title: All the Way
tagline: Politics is war.
overview: Lyndon B. Johnson's amazing 11-month journey from taking office after JFK's assassination, through the fight to pass the 1964 Civil Rights Act and his own presidential campaign, culminating on the night LBJ is actually elected to the office – no longer the 'accidental President.'
plot:
All the Way is a 2016 American biographical drama television film about the first year of Lyndon B. Johnson's presidency, from his succession after the assassination of John F. Kennedy to his victory in the 1964 election. Directed by Jay Roach and adapted by Robert Schenkkan from his 2012 play, it stars Bryan Cranston, reprising his Broadway role as Johnson, with Melissa Leo as Lady Bird Johnson, Anthony Mackie as Martin Luther King Jr. and Frank Langella as Senator Richard Russell Jr. of Georgia.

In 1963, Johnson takes office after Kennedy's assassination, supported and advised by his wife, Lady Bird, and soon turns to passing the Civil Rights Act. King presses him to pass the bill without weakening amendments, while Southern Democrats led by Russell oppose it so fiercely that they threaten to abandon the party,. After the Gulf of Tonkin incident, wary of being outflanked by Republicans, he asks Congress for a resolution backing retaliation against North Vietnam.

Once the Civil Rights Act passes over a filibuster, Johnson campaigns against Barry Goldwater. Johnson orders J. Edgar Hoover to investigate the murders of civil rights workers Chaney, Goodman and Schwerner in Mississippi. At the Democratic National Convention in Atlantic City, Mississippi sends two rival delegations: the regular Dixiecrat delegation, which threatens to walk out, and the Mississippi Freedom Democratic Party, backed by the civil rights movement. Johnson's compromise pleases neither side. Though he attacks Goldwater as a dangerous fanatic, Johnson remains anxious, especially when his aide and friend Walter Jenkins is arrested after a sexual encounter with a man in a public restroom. King wins the Nobel Peace Prize, and Hoover, still distrustful, sends him an anonymous letter urging him to kill himself, which King ignores. Johnson wins decisively but loses the Deep South, and after a phone call with Russell he closes with a paranoid monologue about those around him.

HBO Films acquired the rights in 2014, with Steven Spielberg producing, and Schenkkan reimagined the play cinematically rather than simply filming it. Broadcast on HBO on May 21, 2016, the film earned strong reviews, with 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and 78 on Metacritic. It received eight Primetime Emmy nominations, including Outstanding Television Movie and acting nods for Cranston and Leo.

title: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
tagline: Forge your own path.
overview: The spirited Boruto Uzumaki, son of Seventh Hokage Naruto, is a skilled ninja who possesses the same brashness and passion his father once had. However, the constant absence of his father, who is busy with his Hokage duties, puts a damper on Boruto's fire. plot:
Boruto: Naruto the Movie is a Japanese animated martial-arts fantasy released in 2015, marking Hiroyuki Yamashita's debut as a director. Based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto franchise, it is the second film in the series' canonical storyline and a sequel to the manga. Yūko Sanpei voices Boruto Uzumaki and Junko Takeuchi his father, Naruto, with Kokoro Kikuchi and Noriaki Sugiyama also starring.

Fifteen years after the Fourth Great Ninja War and Naruto's final duel with Sasuke Uchiha, the village of Konohagakure is prospering under Naruto as the Seventh Hokage. Married to Hinata, he has two children, Boruto and Himawari. Boruto has joined a ninja team with Sarada, the daughter of Sasuke and Sakura, and the enigmatic Mitsuki, under their teacher Konohamaru, but he resents his father for putting his duties ahead of his family. When Naruto misses Himawari's birthday, an angry Boruto asks Sasuke to train him so he can surpass his father. Sasuke agrees on the condition that Boruto masters the Rasengan, which he learns from Konohamaru, but struggling to perfect it, Boruto turns to a Scientific Ninja Tool given to him by Katasuke, an arrogant scientist.

Boruto uses the device to cheat his way through the Chunin Exams. Naruto sees through it at once and disqualifies his son in public, and Boruto's bitter outburst makes Naruto recognise his own failings. The moment is shattered by the arrival of Momoshiki and Kinshiki Ōtsutsuki, who want the Nine-Tailed Fox Kurama, sealed within Naruto, to create a chakra fruit that will make them immortal. Naruto shields Boruto and the crowd and is taken captive. Learning he is alive, Sasuke and the other Kage set out to rescue him, and Boruto, now understanding his father's role, insists on joining them. After Naruto is freed, father and son acknowledge their mistakes. Momoshiki devours his partner to grow stronger, and when Katasuke's meddling accidentally revives him, Naruto lends Boruto his chakra to create a giant Rasengan that destroys the enemy. Afterwards, Boruto resolves to follow Sasuke's path as a protector working from the shadows while supporting Sarada's dream of becoming Hokage; Mitsuki reveals he is the son of Orochimaru.

Released on August 7, 2015, the film earned ¥2.62 billion in Japan, becoming the highest-grossing Naruto film, and was well received; Anime News Network graded it "A−", and critics praised its fight animation.

title: Mile 22
tagline: Option 1: Diplomacy. Option 2: Military. Meet Option 3.
overview: An elite group of American operatives, aided by a top-secret tactical command team, must transport an asset who holds life-threatening information to an extraction point 22 miles away through the hostile streets of an Asian city.
plot:
Mile 22 is a 2018 action thriller film directed by Peter Berg and starring Mark Wahlberg, Lauren Cohan, Iko Uwais, John Malkovich, and Pedro Pascal.

The movie follows the story of James Silva (Mark Wahlberg), an elite CIA operative who leads a team of highly skilled agents on a mission to transport a valuable asset from Indonesia to the United States. The asset is a young woman named Gina (Lauren Cohan) who possesses a rare genetic trait that could be used to create a new, highly effective vaccine.

As the team embarks on their perilous journey across Southeast Asia, they face numerous challenges and obstacles, including treacherous terrain, ruthless mercenaries, and corrupt government officials. Along the way, James forms a bond with his team members, including Tami (Lauren Cohan), a skilled assassin; Jax (Iko Uwais), a deadly martial artist; and Gunter (John Malkovich), a seasoned veteran.

As they navigate through the treacherous landscape, the team discovers that they are being pursued by a ruthless mercenary named Balik (Pedro Pascal) who is working for a mysterious organization known as "The Syndicate." The Syndicate will stop at nothing to acquire Gina's genetic trait and use it for their own nefarious purposes.

As the stakes grow higher, James and his team must use all of their skills and resources to stay one step ahead of Balik and his cohorts. Along the way, they encounter a series of intense action sequences, including a thrilling motorcycle chase through the streets of Jakarta and a brutal hand-to-hand combat fight in a crowded market.

As the mission reaches its climax, James and his team face off against Balik and The Syndicate in an explosive showdown at the airport. In the end, James emerges victorious, but not without sacrifices. The movie ends with James reflecting on the cost of his mission and the true meaning of loyalty and sacrifice.

Throughout the movie, Berg's direction is fast-paced and intense, with a focus on high-octane action sequences and heart-pumping suspense. The cast delivers strong performances, with Wahlberg bringing his signature tough-guy charm to the lead role. The movie's themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the true cost of heroism are timely and thought-provoking.

Overall, Mile 22 is a non-stop thrill ride that will keep viewers on the edge of their seats from start to finish. With its talented cast, stunning action sequences, and gripping storyline, it's a must-see for fans of the action-thriller genre.

title: Containment
tagline: No water. No power. No explanation. No escape.
overview: Neighbors in a block wake one morning to find they have been sealed inside their apartments. Can they work together to find out why? Or will they destroy each other in their fight to escape?
plot:
Containment is a 2015 British thriller directed by Neil Mcenery-West in his feature debut, from a screenplay by David Lemon. Mcenery-West began developing the idea in 2008, drawn to contained thrillers and hoping to make a modern urban story in the spirit of Lord of the Flies. His first concept followed a single man trapped alone in his flat, but Lemon widened it to a varied group of residents so it would not feel like one man on a stage. Filming took place in April 2014 in the Weston tower blocks of Southampton, which stayed occupied during the shoot, and many real residents appeared as extras.

Mark, a struggling artist and divorced father, wakes in his flat in a run-down council tower to find the clocks stopped, the power and water off, his phone dead, and his doors and windows sealed shut. A voice on the intercom keeps telling residents to stay calm because the situation is under control. Outside, figures in hazmat suits patrol the grounds and put up a military tent, while people in the opposite block hold up signs asking for help. His teenage neighbor Sergei smashes through the wall with a hammer, bringing his little brother Nicu, and is determined to escape before the officials reach them.

The neighbors form an uneasy alliance with elderly Enid and a young couple, Aiden and Sally, as they search for a way out and see growing horrors both outside and inside the building. When Nicu is taken, Mark and Sergei rescue him and seize a hazmat nurse named Hazel as a hostage, holding her up at the window for the authorities to see. Under questioning, Hazel admits the quarantine is meant to contain an airborne virus that kills within a day, and that infected people may show no symptoms at first. The residents realize escape is their only chance, though not all of them are likely to survive.

Lee Ross plays Mark, with Andrew Leung as Sergei, Gabriel Senior as Nicu, Sheila Reid as Enid, Louise Brealey as Sally, William Postlethwaite as Aiden and Pippa Nixon as Hazel. The film premiered at the East End Film Festival in July 2015, where it won the Accession Award, before its UK release that September. Rotten Tomatoes recorded a 92% approval rating. Leslie Felperin of The Guardian called it a quick, tidy and inventive panic thriller that uses its single location cleverly, despite some stock dialogue, while Eye for Film praised how the director turned the film's limits into a sealed, nightmarish world.

title: He's All That
tagline: It's his turn for a makeover.
overview: To get revenge on her ex-boyfriend, an influencer attempts to transform an unpopular classmate into prom king.
plot:
He's All That is a 2021 American teen romantic comedy film directed by Mark Waters and written by R. Lee Fleming Jr., a gender-swapped remake of the 1999 film She's All That, which was itself a modern take on George Bernard Shaw's Pygmalion. Social media personality Addison Rae makes her film debut as Padgett Sawyer, with Tanner Buchanan as Cameron Kweller, Madison Pettis, Peyton Meyer, and Rachael Leigh Cook and Matthew Lillard, stars of the original film, in new roles. It was released on Netflix on 27 August 2021.

Padgett is a popular high school senior and lifestyle influencer who lives with her divorced mother, a nurse, and hides her modest circumstances from her followers and sponsors by pretending to live in an upscale home. When she catches her boyfriend, the influencer and aspiring rapper Jordan Van Draanen, cheating on her with a backup dancer, her furious reaction is broadcast in a live stream, and she loses followers and sponsorship deals.

To restore her reputation, Padgett accepts a bet from her friend Alden to turn Cameron, an antisocial photographer and the school's least popular boy, into prom king. Cameron is indifferent to her, but she learns about him from his younger sister, Brin, and persuades him to give her horse-riding lessons. As she works to change his appearance and social life, Padgett grows close to Cameron, learning that he and Brin lost their mother in a plane crash and live with their grandmother while their father works abroad. Cameron, in turn, begins to see the real person behind Padgett's online persona. But as their feelings deepen and prom approaches, Jordan tries to win Padgett back, and the revelation of the bet threatens to destroy the trust between them, forcing Padgett to decide what matters more to her: her image or her authenticity.

He's All That received negative reviews, with a 28 percent approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes; the consensus faulted the lack of chemistry between its stars and its failure to improve on the original. Rae's performance was widely criticized, and she received a Golden Raspberry Award for Worst Actress, although the film attracted large viewership on Netflix.

title: Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery
original_title: Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery
overview: Get ready to Rock! Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. Gang team up with the one and only KISS in this all-new, out-of-this-world adventure! We join the Gang at Kiss World – the all-things-Kiss theme park, as they investigate a series of strange hauntings. With help from Kiss, they discover that the Crimson Witch has returned to summon The Destroyer from the alternate dimension of Kissteria! The evil duos ghastly plan, to destroy the earth! Can the Gang's cunning and Kiss's power of rock save the day?!
plot:
Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery is a 2015 animated film that combines the classic mystery-solving adventures of Scooby-Doo with the iconic rock band KISS.

The main themes of this movie revolve around friendship, teamwork, and embracing one's true identity. The story follows Shaggy and Scooby as they team up with the members of KISS - Paul Stanley, Gene Simmons, Eric Singer, and Tommy Thayer - to solve a mystery in the town of New York City.

Throughout the film, the characters learn valuable lessons about working together, trusting each other's unique skills and strengths. Shaggy and Scooby bring their signature laid-back attitude and detective skills, while KISS provides the band's energetic stage presence and musical talents.

The movie also explores themes of identity and self-expression. As the mystery unfolds, the characters discover that they are not just who they seem to be on the surface but have hidden depths and secrets. This is particularly evident in Gene Simmons' character, who struggles with his own identity as a rock star and a father figure.

Ultimately, the film's climax features an energetic musical performance by KISS, which serves as a metaphor for embracing one's true self and finding acceptance within oneself and others. The movie ends on a high note, with the characters coming together to solve the mystery and celebrate their newfound friendships and identities.

Overall, Scooby-Doo! and Kiss: Rock and Roll Mystery is a fun, music-filled adventure that celebrates the power of friendship, teamwork, and self-expression.

title: Curve
overview: A young woman becomes trapped in her car after a hitchhiker causes her to have an automobile accident.
plot:
Curve is a 2015 American horror thriller film directed by Iain Softley from a screenplay by Kimberly Lofstrom Johnson, later rewritten by Lee Patterson. Julianne Hough stars as Mallory Rutledge, a bride-to-be trapped in her car on a deserted highway, and Teddy Sears plays Christian Laughton, the charming but predatory hitchhiker who puts her there, with Penelope Mitchell as Mallory's sister Ella and Madalyn Horcher as a girl named Katie. The film was produced by Jason Blum through Blumhouse Productions together with Ombra Films and LBI Entertainment, and Universal Pictures acquired its worldwide distribution rights.

Mallory is driving to Denver for her wedding rehearsal when she video chats with Ella, who admits she has delayed buying her plane ticket because she doubts Mallory is truly happy about the marriage; Mallory insists she is and ends the call. Soon afterwards her car breaks down in an area without phone service, and a stranger named Christian gets it running again. Feeling guilty for driving off, Mallory turns back and offers him a ride, but his behavior grows increasingly unsettling as he talks about fate having brought them together. When she orders him out, he pulls a knife and forces her to keep driving. Noticing that he is not wearing a seat belt, Mallory deliberately swerves toward a guardrail on a curve, and the car crashes violently and lands upside down. She survives with her leg pinned inside the wreck, while Christian walks away, telling her she must get herself out of this. Over the following days he returns to taunt her, eating and drinking in front of her, telling her he is holding a family hostage, and finally handing her a saw with the suggestion that she cut off her own leg if she wants to live. Weakened and desperate, Mallory resorts to eating a rat and drinking her own urine. When a rainstorm begins to flood the wrecked car and a passing police officer drives away with Christian, Mallory must find a way to free herself and stop him before he harms the captive family.

The film had its world premiere at the Film4 FrightFest on August 31, 2015, and was released through video on demand on January 19, 2016, followed by a home media release on February 2, 2016. Principal photography had begun on October 22, 2013.

title: The Sand
tagline: This Beach is Killer
overview: After an all-night graduation beach party, a group of hung-over students wakes up under the blazing sun to find their numbers somewhat depleted. An enormous alien creature has burrowed down deep and anyone foolish enough to make contact with the sand finds themselves at the mercy of a sea of flesh-eating tentacles. Will they ever be able to escape its carnivorous clutches?
plot:
The Sand, also released as Killer Beach, is a 2015 American horror film directed by Isaac Gabaeff and starring Brooke Butler, Meagan Holder and Mitchel Musso, with Dean Geyer, Cleo Berry and Cynthia Murell among the cast. Some versions of the opening credits use the title Killer Beach, while the closing credits call it The Sand.

A large group of friends holds an all-night beach party, locking their phones in a car trunk so that nobody can post embarrassing pictures online. Two of them find a large ball covered in a sticky substance and bring it back to the party. The next morning Kaylee wakes in the lifeguard hut, her estranged boyfriend Jonah wakes in a convertible beside Chanda, with whom he slept, and others wake on a picnic table or stuck in a trash barrel. Everyone who fell asleep directly on the sand has vanished. When a bird is sucked into the beach, Kaylee realizes the danger, but Marsha steps onto the sand and is trapped, and Vance, falling face first while trying to help, has his skin dissolved before both are dragged under. Kaylee notices nearly invisible tendrils rising toward her hand, and Jonah finds the ball split open and concludes it was an egg whose occupant has burrowed into the beach.

With their phones out of reach, the survivors test the creature's limits. Jonah is slashed while crossing on surfboards, and they notice that it avoids the ashes of the bonfire. A beach patrol officer dismisses their pleas as drug-induced and walks safely in his boots, but he is killed when he reaches for his dropped keys. Mitch dies trying to cross with towels wrapped around his feet, and blood from injuries suffered by Ronnie and Gilbert draws the creature to them. Kaylee confronts Chanda, who admits she slept with Jonah out of jealousy. That night Kaylee, Chanda and Jonah use a raft to reach the patrol car, and Kaylee fights off a huge glowing tentacle by setting it alight with gasoline. Jonah dies of his wounds inside the car. In the morning a man finds the two women, the creature having gone, and they walk off the beach as the monster, revealed to be an enormous jellyfish, swims toward the Santa Monica Pier.

Reviews were mixed, with many critics noting the film's low budget and cheap computer effects. Eye for Film praised its pacing, characterization and rational protagonists, calling it smarter than it looks, while Horror Society rated it eight out of ten and called it a campy good time.

The movie also touches on the idea of responsibility and accountability, highlighting how human carelessness and neglect can have devastating consequences.

Furthermore, Zombie Shark also explores the theme of fear and paranoia, as the characters' perceptions of reality become increasingly distorted by the presence of the zombie shark. This creates a sense of tension and unease, as the audience is left wondering what will happen next and whether anyone will survive the ordeal.

Overall, Zombie Shark is a tense, suspenseful thriller that explores themes of survival, responsibility, and fear in the face of an apocalyptic threat.

His desire for validation and acceptance leads him down a path of self-destruction, as he becomes increasingly entangled with a group of young gangsters.

The film also touches on the theme of class struggle and the economic disparities that can lead to feelings of frustration and disillusionment among young people. Danny's family is struggling financially, and his desire for wealth and status is fueled by his perception of the world around him.

Furthermore, Hot Summer Nights explores the theme of identity and the search for self-discovery. As Danny navigates this treacherous world, he is forced to confront his own vulnerabilities and weaknesses, leading to a deeper understanding of himself and his place in the world.

The movie also grapples with the consequences of violence and the cyclical nature of crime. The film's portrayal of the gang lifestyle is unflinching and realistic, highlighting the devastating effects that this lifestyle can have on individuals and communities.

Overall, Hot Summer Nights is a thought-provoking and intense drama that explores the complexities of youth culture and the struggles of growing up in a world marked by poverty, violence, and disillusionment.

title: The Ridiculous 6
overview: When his long-lost outlaw father returns, Tommy "White Knife" Stockburn goes on an adventure-filled journey across the Old West with his five brothers.
plot:
The Ridiculous 6 is a 2015 American Western comedy film directed by Sean Anders and John Morris, written by Anders and Morris, and produced by Adam Sandler through his production company Happy Madison Productions.

The movie takes place in the late 19th century and follows the story of Tommy Stockton (played by Adam Sandler), a rough-riding cowboy who is on the run from the law. After being accused of stealing $100,000 from a bank, Tommy flees to the mountains of Montana, where he meets a group of outcasts and misfits.

Among them are Samson (played by Nick Swardson), a dim-witted but lovable simpleton; Django (played by Rob Schneider), a former slave who is also an expert in horse riding; and Tito (played by Terry Crews), a tough-as-nails cowboy with a heart of gold. The group, along with Tommy's half-brother, Danny Stockton (played by Taylor Lautner), sets out on a journey to find the legendary Golden Sombrero, a treasure that is said to be hidden somewhere in Mexico.

As they travel through the American West, the group faces numerous challenges and obstacles, including hostile Native Americans, treacherous terrain, and rival treasure hunters. Along the way, Tommy also learns more about his family's past and the reason behind his half-brother's betrayal.

The movie follows a classic Western plot structure, with the group facing various trials and tribulations as they journey towards their goal. However, it also incorporates plenty of comedic elements, thanks to the antics of the lovable but dim-witted Samson and the hilarious banter between Tommy and his half-brother Danny.

As the group gets closer to finding the Golden Sombrero, they are met with unexpected challenges and surprises. In the end, Tommy and his friends successfully find the treasure, but not before facing a final showdown with their rivals.

Throughout the movie, there are plenty of humorous moments, witty one-liners, and entertaining action sequences. The Ridiculous 6 is a lighthearted, family-friendly comedy that pokes fun at traditional Western genre conventions while still delivering plenty of laughs and excitement.

Overall, The Ridiculous 6 is a fun, entertaining movie that is sure to delight fans of Western comedies and Adam Sandler's signature brand of humor.

title: 6 Days
tagline: In the face of terror, a nation will show its strength
overview: London, England, April 1980. Six terrorists assault the Embassy of Iran and take hostages. For six days, tense negotiations are held while the authorities decide whether a military squad should intervene.
plot:
6 Days is a 2017 British-New Zealand action thriller directed by Toa Fraser and written by Glenn Standring, based on the 1980 Iranian Embassy siege in London. It stars Jamie Bell as SAS team leader Rusty Firmin, Abbie Cornish as BBC reporter Kate Adie, Mark Strong as police negotiator Max Vernon and Martin Shaw. The film presents the crisis through these three perspectives: the negotiator, the soldiers and the journalist.

On 30 April 1980, six armed Iranian Arab separatists storm the Iranian Embassy at Princes Gate in Kensington and take more than two dozen people hostage, including police constable Trevor Lock. Their leader, Salim, demands the release of 91 Arab prisoners held in Iran and threatens to begin killing hostages if his demands are not met. Chief Inspector Max Vernon of the Metropolitan Police opens a telephone line with Salim and tries to buy time, building a fragile rapport while promising to help him avoid bloodshed.

As the days pass, Vernon negotiates the release of a few hostages and an extension of the deadline, while Salim demands safe passage out of the country accompanied by Arab ambassadors and insists on getting his message broadcast by the BBC. Outside, Kate Adie reports live from the police cordon, determined to cover the story as it unfolds. Meanwhile, Firmin's SAS team rehearses an assault on the building, waiting for orders from Margaret Thatcher's government, which refuses to give in to terrorism. When the hostage-takers kill a hostage on the sixth day, the soldiers are given the order to storm the embassy in a raid broadcast live on television.

The film recreates the period in detail and emphasizes the tension of waiting and negotiating as much as the climactic raid, known as Operation Nimrod, which made the SAS famous around the world.

6 Days was released in the United Kingdom on 4 August 2017 and was later distributed internationally by Netflix. It received mixed reviews, with about 63 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus described it as a taut if unambitious thriller, while Metacritic gave it a score of 36.

title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
tagline: Never tell him the odds.
overview: Through a series of daring escapades deep within a dark and dangerous criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his mighty future copilot Chewbacca and encounters the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian.
plot:
Solo: A Star Wars Story is a 2018 space western film directed by Ron Howard and written by Lawrence Kasdan, Jody Lee Curtis, and Christopher Weitz. The movie takes place about 10 years before the events of the original Star Wars film (Episode IV: A New Hope) and follows the story of Han Solo, a young smuggler who becomes one of the most iconic heroes in the Star Wars universe.

The film begins with Han Solo (played by Alden Ehrenreich), a street-smart orphan living on the planet Corellia. As a child, Han is forced to survive on the streets, relying on his wits and cunning to get by. He eventually meets his future co-pilot and friend, Chewbacca (Joonas Suotamo), who becomes his loyal companion.

As Han grows older, he becomes involved with Lando Calrissian (Donald Glover), a charismatic smuggler who owns the Millennium Falcon, a ship that will become Han's pride and joy. The two men form an unlikely friendship, but their relationship is put to the test when they are hired by Dryden Vos (Paul Bettany) and his crime lord organization, the Crimson Dawn.

The Crimson Dawn is seeking to acquire the Falcon, which contains a valuable cargo of rare and powerful kyber crystals. Han and Lando must navigate a complex web of intrigue and deception to outwit their enemies and protect the ship. Along the way, they encounter Tobias Beckett (Woody Harrelson), a grizzled old smuggler who becomes an unlikely ally.

As the story unfolds, Han's past is revealed through a series of flashbacks, showcasing his early days as a street urchin and his eventual rise to becoming a skilled smuggler. The film also explores Han's complicated relationship with his father, Tobias Beckett, who abandoned him as a child.

The film explores the emotional toll that war takes on individuals, particularly those who are far from home and have no clear understanding of why they are fighting.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that the motivations behind the invasion are complex and multifaceted, driven by a mix of politics, economics, and ideology. However, for the soldiers themselves, the reality of war is often starkly different from the idealized notion of patriotism and heroism that they were sold before enlisting.

The film also touches on themes of identity, belonging, and the search for purpose in life. The characters are all struggling to find their place in the world, and the experience of war serves as a catalyst for them to confront their own insecurities and fears.

Ultimately, War Pigs is a powerful anti-war statement that challenges the notion of patriotism and heroism in the face of senseless violence and destruction.

Overall, Bajrangi Bhaijaan is a rich and nuanced film that explores complex themes with sensitivity and depth.

title: Boyka: Undisputed IV

overview: In the fourth installment of the fighting franchise, Boyka is shooting for the big leagues when an accidental death in the ring makes him question everything he stands for. When he finds out the wife of the man he accidentally killed is in trouble, Boyka offers to fight in a series of impossible battles to free her from a life of servitude.
plot:
Boyka: Undisputed, also known as Boyka: Undisputed IV, is a 2016 martial arts action film directed by Todor Chapkanov and written by David White and Tony Mosher from a story by Boaz Davidson. The sequel to Undisputed III: Redemption (2010) and the fourth film in the Undisputed series, it stars Scott Adkins, returning as the Russian fighter Yuri Boyka, with Teodora Duhovnikova, Alon Aboutboul, Julian Vergov, Paul Chahidi and Martyn Ford.

Some months after winning his freedom, Boyka is fighting in underground matches in Kyiv under his manager Kiril, with a promising professional bout on the horizon. During one bout he accidentally kills his opponent, Viktor, and is consumed by guilt. When he learns that Viktor left a widow, Alma, he turns his back on an important upcoming fight and, using a forged passport, crosses into Russia to find her in the small town of Drovny.

He discovers that Alma is trapped by debts to the crime boss Zourab, waiting tables at his underground fight club while running a community centre for local children. Zourab is looking for a star fighter, and Boyka strikes a deal: he will fight for him in return for Alma's freedom. Zourab sets him three bouts. Alma lets him train at her community centre, and as he wins each match, including a fight against two brothers at once and a victory over Zourab's top enforcer, Igor Kazmir, the two slowly come to understand each other. Alma explains that she cannot abandon the children, who might otherwise fall into crime.

Zourab breaks the agreement and demands one last fight against his true champion, Koshmar, a giant and seemingly unstoppable brawler, bringing him in with the help of a corrupt senior police officer. After a brutal fight, Boyka breaks Koshmar's arm and leg and knocks him out of the ring. Furious, Zourab seizes Alma as a hostage and orders his men to kill Boyka. Boyka fights through them all and, although shot, chases down Zourab and kills him. Wounded, he asks Alma to forgive him for Viktor's death before he is arrested, missing his big fight.

Six months later, Alma visits him in prison and tells him she forgives him, and Boyka continues to fight in pursuit of his goal of being the most complete fighter in the world. At the 2017 Shanghai International Film Festival the film won a best fight award, and Adkins received an award for his action performance.

Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion is a 2017 Indian fantasy adventure film directed by S.S. Rajamouli and produced by Arka Media Works, in association with Shobu Yarlagadda's Annapurna Studios.

The story begins with the flashback of Bhallaladeva (Rana Daggubati), who was once a close friend and brother-in-law to the king of Mahishmathi. However, he is betrayed by his own brother, Bhairava (Sathyaraj), and is left for dead in a well. The film then jumps forward in time to the present day, where we meet the protagonist, Mahendra (Prabhas), who is the crown prince of Mahishmathi.

Mahendra's life takes a dramatic turn when he discovers that his brother Bhairava has taken over the throne and is ruling with an iron fist. The people of Mahishmathi are suffering under Bhairava's cruel rule, and Mahendra decides to take action to reclaim his rightful place as king.

As Mahendra navigates the complexities of court politics, he meets a mysterious woman named Avanthika (Anushka Shetty), who is revealed to be the reincarnation of Devasena, the princess of Mahishmathi. The two form a strong bond, and Mahendra learns that Avanthika has the power to bring back his brother Bhairava from the dead.

However, things take a dark turn when Mahendra discovers that Bhairava's resurrection is not what it seems. In reality, Bhairava is being controlled by a powerful demon named Kattappa (Sathyaraj), who was once a loyal servant of the king but has since become corrupted by his own ambition.

As the story unfolds, Mahendra and Avanthika must navigate treacherous obstacles and confront their enemies in order to save Mahishmathi from destruction. Along the way, they discover that Bhairava's resurrection is just the beginning of a larger conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the kingdom.

The film builds towards an epic climax as Mahendra and his allies face off against Kattappa and his minions in a battle for control of the throne. In the end, Mahendra emerges victorious, but not without great cost. The film concludes with a sense of closure and new beginnings, as Mahendra and Avanthika look towards a brighter future for Mahishmathi.

Throughout the film, Rajamouli's direction is masterful, weaving together complex characters, intricate plot twists, and stunning visuals to create a cinematic experience that is both thrilling and emotionally resonant. The film's themes of loyalty, betrayal, and redemption are timeless and universal, making Bāhubali 2: The Conclusion a must-see for fans of epic fantasy adventures.

As the story unfolds, Ash and his friends must navigate through multiple timelines and dimensions to stop Hoopa from causing destruction on a massive scale. Along the way, they encounter various Pokémon and characters from different worlds, including some familiar faces from previous movies.

In the climactic final battle, Ash and his friends face off against Hoopa in an epic showdown that takes them across multiple dimensions. With the help of their new allies, including Mallow and Ryo, they are able to defeat Hoopa and restore balance to the world.

The movie ends with Ash and his friends reflecting on what they have learned about themselves and each other. They realize that even though they come from different worlds and backgrounds, they can still work together and support one another in times of need. title: Blair Witch
tagline: There's something evil hiding in the woods.
overview: Students on a camping trip discover something sinister is lurking beyond the trees.
plot:
Blair Witch is a 2016 American found-footage supernatural horror film directed by Adam Wingard and written by Simon Barrett. The third film in the Blair Witch series, it is a direct sequel to The Blair Witch Project (1999) that disregards Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2 (2000). It stars James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Brandon Scott and Valorie Curry.

In 2014, James Donahue, whose sister Heather vanished in 1994 in the Black Hills Forest near Burkittsville, Maryland, while making a documentary about the Blair Witch legend, sees an online video that appears to show her. Hoping to learn what happened, he heads into the woods with his friends Peter and Ashley and the film student Lisa, who is documenting the search. Two locals, Lane and Talia, who posted the video, agree to guide them in exchange for joining the expedition. Ashley injures her foot crossing a creek, and that night Lane and Talia recount the legends of the witch and the 1940s Rustin Parr murders.

After a night of strange noises, the group wakes in the afternoon to find stick figures hanging from the trees. When twine is found in Lane's bag, he and Talia admit to making the figures to fool them, and they are sent away. But the others find themselves walking in circles back to their camp, and a drone reveals only endless forest. Ashley's wound worsens, as though something is moving under her skin. Peter is pursued by an unseen entity and killed. Lane and Talia return, claiming they have wandered for days without seeing the sun. Unseen forces tear the group apart, killing Talia and dragging Ashley away.

During a storm, James and Lisa find Rustin Parr's house, though it supposedly burned down long ago. James runs inside after what he believes is Heather's voice. Lisa, chased by a tall, emaciated creature, is trapped in a tunnel by a crazed Lane, whom she kills. Fleeing to the attic, she sees in a mirror an image proving that the footage that lured them into the woods had come from her own camera. James is tricked by the witch into turning around and vanishes, and Lisa, trying to look only through her camera, is finally snatched away when the creature imitates James's voice.

Released by Lionsgate on September 16, 2016, Blair Witch received mixed reviews, with critics finding a few effective scares but considering it largely a rehash of the original; Rotten Tomatoes reported 38% approval. It grossed $45 million against a $5 million budget but was considered a box-office disappointment.

tagline: The park is gone.
overview: When the island's dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen and Claire mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.
plot:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom is a science fiction adventure film directed by J.A. Bayona and written by Emily Carmichael, Seth Robson, and Colin Trevorrow. The movie takes place three years after the events of Jurassic World (2018) and follows the story of Claire Dearing (Bryce Dallas Howard), the former park manager of Isla Nublar.

The film begins with a prologue that shows the aftermath of the volcanic eruption on Isla Nublar, which caused widespread destruction and killed many of the dinosaurs. The scene then cuts to the present day, where we see Claire living in San Diego with Owen Grady (Chris Pratt), a Velociraptor trainer who has been working with her.

The story takes a dramatic turn when a wealthy entrepreneur named Benjamin Lockwood (James Cromwell) hires Claire and Owen to return to Isla Nublar to rescue his wife, Ellie (DeWanda Wise), who is being held captive by the park's former owner, Simon Masrani (Irrfan Khan). However, upon their arrival, they discover that the island has been taken over by a group of mercenaries led by B.D. Wong's character, Dr. Henry Wu.

The mercenaries plan to capture and sell the dinosaurs to a wealthy collector, but Claire and Owen soon realize that this is not the only reason behind their actions. The true intention is to use the dinosaurs as a means to gain control over the island and its resources. As they try to escape, they are ambushed by the mercenaries, and Owen is captured.

Claire teams up with a group of allies, including ZOologist Dr. Alan Grant (Sam Neill), who had previously worked on the original Jurassic Park project, and a young woman named Maisie Lockwood (Isabella Sermon), Benjamin's daughter. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to rescue Owen and stop the mercenaries from exploiting the dinosaurs.

As they navigate through the island, they encounter various dangers, including the Indominus Rex, a genetically engineered super-dinosaur that has been created by Simon Masrani. The group also discovers that the mercenaries are being led by a mysterious figure known as the "Black Market" dealer, who is revealed to be none other than Claire's former business partner, Eli Mills (Rafe Spall).

The climax of the film takes place at an abandoned volcano on Isla Nublar, where the group faces off against the mercenaries and the Indominus Rex. In a thrilling sequence, Owen and Claire work together to defeat the super-dinosaur and escape the island.

In the end, Claire and Owen manage to rescue Maisie and escape the island, but not before realizing that the dinosaurs are being exploited for their own benefit. The film concludes with a sense of hope and renewal, as Claire and Owen vow to protect the dinosaurs and ensure their safety.

Overall, Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom is an action-packed adventure film that explores themes of conservation, exploitation, and the ethics of playing God with nature. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the film was a commercial success and set the stage for the next installment in the Jurassic World franchise.

title: Monkey King: Hero Is Back
overview: The all-powerful Monkey King once roamed freely between Heaven and Earth, but after angering the Gods, he was imprisoned within an ice cage deep within the mountains. 500 years later, monsters attack a small village and a child flees to the mountains. plot:
Monkey King: Hero Is Back is a 2015 Chinese fantasy adventure film directed by Raman Hui and produced by Hengdian Chinese Film Production Co., along with other production companies.

The movie begins with the Monkey King, Sun Wukong (played by Donnie Yen), who has been imprisoned in the White Cloud Temple for over 500 years. The story is set in a modern-day China where the Monkey King's legend has become a myth. However, the evil forces of the White Bone Demon and her son, General Zhao, are trying to revive the ancient magic that once made the Monkey King powerful.

The film starts with Sun Wukong being released from his prison by the Jade Emperor (played by Raymond Lam), who is worried about the growing threat of General Zhao. The Monkey King returns to the mortal world to find that he has lost his magical powers and must rely on his human form to survive.

As Sun Wukong navigates this new reality, he meets a young girl named Lin Shaoyu (played by Shu Qi), who is being pursued by General Zhao's men. The Monkey King decides to help her, and together they embark on a journey to stop General Zhao and his plans to revive the ancient magic.

Along the way, Sun Wukong encounters various characters from Chinese mythology, including Zhu Bajie (played by Xuan Liu) and Sha Wujing (played by Danny Chan), who join him on his quest. The group faces numerous challenges as they battle against General Zhao's forces and try to find a way to restore the Monkey King's powers.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that General Zhao is not just a simple villain but a complex character with his own motivations and backstory. His desire for power and revenge drives him to seek out the ancient magic, which he believes will allow him to overthrow the Jade Emperor and rule China.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Sun Wukong and General Zhao, with the fate of the world hanging in the balance. In the end, the Monkey King is able to defeat General Zhao and restore his powers, but not before realizing that his actions have consequences and that he must learn to use his powers responsibly.

Throughout the movie, there are many action-packed sequences, stunning visual effects, and memorable performances from the cast. Donnie Yen shines as the Monkey King, bringing a unique blend of humor, wit, and martial arts expertise to the role.

Overall, Monkey King: Hero Is Back is an entertaining and visually stunning film that brings Chinese mythology to life in a fresh and exciting way. With its engaging storyline, memorable characters, and impressive action sequences, it's a must-see for fans of fantasy adventure movies.

title: 12 Rounds 3: Lockdown
tagline: Twelve Rounds In the Clip. One Shot at Redemption.
overview: Lockdown Follows a police officer who returns to duty after recovering from a gun shot wound to discover incriminating evidence of illegal activities against those closest to him. He quickly finds himself trapped inside his own precinct, hunted and in search of the truth, as the crooked cops stop at nothing to recover the evidence.
plot:
12 Rounds 3: Lockdown is an American action film of 2015 directed by Stephen Reynolds and written by Bobby Lee Darby and Nathan Brookes. The third and final film in the 12 Rounds series, co-produced by WWE Studios and Lionsgate, it gave the wrestler Dean Ambrose (Jonathan Good) his film debut as Detective John Shaw. Roger Cross plays the corrupt Detective Tyler Burke, with Lochlyn Munro as Darrow, Sarah Smyth as Jenny Taylor and Rebecca Marshall as Captain Ellen Matthews.

Burke and his men Gideon and Saul kill the drug dealer George Freemont after destroying evidence that Burke has been distributing narcotics. Meanwhile Shaw returns to duty at his precinct, having been sidelined with post-traumatic stress disorder after a shooting that killed his partner, Ray Jones. Burke, meanwhile, is being celebrated for the Freemont bust. Burke does not know that Freemont had hidden a backup of the evidence on a flash drive, found during the autopsy and logged by Taylor. Reading the report, Shaw takes the drive. Burke races to the station, sets off the fire alarm to empty the building of everyone but his own crooked officers, and imposes a total lockdown, cutting all communications.

Realising he is being hunted, Shaw ambushes Burke's accomplice Meeks and uses him as a shield, and Burke shoots Meeks. With only twelve bullets in his gun, Shaw must survive the ambushes and take out the corrupt officers by other means. He encounters Taylor who sees Meeks's blood on him and refuses to trust him, and he warns her to hide. Burke tells Matthews that Shaw killed Meeks. Burke then captures Taylor and threatens to kill her unless Shaw surrenders; Shaw gives himself up, but Burke kills her anyway. After a gunfight that nearly kills Burke, Shaw disables the cameras and tries to send the evidence to Internal Affairs, but Darrow cuts the network before it finishes. From the roof Shaw phones Matthews to expose Burke. Captured, he sees Burke destroy the drive, but in a blackout kills Darrow and escapes. Meeting Matthews behind the building, he learns that she too is in league with Burke, who then shoots her as the SWAT team storms in. Facing arrest, he plays a recording of Burke incriminating himself, and when Burke reaches for his gun, Shaw shoots him in the leg with his last bullet and handcuffs him.

The film was released in select cinemas and on demand in September 2015 by Lionsgate. What's on TV called it a nifty Die Hard-in-a-police-station idea wasted on a by-the-numbers film.

title: XOXO
tagline: Eat. Sleep. Rave. Repeat.
overview: XOXO follows six strangers whose lives collide in one frenetic, dream-chasing, hopelessly romantic night.
plot:
XOXO is a 2016 American music drama film directed by Christopher Louie, a music video director who wrote the story, from a screenplay by Dylan Meyer. Produced for Netflix by Prettybird, with Joe Russell, Louie, Daniel Shafer and Max Leitman as producers and the DJ Pete Tong as producer and music supervisor, it stars Graham Phillips, Sarah Hyland, Brett DelBuono, Hayley Kiyoko, Colin Woodell, Chris D'Elia, Ryan Hansen and Ione Skye, with Ian Anthony Dale, Brianne Howey and Henry Zaga.

The film follows six strangers whose lives intersect during a single night at XOXO, a huge fictional electronic dance music festival in the desert. Ethan Shaw (Phillips), a young bedroom DJ whose track "All I Ever Wanted" has exploded on YouTube, is offered a make-or-break slot at the festival by way of his best friend and manager Tariq (DelBuono), but he has only hours to get there. Things go wrong at once: a festivalgoer passes Tariq a hallucinogen with a kiss and he disappears into a wild trip, Ethan's name is missing from the lists, and a cynical star DJ, Avilo (Hansen), tries to lure him into a dubious collaboration. Krystal (Hyland), a romantic raver, hopes to meet Jordan (Zaga), a date she found online, but crosses paths with Ethan instead. Shanni (Kiyoko) and Ray (Woodell), a couple facing a long-distance future because she is moving to New York, try to sneak into the sold-out event through a sewer tunnel. Neil (D'Elia), a former DJ who now drives a party bus that breaks down on the highway, must confront Avilo, the man he blames for ruining his career, while the festival's founder Anders (Dale) wanders through offering advice. By the climactic set, each problem is resolved and Ethan finally gets his chance.

In 2015 Netflix announced the casting and that it would produce and distribute the film. To give the EDM setting authenticity, scenes were shot at three real music festivals. XOXO premiered on Netflix on 26 August 2016 after a one-week run at the Laemmle Royal in Los Angeles. Reviews were mixed, with a 71% Rotten Tomatoes approval rating from a small sample. The Hollywood Reporter found it so silly it was almost charming, praising Damián Acevedo's neon cinematography and the soundtrack, and Consequence of Sound called it sweet but lacking any real perspective on EDM culture, while The Village Voice wrote that, though predictable, it rewards viewers willing to give in to its rhythms.

Overall, Going in Style offers a heartwarming and entertaining exploration of themes that are both timely and timeless.

plot:
Mission: Impossible - Fallout is a 2018 action spy film directed by Christopher McQuarrie and produced by Paramount Pictures. The movie marks the sixth installment in the Mission: Impossible film series.

The story begins with Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his team, including Benji Dunn (Simon Pegg), Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames), and Ilsa Faust (Rebecca Ferguson), on a mission to neutralize a threat from the terrorist group, The Apostles. However, things take a turn when they discover that the Apostles are actually working for August Walker (Henry Cavill), an American CIA operative.

As Ethan delves deeper into the mystery, he uncovers a plot by August to sell nuclear materials to the highest bidder. Meanwhile, Ilsa is revealed to be working undercover as a double agent, feeding information to The Apostles while secretly working with Ethan's team.

The stakes escalate when Ethan and his team are ambushed by The Apostles in Paris, resulting in Luther being killed. The team then flees to Istanbul, where they discover that August has stolen the plutonium from the nuclear facility, intending to sell it to a terrorist organization.

Ethan and Ilsa embark on a perilous journey across Europe, following a trail of clues and encountering various obstacles along the way. They visit Morocco, Austria, and Norway, all while being pursued by The Apostles and August's henchmen.

As the story unfolds, Ethan and Ilsa grow closer, but their relationship is complicated by Ilsa's loyalty to her country and her allegiance to Ethan's team. Meanwhile, August's true intentions are revealed, and Ethan must confront him in a thrilling showdown.

The film's climax features an intense sequence of action-packed set pieces, including a HALO (high-altitude, low-opening) skydive jump by Ethan and Ilsa, as well as a high-speed car chase through the streets of Paris. The final confrontation between Ethan and August takes place at a nuclear facility in Norway, where Ethan must use his skills to disable the plutonium's delivery system.

In the end, Ethan successfully prevents the sale of the plutonium, but not before Ilsa is mortally wounded by one of August's henchmen. As Ethan holds her dying body, he realizes that their relationship has become a central part of his mission. The film concludes with Ethan and his team escaping, while Ilsa passes away in Ethan's arms.

Throughout the movie, Tom Cruise performs many of his own stunts, which adds to the film's sense of realism and authenticity. The action sequences are expertly choreographed, and the cinematography is breathtaking, capturing the beauty of various locations around the world.

Overall, Mission: Impossible - Fallout is a thrilling and entertaining spy thriller that delivers on its promise of high-octane action and suspenseful storytelling.

title: The Dark Tower
tagline: There are other worlds than these
overview: A boy haunted by visions of a parallel world aids its disillusioned guardian in preventing the destruction of the nexus of universes known as the Dark Tower.
plot:
The Dark Tower (2017) is a fantasy western film directed by Nikolaj Arcel, based on the novel of the same name by Stephen King.

The main themes of The Dark Tower (2017) include:

1. **The Power of Storytelling**: The film explores the idea that stories have the power to shape reality and create worlds. Roland Deschain's quest to find the Dark Tower is a metaphor for the power of storytelling, as he seeks to understand the nature of his own world and the universe.

2. **Redemption and Sacrifice**: Throughout the film, Roland's character undergoes significant development as he grapples with his past mistakes and the weight of his responsibilities. title: The Con Is On
tagline: And it won't be their last
overview: In an effort to avoid paying off a massive gambling debt to a notorious mobster in England, a couple flees to Los Angeles and hatch a jewel theft plot.
plot:
The Con Is On, developed under the title The Brits Are Coming, is a 2018 heist comedy directed by James Oakley, who co-wrote it with Alex Michaelides. Uma Thurman and Tim Roth play a pair of British con artists, with Maggie Q, Sofía Vergara, Alice Eve, Parker Posey, Crispin Glover and Stephen Fry in supporting roles.

Harriet "Harry" Fox and her husband Peter are London grifters; Harry gambles, and Peter drinks and uses cocaine. After they lose a large sum connected to a botched deal, they owe money to Irina, a dangerous gangster, and they flee to Los Angeles to hide and plan their next move. There they meet Sidney, an old friend who is a corrupt priest with a sideline in shady jobs. He offers them work transporting a shipment of opium, but he also tips off Irina about the price on their heads. Peter learns that Irina's grudge is personal: she has feelings for Harry and despises him.

Hiding in a luxury Beverly Hills hotel, Peter runs into his ex-wife Jacky. She is now married to Gabriel, a film director who is cheating on her with both Gina, a relative of Jacky's, and Vivienne, a fiery actress demanding that he leave his wife. Jacky's blue gemstone ring, worth about £5 million, gives the Foxes an idea: they will steal it and use it to pay off Irina. They have a forger make a copy so they can swap the rings at a dinner party at Jacky and Gabriel's mansion, but a drunken Gabriel and Vivienne ruin the plan. When Irina tracks them to the hotel, the couple hide at the mansion, where Harry poses as a dog whisperer. Gabriel wins Best Director at an awards show and declares Vivienne his true love in his acceptance speech, which causes a furious fight at home. Jacky throws the ring away, and it lands in Harry's wine glass. After a shootout with Irina and her henchman, Harry wounds the gangster and hands her a ring; at the airport, Harry realizes the rings were mixed up. The couple board a flight to Brazil, penniless but free of their debt.

Casting took place in 2015. Although the story is set in Los Angeles, it was shot in Manhattan and Yonkers, New York. Lionsgate released the film in limited theaters and on video on demand on May 4, 2018. Reviews were poor, and none of the six critics counted by Rotten Tomatoes gave it a positive review. The Los Angeles Times enjoyed its stylish first half, its martini-dry dialogue and Thurman's comic turn but disliked the rest. RogerEbert.com gave it one and a half stars.

As the heroes work together to thwart the Legion's plans, they learn to put aside their differences and trust one another in order to succeed. This emphasis on collaboration and cooperation serves as a powerful metaphor for the importance of unity and diversity in overcoming even the most daunting challenges.

This lighthearted approach serves as a clever subversion of expectations, inviting viewers to laugh while also reflecting on the complexities of being a hero.

Overall, LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Attack of the Legion of Doom! is a film that celebrates the power of teamwork, diversity, and self-discovery, all while delivering plenty of humor and action along the way.

title: The Condemned 2

overview: A former bounty hunter who finds himself on the run as part of a revamped Condemned tournament, in which convicts are forced to fight each other to the death as part of a game that's broadcast to the public.
plot:
The Condemned 2, also released as The Condemned 2: Desert Prey, is a 2015 American action film directed by Roel Reiné and produced by WWE Studios. Professional wrestler Randy Orton stars as the bounty hunter Will Tanner, with Eric Roberts as his father Frank, Wes Studi, Steven Michael Quezada and Bill Stinchcomb. Written by Alan McElroy and shot in New Mexico, it is a standalone sequel to The Condemned (2007), which starred Steve Austin, and shares only its general theme of people forced into a deadly game for the entertainment of gamblers. Lionsgate released it in a handful of theaters and on video on demand on 6 November 2015.

Will Tanner leads a team of tough, skilled bounty hunters in the family business founded by his father. Their mission is to capture Cyrus Merrick, a criminal entrepreneur who runs illegal gambling on life-and-death contests. When the team finds him, he is presiding over a wager on which of two abducted homeless men will die first from poison. In the violent confrontation that follows, Merrick is killed rather than captured, and the authorities let Will go free only on condition that he leave bounty hunting for good, a decision that infuriates his father.

Will tries to start over, but Merrick's surviving right-hand man has other plans. He organizes a new high-stakes game in which Will himself becomes the prey: his former colleagues are blackmailed into trying to kill him, each attack captured by drones and broadcast to wealthy spectators placing bets in a secret casino. Hunted across the desert, Will must rely on his skills and instincts to survive while trying to understand who is behind the game. With the help of his father and an intelligence specialist, he fights his way toward the man running the operation, who eventually enters the game himself as another contestant in a final kill-or-be-killed showdown.

The film received negative reviews. Dennis Harvey of Variety called it a belated, barely related sequel generic enough to make the forgettable 2007 original look like an oasis of cinematic personality, criticizing its clichéd dialogue, unremarkable stunts and failure to make use of Orton's imposing physique, though he noted the scenery-chewing performances of Roberts and Quezada.

The story begins with the Bellas struggling to find their place in the world without their iconic competition circuit. The group's leader, Aubrey Posen (Anna Camp), is trying to navigate her post-Bella life, while also dealing with the pressure of being a former champion. The group reluctantly agrees to perform at the World Championship of A cappella in China, but things take a turn when they discover that the competition is being held on a US Navy ship.

As the Bellas prepare for the competition, they face various challenges, including Aubrey's struggles with leadership and Emily's desire to pursue a solo career. The group also meets a new rival, Evermoist (a cappella group from China), who are determined to take down the Bellas.

Throughout the movie, the Bellas undergo rigorous training to prepare for the competition, led by their new coach, Gail Abernathy-McKadden (Elizabeth Banks). The group also faces personal struggles, including Aubrey's relationship issues and Emily's feelings of inadequacy.

As the World Championship approaches, the Bellas face off against Evermoist in an epic battle of a cappella. The competition is fierce, but the Bellas ultimately come out on top, thanks to their hard work and dedication.

In the end, the Bellas are hailed as champions, and Aubrey finally finds her place in the world. Emily pursues her solo career, while Chloe finds love with a fellow musician. The movie ends on a high note, with the Bellas performing a final show-stopping number that showcases their talents.

Overall, Pitch Perfect 3 is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of friendship, perseverance, and finding one's place in the world. With its talented cast, witty dialogue, and catchy musical numbers, it's a must-see for fans of the Pitch Perfect franchise.

title: Pet
tagline: If You Love Something, Never Let It Go.
overview: A man bumps into an old crush and becomes obsessed. After several failed attempts at winning her over, he kidnaps her and holds her captive underneath the animal shelter where he works.
plot:
Pet is a 2016 psychological thriller film directed by Carles Torrens and written by Jeremy Slater, who had sold the script in 2007. It stars Dominic Monaghan as Seth, Ksenia Solo as Holly, Jennette McCurdy as Claire, Nathan Parsons as Eric and Da'Vone McDonald as Nate.

Seth, a painfully introverted man who works at an animal control center, becomes obsessed with Holly, a waitress and former high school classmate, after seeing her writing in a journal on a bus. Encouraged by Nate, a security guard at work, he studies her online profiles and asks her out, but she rejects him. When he follows her to the bar where her ex-boyfriend Eric works and refuses to accept her rejection, a scuffle breaks out, and Seth steals her journal, which he reads obsessively. In an abandoned wing of the shelter he finds a hidden room, builds a steel cage, then breaks into Holly's apartment and kidnaps her.

Seth tells the caged Holly that he loves her and has imprisoned her to "save" her. From the journal he has learned that Holly's friend Claire had an affair with Eric, and that Holly, in a rage, crashed their car into a truck and then stabbed the injured Claire with a shard of glass, a death blamed on the accident. Since then Holly has committed a series of gruesome murders and recorded them in her journal, and Seth has found a purpose in stopping her. The two engage in psychological games, with Seth insisting she kills out of guilt and Holly answering that she kills for pleasure. When the suspicious Nate discovers Holly, she distracts him so Seth can overpower him, and at her urging Seth kills Nate and disposes of the body. Holly then persuades Seth to prove his love by cutting off his finger, seizes his knife, threatens suicide unless he frees her, and slits his throat. Some time later, Holly is back with Eric and has published her journal entries as fiction through a vanity press. Discovering that Eric is cheating again, she spares him and instead visits a warehouse where Seth, still alive but horribly mutilated, is kept in a cage, thanking him for absorbing her murderous impulses.

Pet premiered at South by Southwest on March 11, 2016, and was released in nine US theaters on December 2, 2016, by Orion Pictures and Samuel Goldwyn Films, grossing just $8,004. Reviews were mixed, praising its subversive themes and lead performances but criticizing implausible twists; Rotten Tomatoes reported 56% approval and Metacritic a score of 48.

title: Our Times
overview: Office worker Truly Lin goes on a journey through her memories. 20 years ago, she had a crush on the most popular guy in school. Taiyu, a ruffian and a bully, is in love with the campus belle. Truly teams up with Taiyu to tear the golden couple apart and help each other to get the ones they love.
plot:
Our Times (Chinese: 我的少女時代) is a 2015 Taiwanese teen romantic comedy-drama and the feature directorial debut of Frankie Chen, who had previously worked in television drama. It stars Vivian Sung as the schoolgirl Lin Truly, Darren Wang as Hsu Tai-yu, the school's notorious gang leader, Dino Lee as Ouyang Fei-fan, the most popular boy in school, and Dewi Chien as Tao Min-min, with Joe Chen and Jerry Yan as the adult Truly and Tai-yu. Set largely in the 1990s, the film is a nostalgic look at first love and adolescence.

In the present day, Lin Truly is an overworked office employee whose sincerity makes her the target of ridicule from younger colleagues. Listening to an old cassette of a song by Andy Lau, she recalls her high school years, when she was an ordinary girl who idolized Lau and had a crush on Ouyang. When she naively passes on a threatening chain letter to several people, including the school bully Hsu Tai-yu, who is then hit by a car, Tai-yu discovers she sent it and forces her to become his errand girl.

After discovering that Ouyang is secretly dating Min-min, the school's most popular girl, on whom Tai-yu has a crush, Truly forms an alliance with Tai-yu to break the couple up. She learns that Tai-yu and Ouyang were once close friends and that a tragedy turned Tai-yu into a gangster, and she persuades him to become his old self again. As the two study together, defend each other against an unfair school administrator and lead a student protest, their friendship slowly turns into love, but misunderstandings and Tai-yu's health problems separate them before they can confess their feelings. Years later, a chance encounter with Andy Lau leads the adult Truly back to the boy who once promised her that Lau would sing for her.

The film gained wide popularity across Asia, and its theme song, "A Little Happiness" by Hebe Tien, became the first video by a Chinese-language singer to reach 100 million views on YouTube.

Our Times grossed about 84.4 million dollars worldwide, with mainland China its largest market, making it a major commercial success across Asia. Critical response was lukewarm: the South China Morning Post found it excessively saccharine, while the Taipei Times praised Sung's performance and the film's period detail.

title: Forsaken
tagline: Redemption.
overview: John Henry returns to his hometown in hopes of repairing his relationship with his estranged father, but a local gang is terrorizing the town. John Henry is the only one who can stop them, however he has abandoned both his gun and reputation as a fearless quick-draw killer.
plot:
Forsaken is a 2015 Canadian revisionist Western directed by Jon Cassar from a screenplay by Brad Mirman. It stars Kiefer Sutherland and his father Donald Sutherland, who share leading roles in a film for the first time, along with Brian Cox, Michael Wincott, Aaron Poole and Demi Moore. The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2015 and was released in February 2016.

In 1872, John Henry Clayton, a former gunslinger haunted by his past, returns to his hometown in Wyoming after more than ten years of drifting since fighting in the American Civil War. He learns from his father, the stern Reverend Samuel Clayton, that his mother died years earlier. The two men are estranged: the reverend is ashamed of the violent reputation his son earned after the war, and John Henry has lost his faith because of the atrocities he witnessed. He has vowed never to use a gun again and tries to atone by helping his father work the family farm.

John Henry also reunites with his former sweetheart, Mary Alice, who married another man and has a son after he failed to return. Meanwhile the town is being terrorized by a gang working for the ruthless businessman James McCurdy, who is forcing local farmers to sell their land because the railroad is coming. McCurdy recognizes John Henry as a potential threat, and his gang includes the reckless Frank Tillman and "Gentleman" Dave Turner, an elegant gunfighter with his own code of honor who regards John Henry with wary respect. As McCurdy's men grow more violent toward the farmers and John Henry endures their humiliation without fighting back, he is pushed closer to breaking his vow, and the conflict with his father and the gang builds toward a reckoning.

The film received mixed reviews, with a 40 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 55. Several critics appreciated the scenes between the two Sutherlands and the film's classic, unhurried style, while others found the story familiar. Glenn Kenny of RogerEbert.com gave it three out of four stars, writing that it had a solid story and told it without waste.

title: Southbound
tagline: One way in, no way out.
overview: The film contains five stories set on desolate stretches of a desert highway. Two men on the run from their past, a band on its way to a gig, a man struggling to get home, a brother in search of his long-lost sister and a family on vacation are forced to confront their worst fears and darkest secrets in these interwoven tales.
plot:
Southbound is a 2015 American horror anthology made by the directing collective Radio Silence with Roxanne Benjamin, David Bruckner and Patrick Horvath, whose five linked stories unfold along a lonely desert highway watched over by mysterious floating creatures. The cast includes Fabianne Therese, Larry Fessenden, Kate Beahan, Zoe Cooper and Gerald Downey.

In "The Way Out", two men, Mitch and Jack, flee the creatures but keep returning to the same gas station; Jack is killed, and Mitch, convinced he deserves his fate, enters a motel room that becomes his own home, where an apparition of his daughter, Katherine, forever slips away from him. In "Siren", Sadie, Ava and Kim, members of a touring band, break down in the desert and accept a ride from an eccentric couple, whose dinner, prayers and strange medicine draw Sadie's friends into a cult ritual; still haunted by the death of a former bandmate, Sadie escapes and runs into the road, where she is struck by a car.

In "The Accident", the driver, Lucas, distracted by a phone call, calls 911 but cannot say where he is. Voices on the line guide him to an abandoned hospital and talk him through gruesome surgery that kills Sadie, then mock him before letting him leave with clean clothes and a new car. In "Jailbreak", Danny storms a bar called The Trap with a shotgun, searching for his sister, Jesse; its regulars are demons, and he forces the bartender to lead him to Jesse, who is working as a tattoo artist and insists she stays by choice. Danny drags her away into the desert, where she admits that she killed their parents, abandons him to the demons and drives off. In "The Way In", a family spends a last weekend together before their daughter, Jem, leaves for college, when three masked men break in. They kill the mother after revealing a secret about the father, Daryl, and then Daryl himself, showing him a photograph of Katherine; unmasked, they are Mitch and Jack. Jem fights back but is killed, and as the ground opens and the creatures rise, Mitch and Jack escape onto the highway, closing the loop.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 16, 2015, and The Orchard released it in U.S. theaters on February 5, 2016. It drew 81% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 58.

title: War Machine

overview: A rock star general bent on winning the “impossible” war in Afghanistan takes us inside the complex machinery of modern war. Inspired by the true story of General Stanley McChrystal.
plot:
War Machine is a 2017 American war drama film directed by David Fincher, written by Michael Lesslie, Steven Conrad, and Guy Busick, and produced by Plan B Entertainment. The movie is based on the book "The Operators: The World of Military Contractors" by Michael Herr.

The main themes of War Machine include:

1. **Critique of Modern Warfare**: The film critiques the modern concept of warfare, where private military companies (PMCs) like War Machine Inc. profit from conflict while governments bear little to no responsibility for the consequences.
2. **Corporate Greed and Profit**: The movie highlights the corrupting influence of corporate greed on individuals and institutions, as embodied by the character of General Glen McMahon (played by Brad Pitt), who becomes embroiled in a web of deceit and corruption.
3. **The Human Cost of War**: Through the story of Lieutenant Colonel Jim Grogg (played by Jon Bernthal) and his team, the film humanizes the effects of war on soldiers and civilians alike, emphasizing the personal costs of conflict.
4. **Government Accountability**: The movie explores the lack of accountability within governments and institutions, particularly in regards to military actions and their consequences.
5. **The Blurred Lines between War and Business**: War Machine blurs the lines between war and business, highlighting how private companies can profit from conflict while governments claim to be fighting for a higher purpose.

Throughout the film, these themes are interwoven with a complex narrative that explores the inner workings of a PMC and its relationships with government agencies. The movie features a strong ensemble cast, including Shia LaBeouf, Lake Bell, and Meg Tilly.

Overall, War Machine is a thought-provoking commentary on the darker aspects of modern warfare and the corrupting influence of corporate power.

title: Guardians
tagline: Squad of Soviet Superheroes
overview: During the Cold War, an organization called "Patriot" created a super-hero squad, which includes members of multiple soviet republics. For years, the heroes had to hide their identities, but in hard times they must show themselves again.
plot:
Guardians (Russian: Zashchitniki) is a 2017 Russian superhero film directed by Sarik Andreasyan. Anton Pampushnyy, Sanzhar Madiyev, Sebastien Sisak and Alina Lanina play a team of Soviet superheroes, with Valeriya Shkirando as Major Elena Larina and Stanislav Shirin as the villain Kuratov. The team was created during the Cold War and includes representatives of different nationalities of the Soviet Union, each with special abilities linked to the elements. The film was released in Russia in February 2017.

During the Cold War, a secret organisation called Patriot genetically modifies selected individuals to create superhumans capable of defending the Soviet Union. The resulting team consists of Arsus, who can transform into a powerful bear-man; Khan, who moves at superhuman speed and fights with twin curved blades; Ler, who can control earth and stone; and Xenia, who can become invisible when in contact with water. The project succeeds where a rival programme fails, prompting the rival scientist, Professor August Kuratov, to flee and continue his experiments in secret. When soldiers attempt to arrest him, Kuratov destroys the Patriot laboratory in an explosion and is drenched in chemicals, which he survives by rebuilding his body as a cyborg able to generate electricity and control machines. He also creates an army of clones.

After the explosion, the four heroes go into hiding for decades. In the present day, a group of combat robots taking part in a military exercise suddenly turns on its operators and kills them. The Ministry of Defence revives Patriot under Major Larina, who tracks down the surviving heroes and persuades them to reunite. Kuratov, now determined to prove his genius to the world, seizes control of military technology and launches an attack on Moscow, and the Guardians must learn to work together again and rediscover their powers in order to stop him.

The film was conceived as a Russian answer to American superhero franchises, presenting a multinational team drawn from the former Soviet republics, and it relies heavily on computer-generated effects.

Guardians received overwhelmingly negative reviews and was widely panned in Russian media for its script, effects and acting, with only about 27 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes. It debuted at the top of the Russian box office, but its takings fell quickly and it is regarded as a box-office bomb, with some publications listing it among the worst films ever made.

title: Regular Show: The Movie
tagline: Save the Universe from Yourselves... or You're FIRED.
overview: To save the universe, and their friendship, Mordecai and Rigby must defeat an evil volleyball coach.
plot:

Additionally, the movie touches on the idea of finding one's true purpose in life. The film suggests that it's never too late to explore new things and find one's true calling.

Overall, Regular Show: The Movie offers a fun and entertaining ride filled with humor, adventure, and heartwarming moments that celebrate the power of friendship and self-discovery.
