title: The Promise
tagline: Empires fall. Love survives.
overview: Set during the last days of the Ottoman Empire, a love triangle develops between Mikael, a brilliant medical student, the beautiful and sophisticated artist Ana, and Chris, a renowned American journalist based in Paris.
plot:
The Promise is a 2016 American epic historical war drama film directed by Terry George, who co-wrote the screenplay with Robin Swicord. Set in the final years of the Ottoman Empire, it stars Oscar Isaac, Charlotte Le Bon and Christian Bale in a love triangle that unfolds immediately before and during the Armenian genocide, with Shohreh Aghdashloo, Angela Sarafyan, Marwan Kenzari and Jean Reno. Its budget was donated by the Armenian-American businessman Kirk Kerkorian.

Mikael Boghosian, an apothecary in the Armenian village of Siroun in southern Anatolia, becomes engaged to Maral, the daughter of a wealthy neighbor, and uses her dowry to pay for medical school in Constantinople. There he befriends Emre, the son of a senior Ottoman official, and meets Ana Khesarian, a Paris-raised Armenian involved with Chris Myers, an American reporter for the Associated Press. Mikael falls in love with Ana as the First World War begins.

Emre helps Mikael obtain a student exemption from military service, but when Mikael tries to save his uncle during the mass arrests of Armenians in April 1915, he is seized and sent to a forced-labor camp, while Emre is punished with conscription. Mikael escapes and returns home to find the Armenian community under attack. At his family's urging he marries Maral and hides with her in the mountains, where she becomes pregnant. Seeking help, he finds Ana and Chris at a nearby Red Cross mission, but on their way back to Siroun, they discover that the villagers, including Mikael's wife, have been massacred.

Chris is arrested as a spy and sentenced to death, but is freed through Emre's help and the intervention of the American ambassador, Henry Morgenthau; Emre is executed for aiding him. Mikael, Ana and a group of orphans join thousands of Armenians who make a stand against the Ottoman army on Musa Dagh, until a French warship evacuates them. As the refugees row to the ship, Ana is thrown into the water by an artillery barrage and drowns, while Mikael saves his young cousin Yeva. Years later in Watertown, Massachusetts, Mikael, who adopted Yeva, gives a toast at her wedding before the orphans, now grown.

The Promise premiered at the 2016 Toronto International Film Festival and was released in the United States on April 21, 2017, near the anniversary of the genocide. It received mixed reviews, with critics feeling the love triangle overshadowed the history. It grossed only about $12 million against a $90 million budget.

title: Coco
tagline: The celebration of a lifetime
overview: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.
plot:
Coco is a beautifully crafted animated film that pays homage to Mexican culture, traditions, and history. The movie follows the story of Miguel Rivera, a young boy who dreams of becoming a musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz.

Miguel lives with his family in a small town in Mexico, where music is an integral part of their daily lives. However, Miguel's family has a long-standing ban on music due to a past tragedy that led to the death of his great-great-grandfather, Papá. According to legend, Papá was a famous musician who abandoned his family and left them with nothing.

On the Day of the Dead (Día de los Muertos), Miguel decides to sneak out of the house to fulfill his dream of becoming a musician. He steals his family's most prized possession, a magical guitar that supposedly belonged to Ernesto de la Cruz, and sets off on an adventure to find him.

As Miguel travels through the Land of the Dead, he meets various characters who are trapped between worlds, including his deceased relatives and a charming trickster named Héctor. Together, they embark on a journey to uncover the truth about Papá's past and the reason behind the family's ban on music.

Throughout their adventure, Miguel learns valuable lessons about the importance of family, tradition, and following one's dreams. He also discovers that his great-great-grandfather was not the musician he thought he was, but rather a complex individual who made sacrifices for his family.

As the story unfolds, Miguel must confront his own identity and the expectations placed upon him by his family. In the end, he finds a way to honor his ancestors while still pursuing his passion for music.

Coco is a heartwarming film that celebrates Mexican culture and traditions, while also exploring universal themes of identity, family, and the power of music. The animation is stunning, with vibrant colors and intricate details that bring the Land of the Dead to life. The characters are well-developed and relatable, making it easy for audiences of all ages to become invested in their stories.

Overall, Coco is a beautifully crafted film that will leave you smiling, laughing, and maybe even shedding a tear or two. It's a must-see for anyone who loves animation, music, or just great storytelling in general.

overview: A foul-mouthed cat and its gang cross paths with humans.

Through his experiences, the film highlights the transformative power of relationships in helping individuals overcome their past mistakes and find a sense of belonging.

The movie also delves into the theme of redemption, as Tufan seeks to make amends for past wrongdoings and prove himself to those around him. This narrative thread is woven throughout the story, adding depth and complexity to the characters' motivations and actions.

Furthermore, Bad Cat touches on the idea of community and the struggle for survival in a harsh environment. The film's setting, Istanbul, serves as a backdrop for exploring the city's vibrant culture and the resilience of its inhabitants. The movie showcases how even in the face of adversity, individuals can come together to support one another and find ways to thrive.

Overall, Bad Cat is a heartwarming and engaging film that explores themes of redemption, friendship, and survival with humor, wit, and a touch of Turkish culture.

title: Barbie in Rock 'N Royals
overview: When royal Princess Courtney trades places with famous rock star Erika, two worlds collide while both learn to appreciate new friends and experiences.
plot:
Barbie in Rock 'N Royals is a 2015 American-Canadian computer-animated musical film and the 30th entry in the Barbie film series. Directed by Karen J. Lloyd from a screenplay by Marsha Griffin, it was produced by Mattel Playground Productions with animation by Rainmaker Entertainment and music by Gabriel Mann and Rebecca Kneubuhl, and was released direct to video by Universal in the United States on 8 September 2015. Running 84 minutes, it was the last Barbie film in which Barbie plays a character with a different name, and, like Barbie: The Princess and the Popstar, it turns on a princess and a pop star trading places.

Barbie stars as Princess Courtney, a modern royal heading to an island summer camp for the first time. On the island are two rival camps: Camp Royalty, for young princes and princesses, and Camp Pop, for aspiring musicians. A registration mix-up swaps Courtney's name with that of Erika Juno (Chiara Zanni), a famous rock star who has cancelled her tour hoping to make real friends at Camp Pop, so the princess lands among the musicians and the singer among the royals. The camp heads, the stern Lady Anne (Nicole Oliver) of Camp Royalty and Finn Oxford (Michael Dobson) of Camp Pop, share an old rivalry. When Lady Anne hears Erika sing, she fakes a computer failure to block the swap and challenges Finn to a sing-off, with the losing camp to close for good and surrender its land to the winner.

While the two girls learn to fit into unfamiliar worlds and make unexpected friends, Erika overhears Lady Anne's assistant, Clive, revealing the stakes and admitting he has bribed one of the judges, Svetlana Petranova of Camp Arabesque. The other judges are rock legend Allegra James and Prince Reginald of Thistlebrook. Learning that one camp will be lost, the campers of both sides decide to perform together rather than compete. Allegra and the prince abstain, and Svetlana names Camp Royalty the winner, but Finn and Lady Anne overrule the result, agreeing that rock and royalty can mix, and plan to merge the camps the next summer, while Courtney and Erika form a band with their friends called Rock 'N Royals.

Kelly Sheridan voices Courtney and Svetlana, with Bethany Brown, Alessandro Juliani and Kira Tozer among the cast. The songs include "What If I Shine" and the end-credits single "Raise Our Voices". The film's British launch was accompanied by a singing competition promoted with the girl group Little Mix and Nickelodeon.

title: Devil's Gate
tagline: Every family has its secrets.
overview: Set in the small town of Devil's Gate, North Dakota, the film examines the disappearance of a local woman and her young son. Schull plays an FBI agent who helps the local sheriff search for answers. Partnering with a deputy , they track down the missing woman's husband and find that nothing is as it seems.
plot:
Devil's Gate is a 2017 American supernatural horror and science fiction film directed by Clay Staub in his feature debut, from a screenplay he wrote with Peter Aperlo. Amanda Schull stars as FBI Special Agent Daria Francis, with Shawn Ashmore as Deputy Colt Salter, Milo Ventimiglia as the farmer Jackson Pritchard, Bridget Regan as his wife Maria, Jonathan Frakes as Sheriff Gruenwell, and Javier Botet. In some territories it was released as Abduction.

In the small farming town of Devil's Gate, North Dakota, Daria arrives to investigate the disappearance of Maria Pritchard and her young son Jonah. The sheriff wants her to leave Jackson, the boy's ill-tempered and devout father, alone, but she enlists the friendly Colt, and after Maria's sister and mother describe Jackson's worsening temper and Jonah's sketchbook turns up full of disturbing drawings, the pair drive out to the remote Pritchard farm. They find it newly booby-trapped, with a stranded motorist's car outside and Maria's car hidden in the barn. After a standoff, Daria handcuffs Jackson, then discovers what he is keeping in his cellar: a strange humanoid creature locked in a cage. Jackson insists it is a demon like those that took his family, and that he means to trade it for them.

Their phones and car die, and an unnatural lightning storm forces them back into the house. Maria reappears and accuses Jackson of giving Jonah to the beings, whom he had prayed to as angels when the boy fell ill. Daria comes to realize that the visitors are aliens who are colonizing Earth because their own world is dying, replacing people with copies, and that Jackson himself has been replaced. Jonah is the first naturally born human-alien hybrid. One of the beings kills Colt, and when Jonah is returned in a flash of light, Jackson prepares to shoot him, only for Maria to kill Jackson first. The authorities insist on a story that leaves out the aliens, and some time later Jonah shows his mother a hidden collection of the discs used to summon the beings, telling her that it is time for the harvest.

The film premiered at the Tribeca Film Festival on 24 April 2017 and was released by IFC Midnight in January 2018. Reviews were mostly negative, with a 38% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Critics noted competent effects and photography, and The Village Voice called Staub a formidable director of action, but most found the dialogue weak and the story derivative.

title: Born in China
overview: Venturing into the wilds of China, "Born in China" captures intimate moments with a panda bear and her growing cub, a young golden monkey who feels displaced by his baby sister, and a mother snow leopard struggling to raise her two cubs.
plot:
Born in China is a 2016 documentary film by Disneynature that explores the natural world and the human relationship with it. The movie delves into the lives of giant pandas, golden monkeys, and other incredible creatures found in China's wilderness.

At its core, Born in China is a film about conservation and the importance of preserving our planet's biodiversity. It highlights the efforts of Chinese conservationists who work tirelessly to protect endangered species and their habitats. The documentary also sheds light on the impact of human activities on the environment, such as deforestation and pollution, which threaten the very existence of these magnificent creatures.

One of the main themes of Born in China is the concept of balance and harmony between humans and nature. The film shows how the pandas and other animals have adapted to their environments over time, and how they coexist with each other in a delicate ecosystem. This theme is beautifully illustrated through stunning footage of the pandas' daily lives, from foraging for food to interacting with each other.

The movie also explores the idea of identity and belonging. The giant pandas, in particular, are an iconic symbol of China's natural heritage, and their story serves as a metaphor for the country's own journey towards conservation and sustainability. Through the eyes of these incredible animals, we see the beauty and wonder of China's wilderness, and the importance of preserving it for future generations.

Overall, Born in China is a powerful and visually stunning film that inspires us to care about the natural world and our place within it.

title: Riley's First Date?
overview: Riley, now 12, who is hanging out with her parents at home when potential trouble comes knocking. Mom's and Dad's Emotions find themselves forced to deal with Riley going on her first "date."

Riley struggles to adjust to her new life in San Francisco, feeling homesick for her old home in Minnesota. However, she eventually finds solace in a small café where she meets a friendly waitress named Emma, who becomes a source of comfort and support.

The film also explores the theme of friendship and connection. Through Riley's interactions with Emma, we see how important it is to form connections with others when we're feeling lost or uncertain about our surroundings. The movie shows that even in unfamiliar places, there are people who can provide us with a sense of belonging and comfort.

Additionally, the film touches on the theme of nostalgia and the importance of holding onto memories of the past. Riley's love for her old home and family is evident throughout the story, and we see how she tries to hold onto these memories as she navigates her new life in San Francisco.

Overall, Riley's First Date is a heartwarming and relatable film that explores themes of change, friendship, and nostalgia in a way that will resonate with audiences of all ages.

title: Siren
tagline: No Man Can Resist Her. All Men Should.
overview: A bachelor party becomes a savage fight for survival when the groomsmen unwittingly unleash a fabled predator upon the festivities.
plot:
Siren (stylized as SiREN) is a 2016 American supernatural horror film directed by Gregg Bishop and written by Ben Collins and Luke Piotrowski. The first spin-off of the V/H/S anthology franchise, it is a feature-length expansion of "Amateur Night," David Bruckner's segment from V/H/S (2012), with Hannah Fierman reprising her role as the creature Lily. Chase Williamson stars as Jonah, with Justin Welborn, Michael Aaron Milligan and Hayes Mercure. Unlike its predecessor, the film is told in a conventional narrative style rather than as found footage. It received a limited theatrical release on 2 December 2016.

The film opens years in the past, as a mystic and a sheriff investigate a séance in a church that has ended in the deaths of everyone present. The creature summoned during the ritual, which takes the form of a young girl, kills the sheriff, and the mystic places a shackle around her ankle to control her.

In the present, Jonah is about to get married, and his brother Mac and friends Rand and Elliot take him out for his bachelor party. Disappointed by a seedy strip club, they are approached by a stranger who leads them to a secret underground club in the countryside. Its owner, the charismatic Mr. Nyx, turns out to be the mystic from the prologue. When Jonah asks for an experience that will not compromise his loyalty to his fiancée, Nyx sends him to a private room where a captive young woman, Lily, sings to him from behind glass. Her song puts him into a trance in which he relives every sexual experience of his life. Believing she is a trafficking victim, Jonah and his friends help her escape, only to discover that she is the monstrous creature from the opening scene. Lily, who has formed a dangerous fixation on Jonah, follows him through the night, killing anyone who stands in her way, while Nyx and his men pursue the group to reclaim his prized possession.

Siren received mixed reviews, with a 65 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 54. Noel Murray of the Los Angeles Times called it, for the most part, a clever and confident expansion of a terrific short that stings less but still packs plenty of poison, while other critics found it less effective than Bruckner's original segment.

title: The Star
overview: A small but brave donkey and his animal friends become the unsung heroes of the greatest story ever told, the first Christmas.
plot:
The Star, also known as The Star: The Story of the First Christmas, is a 2017 American animated comedy retelling the Nativity of Jesus from the perspective of the animals, directed by Timothy Reckart and written by Carlos Kotkin from a story by Kotkin and Simon Moore. It features the voices of Steven Yeun, Gina Rodriguez, Zachary Levi, Keegan-Michael Key, Aidy Bryant, Kelly Clarkson, Kristin Chenoweth, Tracy Morgan, Tyler Perry and Oprah Winfrey. It was produced by Sony Pictures Animation and released by Sony Pictures Releasing on November 17, 2017.

In Nazareth, Mary is visited by an angel who tells her she will bear the Messiah, as a new star begins to glow in the sky. Six months later, a young donkey tired of turning a mill wheel dreams of joining a royal caravan and feeling important. Helped by an older donkey, he escapes from his owner, a miller, and, injured, takes refuge at the home of the newlywed Mary and Joseph. Mary names him Boaz, or Bo, and nurses him, while Joseph comes to accept her pregnancy after a vision of his own. Bo and his friend Dave, a wisecracking dove, plan to slip away, but Mary's kindness keeps them there for months.

Meanwhile, the three wise men arrive at the palace of King Herod with their talkative camels, Felix, Cyrus and Deborah. On learning that their gifts are for a newborn king, Herod sends a brutal hunter and his two fearsome dogs, Thaddeus and Rufus, to find and kill the child. When Mary and Joseph set out for Bethlehem for the census, Bo realizes that they are in danger and sets out with Dave to warn them, joined by Ruth, a cheerful sheep who left her flock to follow the star. After a chaotic marketplace chase, Joseph, unaware of the threat, sends Bo away. Bo finds the royal caravan but realizes Mary matters more and returns.

In Bethlehem, where there is no room at the inn, the miller recaptures Bo and ties him in a stable, where the star's light has been shining onto the manger for months. Realizing that this is where the baby is meant to be born, they help Bo escape. He brings Mary and Joseph to the stable, while his friends rally the camels and Ruth's flock to defeat the hunter, who falls to his death. Jesus is born, the shepherds and wise men arrive, and Joseph buys Bo from the miller.

The Star grossed about $63 million worldwide against a $20 million budget. Reviews were mixed, though audiences gave it an "A" CinemaScore. Mariah Carey's song "The Star" was nominated for a Golden Globe for Best Original Song.

title: Why Him?
tagline: Of all the guys his daughter could have chosen...
overview: A dad forms a bitter rivalry with his daughter's young rich boyfriend.
plot:
Why Him? is a 2016 American comedy film directed by John Hamburg and written by Hamburg and Dan Sterling. The movie stars James Franco, Bryan Cranston, Megan Mullally, and Zoey Deutch.

The story revolves around Ned Fleming (Bryan Cranston), a software engineer who lives in San Francisco with his wife Barb (Megan Mullally) and their teenage daughter Mary (Zoey Deutch). Ned is a loving but awkward father who wants to give his daughter the best life possible. He's recently been laid off from his job, which has left him feeling anxious about providing for his family.

One day, Ned discovers that Barb has been secretly dating Laird Mayhew (James Franco), a wealthy tech entrepreneur who owns a popular social media platform called "Laird & Taylor." Overall, Why Him? is a funny and entertaining movie that explores the complexities of modern family life. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, it's a great choice for fans of comedy and satire.

title: Lumberjack Man
tagline: Welcome to Summer Camp.
overview: As the staff of Good Friends Church Camp prepares for a spring break filled with "Fun Under the Son", a demon logger rises from his sap boiler to wreak his vengeance and feast on flapjacks soaked in the blood of his victims.
plot:
Lumberjack Man is a 2015 American comedy slasher film written and directed by Josh Bear. Michael Madsen stars as Dr. Peter Shirtcliff, with Ciara Flynn, Jarrett King, Brina Palencia and Alex Dobrenko among the cast. The film was part of After Dark Films' 2015 "8 Films to Die For" lineup, a series of low-budget genre releases.

Teenagers and staff arrive for their annual retreat at the Good Friends Church Camp, unaware that a monstrous threat has awakened nearby. In an abandoned log cabin close to the campgrounds, an undead lumberjack rises from the grave. Armed with axes, a saw and a rolling griddle loaded with giant flapjacks, he begins stalking the campers, killing them and using their blood as syrup for his pancakes. Shirtcliff, an eccentric expert, tries to warn the head park ranger, LuAnn Potts, of the danger, but she dismisses his story as absurd, especially when he links it to the history of an award-winning instant pancake brand created by a man named J.T. Jeppson. As Shirtcliff heads to the camp to save the young people, LuAnn begins examining old newspaper clippings and police reports and starts to believe something is wrong. The killer attacks her, but retreats when she throws syrup at him.

At the camp, the campers and counselors are killed one by one around the mess hall until only a few remain, including Faith, Reggie and the cook, while a cowardly counselor who abandons the others meets a gruesome end. Shirtcliff arrives and reveals the true story behind the creature and the Jeppson pancake fortune. In 1892, Jeppson, while hunting in the woods, was lured by a delicious aroma to the cabin of Nehemiah Easterday, a reclusive man who each year, on the day before Lent, cooked his family's secret pancake recipe. The secret of what happened between the two men explains the origin of the Lumberjack Man and his murderous appetite, and the survivors must find a way to stop him.

The film received generally poor reviews. Ari Drew of Dread Central gave it three stars, finding it fun but lacking in writing and technical polish, while a writer for Slasher.Club called it a nonsensical, ultimately bad film whose occasional charm was undone by terrible characters. Its gleefully silly premise nonetheless gave it some appeal among fans of comedic horror.

title: Digimon Adventure tri. Part 1: Reunion
original_title: デジモンアドベンチャー tri. 第１章「再会」
overview: After years of inactivity, the DigiDestined regroup with their Digimon to save their world, but have the years changed their characters too much?
plot:
Digimon Adventure tri. Part 1: Reunion (Japanese: Saikai) is a 2015 Japanese animated adventure film produced by Toei Animation, the first of six films in the Digimon Adventure tri. series created to celebrate the fifteenth anniversary of the Digimon franchise. Directed by Keitaro Motonaga from a screenplay by Yūko Kakihara, with character designs by Atsuya Uki, it serves as a direct sequel to the television series Digimon Adventure and Digimon Adventure 02 and follows the original eight DigiDestined during their high school years. The project was announced in 2014 as a television series and was reconceived in May 2015 as a theatrical film series.

Set in 2005, six years after the first adventure, the film finds Tai Kamiya restless and without direction: his friends have drifted apart, he cannot gather them for one of his soccer games, and he has no plans for the future. When a Kuwagamon tears through Odaiba, Tai races to the scene, and Agumon arrives to digivolve and fight back as the battle spreads to the airport. Watching the destruction and the injured bystanders, Tai is shaken by the realization that the DigiDestined's battles cause real harm. A new connection to the Digital World is letting through infected Digimon more powerful than before, and the children of the second series appear to have been overwhelmed. Supported by a government task force aided by Gennai, the group reunites, including Mimi, who returns from America, but Tai clashes with Matt, who insists that only they can protect people. When the Royal Knight Alphamon attacks, apparently hunting a mysterious new DigiDestined named Meiko Mochizuki and her partner Meicoomon, Matt pulls Tai out of his paralysis and their partners combine into Omnimon, yet Tai hesitates at the decisive moment and Alphamon escapes, while the enigmatic Hackmon watches from the shadows.

Reunion opened in Japanese theaters on 21 November 2015 in a limited release, and was simulcast outside Japan by Crunchyroll in episodic form on the same day. It grossed about ¥230 million in Japan. An English dub distributed by Eleven Arts premiered at a Fathom Events screening in North America on 15 September 2016. Den of Geek's Shamus Kelley called it a model for how continuations of famous franchises should be made, praising its faithful characters and Tai's arc about responsibility, though he wished the female characters had more to do.

title: Harmony
tagline: This is the way the world ends...
overview: Set in a future world. Japan has created a great medical technology that controls ethics, health, and social interaction to create a perfect world. Three young girls attempt to stand up to this by committing suicide, but it doesn't work. Years later, Tuan, one of the girls who attempted suicide must prevent a crisis that threatens this "perfect" world.
plot:
Harmony is a 2015 Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Michael Arias and Takashi Nakamura and produced by Studio 4°C, with a screenplay by Kōji Yamamoto. It is based on the novel of the same name by Project Itoh and was the second of three anime features adapted from his novels, following The Empire of Corpses and preceding Genocidal Organ. Miyuki Sawashiro voices the protagonist, Tuan Kirie, and Reina Ueda voices her friend Miach Mihie.

In the future, after a nuclear cataclysm called the Maelstrom and the civil wars that followed nearly wiped out humanity, a seeming utopia has been established. Across national borders, society is overseen by the Admedistration, and citizens' bodies are monitored by WatchMe medical nanotechnology, all devoted to preventing disease and extending life. Crime and illness have largely vanished, and people live under a powerful ethic of welfare and mutual consideration. As teenagers in Japan, Tuan, Miach and their friend Cian Reikado reject this order, which they feel smothers them with kindness and denies any real autonomy, and attempt suicide together, committing the crime of rejecting life itself. Miach, the fiercest critic of the system, apparently dies, while Tuan and Cian are saved at the last moment.

Thirteen years later, Tuan works as a senior inspector for the World Health Organization, investigating illegal gene therapy around the world while still holding on to her old ideals and taking pleasure in mistreating her own body. When she meets Cian again and they recall their pact and the loss of Miach, a wave of murders and suicides suddenly breaks out, apparently driven through the very networks meant to protect people. Tuan's investigation leads her to follow the clues left by her old friend, and she must uncover the truth behind the supposedly perfect world and the meaning of the word harmony, then decide what kind of world she wants to create.

The film was released in Japan on November 13, 2015, taking over the date originally set for Genocidal Organ, which had been delayed. Funimation licensed it and gave it a two-day theatrical engagement in the United States on May 17 and 18, 2016. A four-volume manga adaptation by Fumi Minato ran in Newtype from 2015 to 2019. Critics praised its contemplative passages and minimalist sound design but faulted the stilted, monologue-heavy script and plain visuals; Anime News Network's Nick Creamer called it talk-heavy and visually uninspired.

Through Koyomi's interactions with various characters, including Miki Saeki and Shinobu Oshino, the movie illustrates the complexities of human connection and the ways in which it can shape our understanding of ourselves.

Ultimately, Kizumonogatari Part 1: Tekketsu is a film that defies easy categorization, instead embracing its own ambiguity and complexity. It invites viewers to ponder the nature of reality, identity, and relationships, leaving a lasting impression long after the credits roll.

title: Mr. Six
overview: Many years ago Mr. Six was a notorious gangster. That was back when there was still such a thing as honour among thieves, when criminals earned respect and maintained principles. The movie highlights the importance of human connections and the need for people to find support and belonging in their lives.

Furthermore, Mr. Six touches on the theme of morality and the consequences of one's actions. The protagonist is forced to confront the harm he has caused in the past and grapple with the idea that his violent lifestyle may not be as glamorous or exciting as he once thought. This introspection serves as a catalyst for his growth and transformation, as he begins to question the values and principles that have guided him throughout his life.

Overall, Mr. Six is a nuanced exploration of the human condition, delving into themes that are both universally relatable and uniquely Chinese in context.

title: Even Lambs Have Teeth
tagline: Revenge can be a bitch.
overview: Two young women terrorized by a group of small town psychos seek revenge on their tormentors.
plot:
Even Lambs Have Teeth is a Canadian-French rape-and-revenge thriller of 2015 written and directed by Terry Miles. It stars Kirsten Prout as Sloan and Tiera Skovbye as Katie, two young women who strike back at the trafficking ring that abducted them, with Garrett Black, Jameson Parker, Darren Mann, Michael Karl Richards, Patrick Gilmore as Boris and Craig March as the local sheriff.

Fresh out of college, Katie and Sloan plan to spend a month working on a rural organic farm before a trip to New York City. Katie's uncle, an FBI agent, sees them off at the bus station and asks for a coded text message each day to prove they are safe. While they wait, two charming young men, Lucas and Jed, offer them a lift to the farm; Sloan talks a reluctant Katie into accepting. Instead the boys detour to Jed's family home, where their mother serves the girls drugged food. They wake in their underwear, chained inside storage containers in the woods, prisoners of a sex-exploitation ring run by Boris, and are assaulted by the sheriff and other local men. Boris uses Katie's phone to send a reassuring message, unaware that the code must change daily.

Sensing that something is wrong, the uncle drives to the town. The sheriff tries to calm him and then warns Boris, who orders Jed to get rid of the girls. A restaurant worker, however, remembers seeing them leave in a blue truck, and the uncle traces it to Boris. Meanwhile Katie kills one of their abusers by biting into his throat, takes his keys and frees Sloan, and the pair escape in the sheriff's own patrol car. After arming themselves at a hardware store, they ambush Boris at home, force him to name his accomplices and kill him, then hunt down the rest of the ring one by one in increasingly inventive ways. Later, as the friends finally leave for New York, the uncle assures Katie's mother that they will be fine, while at the airport a stranger with an organic-farm sign greets a new pair of young travellers.

The film premiered at the Mile High Horror Film Festival in October 2015 and was later released on DVD and on demand. Bloody Disgusting's Patrick Cooper praised its balance of human horror, dark comedy and violent revenge.

title: Marauders
tagline: The rich will pay
overview: An untraceable group of elite bank robbers is chased by a suicidal FBI agent who uncovers a deeper purpose behind the robbery-homicides.
plot:
Marauders is a 2016 American crime thriller directed by Steven C. Miller and written by Michael Cody and Chris Sivertson. Christopher Meloni stars as an FBI agent investigating a string of violent bank robberies that appear aimed squarely at a ruthless banking executive played by Bruce Willis, with Dave Bautista and Adrian Grenier co-starring.

In Cincinnati, four masked men take $3 million from a branch of Hubert National Bank, and their leader executes the manager, Steven Hutchinson. FBI Special Agent Jonathan Montgomery leads a joint investigation with the city police, and a fingerprint at the scene belongs to TJ Jackson, an Army Ranger officially killed in 2011 when his unit supposedly went rogue and kidnapped Alexander Hubert for ransom, leaving his brother Jeffrey sole heir to Hubert International. The stolen cash turns up donated to a city mission. A second raid empties safe deposit boxes belonging to Hubert and Ohio Senator Cook, and David Dagley, a member of Hubert's security team and the Rangers' former commanding officer, is lured to the bank and stabbed to death. Evidence of a secret affair between Hubert and Cook reaches Montgomery as the robbers push him toward Hubert's corruption. During a third, bloody heist at the main branch one robber is killed. A stolen file then exposes the truth: Hubert and Cook had fed the Rangers false intelligence about a terrorist threat in Costa Rica so that Alexander would die, and a Special Forces team, unaware of the deception, wiped out the unit. TJ survived thanks to Wells, then a Special Forces sniper. As Hubert's assets are frozen and he prepares to flee, TJ is arrested, and Montgomery's colleague, FBI Special Agent Wells, is revealed as the robbers' leader, avenging the massacre alongside other veterans of the attack. Detective Mims, consumed by guilt and facing his wife's terminal cancer, tracks Wells down and begs to return the money, and Wells kills him. Later, in Tijuana, Montgomery finds Wells about to kill Hubert and stabs Hubert himself, letting Wells go.

Meloni plays Montgomery, with Willis as Hubert, Bautista as FBI agent Stockwell, Grenier as Wells, Texas Battle as TJ and Johnathon Schaech as Mims. Financed by Emmett/Furla/Oasis Films, it was shot in Cincinnati from September to October 2015, and Lionsgate Premiere released it on July 1, 2016. Reviews were poor, with 22% on Rotten Tomatoes; critics called it a by-the-numbers B-movie with a convoluted plot and a rote performance from Willis.

title: Ford v Ferrari

overview: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for Ford Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.
plot:
Ford v Ferrari is a biographical sports drama film directed by James Mangold, released in 2019 by 20th Century Fox. The movie tells the story of the rivalry between car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles, who join forces to take down the dominant Ferrari team at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The film begins with a young Carroll Shelby (played by Christian Bale), an American racing driver who returns from World War II as a paraplegic. Despite his physical limitations, Shelby is determined to return to racing and becomes involved in the development of the Ford GT40, a car designed to challenge Ferrari's dominance at Le Mans.

Shelby meets Ken Miles (played by Matt Damon), an Australian-born driver who has been hired by Ford to compete against Ferrari. Miles is initially hesitant to join forces with Shelby, but eventually warms up to his unorthodox methods and the two form a strong partnership.

As the story unfolds, we see the development of the GT40, which becomes a symbol of American ingenuity and determination. The film also explores the personal struggles of both Shelby and Miles, including their relationships with their families and their own demons.

The plot thickens as the 24 Hours of Le Mans approaches, and Shelby and Miles prepare to take on Ferrari's dominant team led by Enzo Ferrari (played by Remo Girone). The tension builds as the two teams engage in a series of intense racing battles, both on and off the track.

In the climactic final act, Shelby and Miles face off against Ferrari at Le Mans, with the GT40 emerging victorious. However, the victory is bittersweet, as Shelby's health begins to decline, and he must come to terms with his own mortality.

The film ends with a poignant moment of reflection, as Shelby looks back on his life and the legacy of the GT40. The final shot is of the GT40 crossing the finish line at Le Mans, a testament to the power of determination and innovation.

Throughout the film, Mangold pays tribute to the real-life events that inspired the story, including the rivalry between Ford and Ferrari in the 1960s. The film features stunning racing sequences, impressive car designs, and outstanding performances from the cast.

Overall, Ford v Ferrari is a thrilling and emotionally resonant film that celebrates the spirit of American ingenuity and determination. With its strong performances, impressive car designs, and gripping storyline, it's no wonder that the film received widespread critical acclaim and earned several awards and nominations.

Overall, Maudie is a heartwarming and inspiring film that celebrates the power of art, love, and human connection to overcome even the most daunting challenges.

title: Blackway
tagline: Sometimes revenge is the only answer.
overview: A young woman newly returned to her hometown becomes the subject of harassment by a man named Blackway, an ex-cop turned violent crime lord who operates with impunity in this small community on the edge of the wilderness. Forsaken by the local townspeople—and advised by the Sheriff to leave town—Lillian decides instead to take a stand against her sociopathic stalker, and enlists the help of ex-logger Lester and his laconic young sidekick.
plot:
Blackway, known on the festival circuit as Go with Me, is a 2015 thriller directed by Swedish filmmaker Daniel Alfredson and written by Joseph Gangemi and Gregory Jacobs, based on Castle Freeman Jr.'s 2008 novel Go with Me. Julia Stiles stars as Lillian, with Anthony Hopkins as the elderly logger Lester, Alexander Ludwig as his young protégé Nate, Ray Liotta as the menacing Blackway and Hal Holbrook. Filmed in Canada in 2014, it premiered at the Venice Film Festival in September 2015 and was released theatrically in June 2016. It was Holbrook's final film appearance.

In a logging community in the Pacific Northwest, Lillian, a young woman recently returned to her hometown, is being terrorized by Blackway, a former deputy sheriff who now controls the local criminal underworld. After finding her cat decapitated, she goes to the sheriff, who tells her to leave town and suggests she talk to a man named Scotty. When she goes looking for him at a timber mill, he is away, and the mill's elderly owner and workers also advise her to get out. The owner jokingly offers a week's pay and funeral expenses to anyone willing to help her, and to everyone's surprise, an old man, Lester, agrees. His young protégé, Nate, a strong but quiet mill worker, comes along.

Lillian, Lester and Nate drive around the area searching for Blackway, visiting the places he frequents. Through conversations and flashbacks, it becomes clear how deeply Blackway has scarred the lives of all three and of many other townspeople; he is universally hated yet feared, and no one has dared to stand up to him. As the day goes on, the confrontation escalates. The trio fight with Blackway's men, cripple his associate Murdoch, destroy a building and steal weapons, provoking Blackway to come after them. As night falls, they wait for him at a remote abandoned logging camp that holds significance for both Lester and Blackway, where Lester prepares for a final reckoning and the three must decide how far they are willing to go to end Blackway's reign of fear.

Blackway received poor reviews. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 20 percent rating based on five reviews, and Guy Lodge of Variety called it a turgid, tension-free revenge thriller. Some critics nonetheless appreciated the atmospheric setting and Hopkins's understated performance.

original_title: The Lion Guard: Return of the Roar
tagline: A new hero finds his roar!
overview: Set in the African savannah, the film follows Kion as he assembles the members of the 'Lion Guard'. Throughout the film, the diverse team of young animals will learn how to utilize each of their unique abilities to solve problems and accomplish tasks to maintain balance within the Circle of Life, while also introducing viewers to the vast array of animals that populate the prodigious African landscape.
plot:
The Lion Guard: Return of the Roar is a 2015 American animated television film produced by Disney Television Animation, with animation services from Mercury Filmworks, which serves as the pilot for the series The Lion Guard. Directed by Howy Parkins and written by Ford Riley, who developed the series, it continues the story of Disney's 1994 film The Lion King and is set during the time span of The Lion King II: Simba's Pride. It premiered on Disney Channel in the United States and Canada on 22 November 2015, ahead of the series launch in January 2016, and was released on DVD in February 2016.

The film centres on Kion (Max Charles), the fun-loving younger son of King Simba (Rob Lowe) and Queen Nala (Gabrielle Union), who is happy that his sister Kiara (Eden Riegel) is the one destined to rule. While chasing a ball into the forbidden Outlands with his friend Bunga, a fearless honey badger (Joshua Rush), Kion lets loose a tremendous roar that drives off the hyenas of Janja's clan. Simba and Rafiki reveal that this is the Roar of the Elders, a power once held by Simba's uncle Scar, who lost it by using it for evil and destroying his Lion Guard. As the second-born, Kion must now lead a new Guard of the fiercest, bravest, fastest, strongest and keenest of sight.

Kion chooses his friends: Bunga as the bravest, the cheetah Fuli (Diamond White) as the fastest, the hippo Beshte (Dusan Brown) as the strongest and the egret Ono (Atticus Shaffer) as the keenest of sight. Simba is dismayed that his son has not picked lions, insisting the Guard is no game. Doubting himself and fearing he might turn out like Scar, Kion receives advice from the spirit of his grandfather Mufasa (James Earl Jones), who tells him to trust his instincts. Meanwhile, alerted by the vulture Mzingo, Janja plots to strike before the new Guard can form, and the hyenas start a stampede in a gazelle herd. Kion defies his father, bestows the Mark of the Guard on his friends, and leads them into battle; together they rout the hyenas, Bunga saves Kiara from a stampede, and Kion's roar drives Janja back to the Outlands, after which Simba accepts the new Lion Guard.

Ernie Sabella voices Pumbaa, alongside Kevin Schon as Timon, Jeff Bennett as Zazu and Khary Payton as Rafiki, while Sarah Hyland and Madison Pettis voice Kiara's friends Tiifu and Zuri. The film introduces the motto "Zuka Zama" as the Guard's counterpart to "Hakuna Matata".

title: Riot
tagline: Caged to kill.
overview: Copper Jack Stone purposefully orchestrates a bank robbery in order to be thrown into prison with the notorious Russian kingpin Balam. Balam is more than just a mob criminal; he's a very cunning and dangerous lord who controls the police force from behind bars. Balam lives in prison as a cover for his real power, which is King of the city. His cell is a lavish private room built specifically for him, inaccessible to most in the depths of the prison structure. Even the warden fears venturing into his area of the prison. However, even surrounded by his loyal henchmen and guards in his sectioned off fortress, Balam doesn't know Jack is coming for him to avenge his family, who Balam murdered in cold blood. Balam is tough... but Jack is tougher.
plot:
Riot is a 2015 American prison action film written and directed by John Lyde, whose earlier films included Survivor and Curse of the Dragon Slayer. Produced by Mainstay Productions and Matthew Reese Films with VMI Worldwide and distributed on home video by Universal, it stars Matthew Reese as Jack Stone, Dolph Lundgren as William, the mixed martial artist Chuck Liddell as Balam and Danielle Chuchran as Alena, with Michael Flynn, Renny Grames, Eve Mauro and Melanie Stone. The film runs 88 minutes.

Jack Stone is a good cop and family man whose wife was murdered on the orders of Balam, a cunning Russian crime lord who runs the city from behind bars and controls corrupt members of the police force. Balam lives in a lavish private cell deep inside a maximum-security prison, protected by loyal henchmen and guards, in a section of the facility that even the warden fears to enter. Determined to get close enough to take revenge, Jack deliberately gets himself convicted and sent to the same prison, through a staged bank robbery and the death of a fellow officer, one of the policemen on Balam's payroll. Once inside, he quickly runs afoul of guards who work for the kingpin, masked and armored, and of Balam's thugs, and beatings and backstabbing become a daily occurrence. His only ally is William, a seemingly slow, unassuming inmate who works as a janitor and keeps out of trouble, but who proves willing and able to watch his back. Meanwhile, in the women's wing, the tough inmate Alena keeps picking fights so that she will be sent to the infirmary, where she can slip loose to carry out a secret mission of her own, which turns out to be connected to William. The storylines converge in a violent prison riot during the final half hour, as Jack fights his way toward Balam.

Riot was released in 2015 and came out on Blu-ray and DVD by Universal in April 2016. Reviews from action-oriented outlets were moderately positive. Ian Jane of DVD Talk called it a predictable, generic but well-paced B-grade prison movie whose highlights are its plentiful, well-choreographed fights and the climactic riot, praising Reese as a credible action hero, Liddell's authentic moves despite an unconvincing Russian accent and Chuchran's physicality, while noting that Lundgren, though top billed, is underused. The Action Elite praised the physical performances of Reese and Chuchran and found Lundgren doing something different by moving into a nuanced character role.

title: Monster High: Boo York, Boo York
original_title: Monster High: Boo York, Boo York
tagline: A Monsterrific Musical!
overview: It's fright lights, big city when the Monster High ghouls head to Boo York! Cleo de Nile is invited to attend a gancy gala celebrating the return of the magical comet and, of course, she brings along her beast friends. But their trip isn't all fun and frightseeing because Nefera, Cleo's sister, uses the comet's power for her own spooktacularly sneaky plans. Can the monsters unwrap the mystery of the comet in time to stop Nefera? Find out in Booy York, Boo York, the first-ever Monster High musical, featuring eight original songs.
plot:
Monster High: Boo York, Boo York is a 2015 computer-animated musical fantasy film for children based on Mattel's Monster High doll franchise. Directed by William Lau and written by Keith Wagner, it was released on home video on September 29, 2015, and broadcast on Nickelodeon as a television special in October. It was the ninth CGI-animated film and the twelfth animated film overall in the franchise. The voice cast includes Karen Strassman as Catty Noir, Celeste Henderson as Cleo de Nile and Clawdeen Wolf, Wendee Lee as Nefera de Nile, Kate Higgins as Frankie Stein and Sue Swan as Draculaura.

Cleo de Nile's father, Ramses, invites his daughters to a glamorous gala in the city of Boo York, a monster version of New York, to celebrate the display of the Comet Crystal and the arrival of a comet from outer space. Cleo brings along her boyfriend Deuce and her classmates Frankie, Clawdeen, Draculaura, Operetta and Catty Noir, a singer who has been struggling to write a new original song. In Boo York, the friends meet a group of local talents, including the aspiring performer Luna Mothews, the robotic DJ Elle Eedee and the ballerina Mouscedes King, and also run into their rival Toralei, who has been invited by Cleo's scheming sister Nefera.

Ramses and Nefera plot to take control of Boo York by arranging a match between Cleo and Seth, the son of the gala's wealthy patron, Amuncommon Ptolemy: if the two make a promise to each other under the power of the comet, it can never be broken. Meanwhile, back at Monster High, Ghoulia discovers that the comet appears to be on a collision course with Earth and races to find a way to stop it before it destroys the world. As the night of the gala approaches, Cleo must decide between duty to her family and her own heart, while Catty searches for her voice as an artist.

The film is structured as a Broadway-style musical, with original songs performed by the characters, and its themes include friendship, self-expression and following one's dreams.

The film's soundtrack charted on Billboard's Kid Albums and Soundtracks charts. Mattel released several doll lines based on the film, and author Perdita Finn wrote a junior novelization published by Little, Brown Books for Young Readers in 2015, along with other tie-in children's books.

title: Crown for Christmas
overview: Allie Foster, a struggling New York artist, reluctantly accepts to act as a governess to a rebellious Princess Theodora of Winshire. When Allie forms an unlikely bond with the princess, she attracts the attention of the handsome King Maximillian, who’s facing an arranged marriage against his heart’s wishes. As Christmas Eve draws near, Allie finds herself swept up in romance, royalty and the spirit of the holidays.
plot:
Crown for Christmas is a 2015 American romantic comedy film directed by Michael Bregman and starring Lacey Chabert and Paul Greene.

The movie follows the story of Emma, a young woman who returns to her hometown of Willow Creek after being away for several years. She reconnects with an old friend, Jake, and they rekindle their friendship, which eventually blossoms into romance. However, their relationship is put to the test when Emma's past comes back to haunt her.

The main themes of Crown for Christmas include:

1. Second chances: The movie explores the idea of giving people second chances, whether it's in relationships or in life. Emma and Jake both have a chance to rekindle their friendship and romance, and they take it.
2. Small-town charm: The film showcases the charm and warmth of small-town Willow Creek, which serves as a backdrop for the story. The town's close-knit community and festive atmosphere add to the movie's cozy feel.
3. Family and tradition: Emma's family is an important part of her life, and she struggles with her past and present relationships. The movie highlights the importance of family traditions and the role they play in shaping our identities.
4. Self-discovery: Throughout the film, Emma learns more about herself and what she wants out of life. She discovers new passions and interests, which helps her grow as a person.

Overall, Crown for Christmas is a heartwarming romantic comedy that explores themes of love, friendship, family, and self-discovery in a charming small-town setting.

title: Invisible Sister
tagline: What you see is only half the story
overview: Teenager Cleo's school science project goes quite awry, causing her popular older sister Molly to go invisible.
plot:
Invisible Sister is a 2015 American science fiction comedy television film directed by Paul Hoen and loosely based on the book My Invisible Sister by Beatrice Colin and Sara Pinto. Rowan Blanchard stars as a brilliant but overlooked teenager and Paris Berelc as her popular older sister, with Karan Brar, Rachel Crow, Will Meyers and Alex Désert. The Disney Channel Original Movie premiered on October 9, 2015, drawing 4.03 million viewers.

Cleo Eastman, a gifted but introverted and sarcastic student in New Orleans, lives in the shadow of her older sister Molly, a lacrosse star whom everyone at school adores. Cleo's science teacher, Mr. Perkins, sets her a special challenge: to identify a mystery substance and turn it into crystals. While she works on it at home during a dinner Molly is hosting for her team, a moth distracts her and she spills extra chemicals into her mixture. The vapour turns the moth invisible, and it escapes.

That night the invisible moth flies into the bathroom light, falls into a glass of water and antacid that Molly is about to drink, and she swallows it. In the morning Molly is horrified to find that she is completely invisible. It is Halloween and the day of the season-opening lacrosse match, which college scouts will be watching, so Cleo is forced to dress in Molly's costume and impersonate her at school, while the invisible Molly steals a microscope so Cleo can investigate. Molly also secretly secures Cleo a date with Carter, the boy Cleo likes, while Cleo's friend George discovers the secret.

With Molly's help, Cleo leads the team to victory. Studying Molly's cells, Cleo and George realise that her invisibility will become permanent unless they create an antidote by midnight. Catching another moth in a cemetery, the sisters argue and then open up: Cleo admits she has always envied Molly's spark, while Molly confesses she envies Cleo's intelligence, knowing that popularity fades.

Getting into the school with help from the invisible Molly, Cleo and George repeat the experiment but need Carter's help to interpret the results, and find him at a Halloween party. Joined by Molly's boyfriend Coug, they race to produce the antidote, but it fails until Cleo adds the antacid Molly drank the night before, and Molly becomes visible again. Impressed, Mr. Perkins invites Cleo to present her findings to a scientific association, and Cleo comes to appreciate the line between being seen and unseen.

title: Adventures in Babysitting
overview: Two teen rival babysitters, Jenny and Lola, team up to hunt down one of their kids who accidentally ran away into the big city without any supervision.
plot:
Adventures in Babysitting is a 2016 American adventure comedy television film directed by John Schultz and starring Sabrina Carpenter and Sofia Carson. A remake of the 1987 film of the same name, it premiered on Disney Channel in the United States and Canada on June 24, 2016, and holds the distinction of being the 100th Disney Channel Original Movie. The supporting cast includes Nikki Hahn, Mallory James Mahoney, Max Gecowets, Jet Jurgensmeyer, Madison Horcher and Kevin Quinn.

Jenny Parker and Lola Perez are both nineteen and share a passion for photography, but their personalities are very different, and Lola is by far the more impulsive of the two. They meet as finalists for the same photography internship and accidentally swap phones at the interview. When a professor, Helen Anderson, calls Jenny's phone in search of a last-minute babysitter, Lola takes the job, and that night Jenny looks after Emily and Katy Cooper while Lola watches the three Anderson children, Trey, Bobby and AJ. After realizing they have each other's phones, Jenny sets out to find Lola, only to discover that fourteen-year-old Trey has sneaked out to a concert. The two babysitters and the remaining children head into the city to bring him back, and a stop at a shady pawn shop goes wrong when Bobby accidentally releases a rare ferret, Lola snaps a photo of the chaos, and the owners, Tiny and Scalper, who are trafficking the animal illegally, give chase to get rid of the evidence. As the night spirals out of control, the group must find the money to recover their towed car before midnight, Lola lands in a police station for scalping a concert ticket, Jenny clashes with rebellious thirteen-year-old Emily, who has secretly dyed her hair and gotten a tattoo, and young AJ meets her roller derby idol. All the while, the two sitters must get every child home before the parents return from their party, learning to rely on each other along the way, while Jenny wonders whether she has missed her chance with her crush, Zac.

Carpenter plays Jenny and Carson plays Lola, with Kevin Quinn as Zac Chase, Gillian Vigman as Helen Anderson, Gabrielle Miller as Donna Cooper, and Michael Northey and Ken Lawson as the pawn shop crooks Tiny and Scalper. Hahn and Mahoney play the Cooper sisters, while Gecowets, Jurgensmeyer and Horcher play the Anderson siblings.

title: Center of My World
overview: A strange family: 17-year-old Phil lives with his mother and twin sister in an old mansion on the outskirts of town. When he returns from summer camp, the mood in the mansion has soured somehow. Phil doesn’t worry about it, hanging out with his best friend Kat instead. When he starts to feel attracted to a mysterious new student at school, Phil is plunged into emotional turmoil only exacerbated by the trouble at home.
plot:
Center of My World is a 2016 German science fiction film directed by Jakob Lass. The movie tells the story of a young boy named Anderz, who lives in a remote village on the edge of a vast desert with his father. When Anderz's mother passes away, he embarks on an extraordinary journey to find her spirit and ultimately discovers a magical portal that transports him to another world.

The main theme of Center of My World revolves around the idea of identity and self-discovery. As Anderz navigates this new world, he encounters various characters who challenge his perceptions of himself and the world around him. Through his experiences, Anderz learns to let go of his past and find a sense of belonging in this new reality.

The film also explores the concept of isolation and loneliness. Anderz's journey is marked by his separation from his father and his struggle to connect with others in this new world. However, as he forms connections with the people he meets, he begins to realize that even in solitude, there is always the possibility for human connection and understanding.

Furthermore, Center of My World touches on the idea of growing up and coming of age. Anderz's experiences serve as a metaphor for the challenges and uncertainties of adolescence, where one must navigate the complexities of relationships, identity, and belonging.

Overall, the movie presents a poignant and thought-provoking exploration of the human experience, delving into themes that are both universally relatable and deeply personal.

title: Hidden
tagline: Fear will find you.
overview: A family takes refuge in a fallout shelter to avoid a dangerous outbreak.
plot:
Hidden is a 2015 American psychological thriller written and directed by Matt and Ross Duffer, known as the Duffer Brothers, in their feature film debut. It stars Alexander Skarsgård as Ray, Andrea Riseborough as Claire and Emily Alyn Lind as their daughter Zoe. The film follows a family struggling to survive in hiding after a mysterious outbreak, and it was the last film of producer Richard D. Zanuck, who died before filming began.

An unknown outbreak has devastated the United States. Ray, Claire and their young daughter Zoe have taken refuge in an abandoned fallout shelter after the military began bombing the civilian population of their town. They have lived underground for many months, surviving on dwindling supplies and following strict rules: stay calm, stay quiet and never go outside. Above them roam creatures Zoe calls the Breathers, who have been hunting the family and have nearly found them several times. Ray and Claire's single priority is keeping Zoe alive, whatever happens to them.

The family's fragile routine is disturbed when they discover that a rat has been eating their food and has found a way into the shelter through a small air duct. While trying to catch it, Ray accidentally knocks over a lamp and starts a fire. Although they put it out, the smoke drifts up the duct and leaves ash on the hatch, potentially revealing their hiding place. When Claire and Ray go to the surface to conceal the shelter, Zoe spots a figure through her homemade periscope and breaks the rules to warn them. A Breather follows them back, and the family must find a way to survive the siege. Flashbacks to the beginning of the outbreak gradually reveal how the family came to be in the shelter and the truth about the Breathers.

The film relies on a single claustrophobic location and slowly building tension, ending with a twist that recontextualizes the story.

Hidden was written shortly after the Duffers graduated from Chapman University and acquired by Warner Bros. in 2011, but it received only a limited release in September 2015, shortly before the brothers created the series Stranger Things. It received generally positive reviews from the few critics who saw it, with 83 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Dangal
overview: Dangal is an extraordinary true story based on the life of Mahavir Singh and his two daughters, Geeta and Babita Phogat. The film traces the inspirational journey of a father who trains his daughters to become world class wrestlers.
plot:
Dangal (transl. 'Wrestling Bout') is a 2016 Indian Hindi-language biographical sports drama directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Aamir Khan, Kiran Rao and Siddharth Roy Kapur under Aamir Khan Productions and The Walt Disney Company India. Khan stars as Mahavir Singh Phogat, an amateur wrestler who trained his daughters Geeta Phogat and Babita Kumari to become India's first world-class female wrestlers. Fatima Sana Shaikh and Sanya Malhotra play the adult sisters, Zaira Wasim and Suhani Bhatnagar their younger selves, Sakshi Tanwar their mother, and Aparshakti Khurana their cousin Omkar, who narrates the story.

Mahavir, a former national champion in the traditional pehlwani style from a village in Haryana, gave up wrestling under family pressure to take a steady job, leaving him with the regret of never winning an international medal for India. He hopes a son will fulfil his dream, but when his wife gives birth only to daughters he resigns himself to disappointment. His view changes when his eldest daughters, Geeta and Babita, beat up two boys who insulted them, revealing their natural strength.

Mahavir begins training the girls with fierce discipline: early-morning runs, strict diets, cropped hair and wrestling bouts against boys in local tournaments, defying the mockery of villagers who believe wrestling is not for women. Lacking proper facilities, he improvises with mattresses in place of mats and teaches them freestyle technique. The sisters resent his harshness at first but come to appreciate the opportunity he is giving them. Geeta wins state and national titles and joins the National Sports Academy in Patiala, where a new coach's methods and her taste of independence create a painful rift with her father. The story builds to Geeta's campaign at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi, where she aims to become the first Indian woman to win gold in wrestling.

Dangal received widespread critical acclaim for its story, direction and performances, particularly Khan's physical transformation, and for its message on gender equality. It became the highest-grossing Indian film of all time, earning over ₹2,000 crore worldwide, helped by an enormous success in China. It won the Filmfare Award for Best Film, and Wasim won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actress.

title: The Grinch
tagline: Scheme big.
overview: The Grinch hatches a scheme to ruin Christmas when the residents of Whoville plan their annual holiday celebration.
plot:
The Grinch is a 2018 American animated musical comedy film directed by Scott Mosier and Yarrow Cheney, and produced by Illumination Entertainment and Universal Pictures.

The story takes place in Whoville, where the residents are preparing for Christmas. The main character, the Grinch (voiced by Benedict Cumberbatch), lives on Mount Crumpit with his dog Max. He despises the cheerful Whos and their love for Christmas, which he believes is a noisy and chaotic holiday.

The Grinch decides to take matters into his own hands and steal Christmas from the Whos. He disguises himself as Santa Claus and sets out to sabotage the holiday by stealing all the decorations, gifts, and food. However, as he observes the Whos' kindness and generosity towards each other despite their poverty, he begins to feel a change of heart.

The Grinch's plan is foiled when Max, who has been watching over him from afar, reveals his true identity. The Grinch is forced to confront the true meaning of Christmas, which is not about material possessions or noise, but about kindness, love, and community.

As the story unfolds, the Grinch begins to see the Whos in a new light and starts to appreciate their joy and generosity. He returns all the stolen items and joins the Whos for Christmas dinner, where he is welcomed with open arms.

The film features a star-studded voice cast, including Cameron Seely as Cindy Lou Who, John Legend as Mayor Augustus Maywho, and Pharrell Williams as the narrator. The movie's soundtrack includes original songs by Pharrell Williams, Benj Pasek, and Justin Paul.

Overall, The Grinch is a heartwarming story about the importance of kindness, generosity, and community during the holiday season. It features stunning animation, catchy music, and a talented voice cast that brings the beloved characters to life.

title: Navy Seals vs. Zombies
overview: A team of highly skilled Navy SEALS find themselves embarking on the battle of their lives when they come face-to-face with the undead. After a deadly outbreak occurs in New Orleans, the SEALS must fight for their lives, and the city, against an army of zombies.
plot:
Navy Seals vs. Zombies is an action-comedy film that combines elements of horror and military action. The movie follows a team of Navy SEALs as they battle against a zombie outbreak in the Middle East.

At its core, the film explores themes of camaraderie, sacrifice, and the human cost of war. As the Navy SEALs fight to survive against the undead hordes, they are also forced to confront their own personal demons and make difficult choices that test their bonds with each other. The movie highlights the strong relationships between the characters, particularly the banter and trust that develops among them as they work together to overcome seemingly insurmountable odds.

The film also touches on the idea of the "other," using the zombies as a metaphor for the unknown or the enemy. As the Navy SEALs navigate this new and terrifying threat, they are forced to confront their own biases and assumptions about what it means to be human. The movie suggests that even in the face of unimaginable horror, humanity can persevere and find ways to connect with each other.

Furthermore, the film critiques the notion of war as a solution to problems, highlighting the devastating consequences of military action on civilians and the environment. The zombies serve as a symbol for the chaos and destruction that can result from conflict, and the Navy SEALs' efforts to contain the outbreak serve as a commentary on the futility of trying to control or eradicate something that is inherently unpredictable.

Overall, Navy Seals vs. Zombies is a tongue-in-cheek sendup of military action movies, using humor and satire to explore deeper themes about humanity, camaraderie, and the consequences of war.

title: Suspiria
tagline: Give your soul to the dance.
overview: Young American dancer Susie Bannion arrives in 1970s Berlin to audition for the world-renowned Helena Markos Dance Company. When she vaults to the role of lead dancer, the woman she replaces breaks down and accuses the company's female directors of witchcraft. Meanwhile, an inquisitive psychotherapist and a member of the troupe uncover dark and sinister secrets as they probe the depths of the studio's hidden underground chambers.
plot:
Suspiria is a 2018 supernatural horror film directed by Luca Guadagnino from a screenplay by David Kajganich, inspired by Dario Argento's 1977 film of the same name. Guadagnino, who had acquired the rights from Argento and Daria Nicolodi, called it an homage rather than a straight remake, and Kajganich set it during West Germany's "German Autumn" of 1977 to explore inherited guilt, motherhood and power among women. Radiohead's Thom Yorke composed the score. The film premiered at the Venice International Film Festival on September 1, 2018, and Amazon Studios opened it in Los Angeles and New York on October 26.

Susie Bannion, an American raised in a Mennonite family in Ohio, joins the Markos Dance Academy in West Berlin just after student Patricia Hingle vanishes, having told her psychotherapist, Josef Klemperer, that the school is run by witches. When the Soviet student Olga storms out of rehearsal, she is trapped in a mirrored room, and Susie's ferocious dance for Madame Blanc mangles Olga's body, which the matrons drag away. The matrons secretly vote to keep the ancient, disfigured Mother Markos as their leader over Blanc. Susie rises quickly to become Blanc's protégée and the lead in the company's piece Volk, while her friend Sara, prompted by Klemperer, finds hidden passages and the withered Patricia in the catacombs. The witches break Sara's leg and force her to dance in a trance during the performance.

Klemperer, who has long believed his wife, Anke, lost in the war, is lured to the academy by a matron disguised as her, to serve as a witness. At the sabbath, where Susie is meant to become Markos's new vessel, the matrons disembowel Sara and Markos nearly decapitates the doubting Blanc. Susie then reveals that she herself is Mother Suspiriorum, one of the Three Mothers, summons Death to destroy Markos and her loyalists, and grants Patricia, Olga and Sara the deaths they plead for. Later she visits Klemperer, tells him Anke died at the Theresienstadt concentration camp, and erases his memories.

Dakota Johnson plays Susie, while Tilda Swinton plays Madame Blanc, Mother Markos and, under the pseudonym "Lutz Ebersdorf", Klemperer. Mia Goth plays Sara and Chloë Grace Moretz plays Patricia, and Jessica Harper, star of the original, makes a cameo. Critics were split, with 65% approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and the film earned about $7.7 million worldwide.

title: Barbie & Her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure
original_title: Barbie & Her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure
overview: Barbie and her sisters, Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea, and their adorable new puppy friends find unexpected mystery and adventure when they return to their hometown of Willows. While going through mementos in Grandma's attic, the sisters discover an old map, believed to lead to a long-lost treasure buried somewhere in the town. With their puppy pals in tow, the four girls go on an exciting treasure hunt, along the way discovering that the greatest treasure of all is the love and laughter they share as sisters!
plot:
Barbie & Her Sisters in the Great Puppy Adventure is a 2015 American computer-animated adventure film and the 31st entry in the Barbie film series. Directed by Andrew Tan from a screenplay by Amy Wolfram, it was produced by Mattel Playground Productions with animation by Arc Productions and music by Christopher Willis. Universal released it on DVD and Blu-ray in the United States on 27 October 2015, and it had its television premiere on Nickelodeon that December. It runs 76 minutes.

Barbie (Kelly Sheridan) drives her younger sisters Skipper, Stacie and Chelsea in their pink camper to their childhood hometown of Willows for a two-week summer stay with Grandma Roberts. Her dog, Tiffany, has had four puppies who can talk among themselves, and each sister adopts one: Barbie takes Taffy, Skipper DJ, Stacie Rookie and Chelsea Honey. Rummaging in the attic, Skipper finds an old map, and Grandma explains that the town's founders buried a treasure to be found in a time of need so that Willows would always prosper. While Barbie plans to spend time with her childhood friend Christie at the Willowfest fair, the younger girls set off on the treasure hunt, unaware that two carnival workers, Joe and Marty, are following them in hopes of seizing the prize.

The trail of riddles leads the sisters and their puppies from the town hall to a founders' vase holding a willow-tree charm, to Lake Willows, a fountain and the musical town clock, whose chiming tune hides the next clue. Meanwhile Barbie notices that Willowfest has shrunk, shops have closed, the town is in disrepair, and Christie's family must move away because they can no longer afford to stay. After Joe and Marty steal Skipper's tablet with the girls' notes, Barbie joins the hunt. Following the map's song lyrics, the sisters find a hidden tunnel beneath the first willow tree, cross a cavern to an underground lake, and open a treasure vault with the charm. The crooks trap everyone inside with a rockslide, but Taffy frees them, and the puppies tie up the thieves before the police arrive.

The girls donate the treasure to the town, reviving Willows: shops reopen, repairs are made and Christie's family can stay. Before leaving with their puppies, the sisters hide part of their reward with a new map to give townspeople something to believe in. The voice cast includes Kazumi Evans as Skipper, Claire Maggie Corlett as Stacie, Alyssya Swales as Chelsea and Joanne Wilson as Grandma.

plot:
Top Gun: Maverick is a 2022 American action-drama film directed by Joseph Kosinski and written by Ehren Kruger, Eric Warren Singer, Christopher McQuarrie, and Peter Craig. The movie stars Tom Cruise, Miles Teller, Jennifer Connelly, Jon Hamm, Glen Powell, Lewis Pullman, and Ed Harris.

The story takes place 34 years after the events of the original Top Gun (1986). Maverick (Tom Cruise), now a test pilot at the Navy's elite flight school, is recruited by Admiral Cyclone (Jon Hamm) to lead a mission to take out an underground nuclear facility in North Korea. The facility is believed to be developing advanced missiles that could threaten global security.

Maverick is tasked with training a new group of pilots, including Lieutenant Bradley "Rooster" Bradshaw (Miles Teller), the son of Maverick's late friend and Radar Intercept Officer, Goose (Anthony Edwards). Rooster is struggling to live up to his father's legacy, and Maverick sees an opportunity to help him find his own path.

As Maverick trains the pilots, he also faces opposition from Admiral Cyclone, who wants to use a more conventional approach to take out the facility. Maverick must convince the admiral that his unorthodox plan is the best way to achieve their objective.

Throughout the film, Maverick's relationships with his team are put to the test as they face intense aerial combat and personal struggles. The movie features stunning aerial sequences, showcasing the skills of the pilots and the cutting-edge technology used in modern fighter jets.

One of the standout aspects of Top Gun: Maverick is its exploration of themes such as legacy, mentorship, and redemption. Maverick's character arc is particularly compelling, as he grapples with his past mistakes and tries to make amends while also finding a way to move forward.

Overall, Top Gun: Maverick is an exhilarating and emotionally resonant film that delivers on its promise of high-octane action and memorable characters. With Tom Cruise reprising his iconic role as Maverick, the movie is sure to thrill fans of the original and newcomers alike.

On the other hand, Gerda's unwavering dedication to her friend represents the redemptive power of love and friendship.

The film also touches on themes of identity and belonging, as Kai struggles to find his place in a world where he feels like an outcast. His journey serves as a reminder that everyone deserves acceptance and understanding, regardless of their differences.
