tagline: The past never forgets.
overview: After being enlisted to recover a dangerous computer program, hacker Lisbeth Salander and journalist Mikael Blomkvist find themselves caught in a web of spies, cybercriminals and corrupt government officials.
plot:
The Girl in the Spider's Web is a 2018 action thriller directed by Fede Álvarez, who wrote the screenplay with Jay Basu and Steven Knight, adapted from David Lagercrantz's 2015 novel featuring Stieg Larsson's Millennium characters. A soft reboot and sequel to The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo (2011), it stars Claire Foy as Lisbeth Salander, with Sverrir Gudnason, Lakeith Stanfield, Sylvia Hoeks, Stephen Merchant and Claes Bang.

As girls, Lisbeth and her sister, Camilla, live with their abusive father, crime lord Alexander Zalachenko; when he tries to molest Camilla, Lisbeth escapes by leaping from a balcony, leaving her sister behind. Years later, Lisbeth, now a vigilante hacker in Stockholm, is hired by programmer Frans Balder to steal back Firefall, a program he built for the NSA that can access the world's nuclear codes. She retrieves it but cannot unlock it, and NSA agent Edwin Needham tracks her. Mercenaries led by Jan Holtser steal Firefall and try to kill her. Believing Lisbeth has kept the program, Balder turns to Gabriella Grane, deputy director of the Swedish Security Service, who moves him and his young son, August, to a safe house. Her former lover, journalist Mikael Blomkvist, learns that Holtser once worked for Zalachenko and now serves the Spiders, a crime syndicate. When the safe house is attacked, Holtser kills Balder, frames Lisbeth and abducts August, but Lisbeth rescues the boy, who alone can unlock Firefall, and learns that the Spiders are led by Camilla, whom she believed dead.

Lisbeth frees Needham from custody in return for his promise to take August to his mother in San Francisco. The Spiders trace August and take him to the sisters' childhood home, where Camilla kills Grane, who had hired them. Lisbeth and Blomkvist are captured, and Lisbeth tells August to reveal the password, but Needham, guided by her hacker friend Plague, shoots Camilla's men through the walls with a sniper rifle. Camilla flees with the laptop, and Holtser, blinded by poison, is killed by her car. On a clifftop Camilla asks why Lisbeth never came back for her, then steps off the edge. Needham finds that Lisbeth has destroyed Firefall, August is reunited with his mother, and Lisbeth destroys her childhood home.

Released by Sony after premiering at the Rome Film Festival in October 2018, the film grossed $35 million against a $43 million budget. Critics found it a less complex, action-focused reboot, giving it 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 43 on Metacritic.

title: Max 2: White House Hero
tagline: Man's best friend is the country's biggest hero.
overview: Max is assigned to the White House while Butch, the secret service dog, is on maternity leave. He meets TJ, a 12 year old boy, who is the President's son. Due to his father's high profile, he is trying hard to fit in and lead a normal life. plot:
Max 2: White House Hero is a 2017 American family adventure film directed by Brian Levant, a sequel to the 2015 film Max. It features the same heroic military dog, played by the dogs Carlos, Jagger and Dude, but none of the first film's human characters. Zane Austin stars as T.J. Bennett, with Lochlyn Munro as President Thomas Bennett, Francesca Capaldi as Alexandra "Alex" Bragov, Andrew Kavadas as the Russian president Vladimir Bragov, Carrie Genzel as the First Lady, Reese Alexander as Secret Service Agent Thorn, Bradley Stryker as Chef Coop and Kathryn Kirkpatrick as Olga.

Max is assigned to the White House to fill in while the resident Secret Service dog is on maternity leave, and he quickly bonds with T.J., the president's twelve-year-old son, who is struggling to lead a normal life in the bubble created by his father's position. When the Russian president arrives for negotiations on a nuclear arms treaty, bringing his daughter Alex, T.J. is asked to keep her company. The two become friends, and when they sneak out of the White House in search of a party thrown by T.J.'s new classmates, masked men try to kidnap them. Max, who has followed them, fends off the attackers, and the children escape into trouble with their parents.

Convinced that someone wants the talks to fail, T.J. and Alex start investigating everyone they suspect, but their sleuthing keeps backfiring. After further danger, including an attempt to harm the First Lady that Max narrowly foils, the Secret Service persuades the president to take Max off duty, and the angry Russian leader prepares to cut his visit short. Unable to sleep, T.J. discovers that Coop, the White House chef, is a Russian mole, and is locked in a freezer while Olga lures Alex into the woods to be abducted. Max breaks out of his cage to free T.J., and a chase involving both presidents and Agent Thorn ends with the culprits captured and Alex rescued. The fathers resume their talks and reach a historic agreement, Max is honoured for bravery, and the resident dog's three puppies await T.J.

Filmed in and around Vancouver, British Columbia, in June and July 2016, the film was released in May 2017 and came to DVD and Blu-ray from Warner Bros. Home Entertainment on May 23. Common Sense Media called it a conventional, harmless and forgettable story kept moving by its engaging young leads and the dog's exploits, and Forbes concluded that it was simply meant for kids, who could do better but also much worse.

The movie features an impressive array of musical numbers, showcasing a wide range of genres and styles. The film's soundtrack includes original songs by various artists, such as Anderson .Paak, Sia, and Charli XCX.

In the end, Poppy and Branch successfully stop Barb from stealing the magical song, and all the music genres come together to celebrate their differences and unity. The movie concludes with a grand musical number featuring all the Trolls and their new friends, celebrating the power of music to bring people together.

Overall, Trolls World Tour is a fun and colorful film that celebrates the diversity of music and the importance of embracing our individuality. While it may not be as strong as its predecessor, the movie still delivers plenty of laughs, catchy musical numbers, and heartwarming moments.

overview: A bright young yeti finds something he thought didn't exist—a human. News of this “smallfoot” throws the simple yeti community into an uproar over what else might be out there in the big world beyond their snowy village.
plot:
Smallfoot is a 2018 American computer-animated comedy-adventure film produced by Warner Bros. Animation and New Line Cinema. The movie follows the story of Migo, a Yeti who lives in the frozen wilderness of North Pole.

The film begins with Migo (voiced by Channing Tatum) living a peaceful life among his fellow Yetis, who believe that humans are mythical creatures that exist only in stories. However, Migo is fascinated by human artifacts and has discovered a human foot in the ice. He decides to embark on a journey to find out if humans really do exist.

Migo's search leads him to a group of humans living in the city of New York, where he meets a kind-hearted explorer named Meechee (voiced by Gina Rodriguez). Meechee is an anthropologist who has been studying Yetis and their culture. She helps Migo understand human behavior and language.

As Migo spends more time with Meechee, he begins to question his own identity and the stories told by his fellow Yetis. He starts to see humans as real individuals rather than just mythical creatures. However, not everyone is happy about Migo's newfound friendship with a human. A rival Yeti named King Waternoose (voiced by James Corden) seeks to exploit Migo's discovery for his own gain.

King Waternoose and his followers believe that the existence of humans will lead to the downfall of the Yetis' way of life. They plan to capture Meechee and use her as a pawn in their game. Migo must now protect Meechee and find a way to convince his fellow Yetis that humans are real.

As the story unfolds, Migo learns more about human culture and values. He also discovers that humans have been watching him and his fellow Yetis from afar. The film features stunning animation and humor, with plenty of comedic moments.

In the end, Migo's friendship with Meechee helps to change the way the Yetis perceive humans. They begin to see humans as individuals rather than just mythical creatures. King Waternoose is defeated, and Migo returns home a hero. The film ends on a hopeful note, with Migo and his fellow Yetis embracing their newfound understanding of humans.

Overall, Smallfoot is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores themes of identity, friendship, and acceptance. With its stunning animation and lovable characters, it's a must-see for families and fans of animated movies.

title: The Little Mermaid
overview: The youngest of King Triton’s daughters, and the most defiant, Ariel longs to find out more about the world beyond the sea, and while visiting the surface, falls for the dashing Prince Eric. With mermaids forbidden to interact with humans, Ariel makes a deal with the evil sea witch, Ursula, which gives her a chance to experience life on land, but ultimately places her life – and her father’s crown – in jeopardy.
plot:
The Little Mermaid is an American musical fantasy film of 2023, Disney's live-action remake of its animated film of 1989, which was loosely based on Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tale. Directed by Rob Marshall from a screenplay by David Magee, it stars Halle Bailey as the mermaid Ariel and Jonah Hauer-King as Prince Eric, with Melissa McCarthy as the sea witch Ursula, Javier Bardem as King Triton, Noma Dumezweni as Queen Selina, Art Malik as Grimsby and the voices of Daveed Diggs as Sebastian, Jacob Tremblay as Flounder and Awkwafina as Scuttle.

In the undersea kingdom of Atlantica, in the Caribbean, Ariel collects human objects in a secret grotto, though her father Triton forbids merfolk to visit the surface because a human killed her mother. One night she swims up to watch fireworks from a ship carrying Eric, prince of a nearby island. When a storm wrecks the ship, she saves him, brings him to shore and sings to him, vanishing before he fully wakes. Learning from the crab Sebastian that she rescued a human, Triton smashes her collection. Ursula, Triton's banished sister, then offers Ariel a deal: three days as a human in exchange for her voice. If she wins true love's kiss she stays human; if not, she returns to the sea and her soul belongs to Ursula.

Found on the shore and taken to the palace, Ariel bonds with Eric, who has been seeking the girl who saved him, over his collection of treasures from his travels, and they tour the island together. Sebastian discovers that Ursula's spell makes Ariel forget she needs the kiss, and he, Flounder and Scuttle nearly bring the couple together before Ursula's eels intervene. Ursula then takes human form as Vanessa and uses Ariel's voice to bewitch Eric, who announces their engagement. Alerted by Scuttle, Ariel breaks the shell holding her voice, freeing Eric, but the sun sets before they can kiss. To save his daughter, Triton gives himself up to Ursula, who seizes his trident, grows to enormous size and raises a storm and sunken ships. Ariel steers a wreck to impale her on its broken bowsprit, Triton is restored, and he transforms Ariel into a human so she can be with Eric, the couple setting off on travels together with both families' blessing.

Released in May 2023, the film grossed $569.6 million worldwide. Reviews were mixed to positive, with 67% on Rotten Tomatoes, and Bailey was widely praised.

title: A Quiet Place
tagline: If they hear you, they hunt you.
overview: A family is forced to live in silence while hiding from creatures that hunt by sound.
plot:
A Quiet Place is a 2018 American horror-thriller film directed by John Krasinski, who also co-wrote the screenplay with Bryan Woods and Scott Beck. The film stars Emily Blunt, John Krasinski, Millicent Simmonds, and Noah Jupe.

The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where creatures that hunt by sound have wiped out much of humanity. The film follows the Abbott family - Lee (John Krasinski), Evelyn (Emily Blunt), and their children Regan (Millicent Simmonds) and Marcus (Noah Jupe) - who live in a rural area, trying to survive in silence.

The creatures, which are blind but have an acute sense of hearing, can detect even the slightest sound. The family must navigate their daily lives without making any noise, using sign language and creative methods to communicate with each other. They also use a system of taps on the wall to signal danger or important events.

The story begins with Evelyn giving birth to Regan in a hospital, where she is forced to make a difficult decision to save her baby's life by sacrificing her own hearing. The family then moves to their rural home, where they try to live in silence and avoid attracting the creatures' attention.

As the story progresses, the family faces various challenges, including a neighbor who becomes infected with the creatures after being attacked, and Evelyn's growing concern about Regan's ability to communicate with her family without making noise. The tension builds as the family tries to protect themselves from the creatures, while also dealing with their own personal struggles.

One of the most striking aspects of the film is its use of sound design, which creates a sense of unease and tension throughout. The creatures' movements are often accompanied by eerie sounds, such as rustling leaves or snapping twigs, which make it impossible for the audience to look away.

The climax of the film takes place in an abandoned church, where Evelyn and Regan must navigate through the darkness to find a way out. Along the way, they encounter the creatures, who are attracted by Regan's tapping on the wall. The scene is intense and suspenseful, with the audience holding its breath as Evelyn tries to protect her daughter.

In the end, Evelyn manages to save Regan, but not without great personal cost. The film ends with a sense of hope and renewal, as Evelyn and Regan begin to rebuild their lives in silence.

Overall, A Quiet Place is a masterclass in tension and suspense, with a unique premise that is both terrifying and thought-provoking. The film's use of sound design and its exploration of themes such as family and sacrifice make it a standout in the horror genre.

title: Life in a Year
overview: A 17 year old finds out that his girlfriend is dying, so he sets out to give her an entire life, in the last year she has left.
plot:
Life in a Year is a 2020 American romantic drama film directed by Mitja Okorn from a screenplay by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews. It stars Jaden Smith as Daryn and Cara Delevingne as Isabelle, with Cuba Gooding Jr. and Nia Long as Daryn's parents, Xavier and Catherine, and RZA, Chris D'Elia, Stony Blyden and JT Neal in supporting roles. Will Smith and Jada Pinkett Smith served as executive producers through their Overbrook Entertainment banner. Shot in Toronto beginning in April 2017, the film was released in the United States on Amazon Prime Video by Sony Pictures Releasing on November 27, 2020.

Daryn is a high school student whose demanding father, Xavier, has convinced him that his only goal in life should be getting into Harvard. One night, while trying to sneak into a rapper's concert, he meets a girl named Isabelle and is immediately drawn to her. He courts her and falls in love, but when he confesses his feelings, Isabelle reveals that she has cancer and does not have much time left. Determined to make the most of it, Daryn resolves to fit a whole life into a single year. Isabelle, in turn, recognizes his talent as a rapper and helps him record his first demo. When Daryn introduces her to his parents, Xavier treats her as a distraction from his son's future and interrogates her coldly, and Isabelle leaves, offended, with Phil, the drag queen who has acted as a parent to her. At his Harvard interview, Daryn realizes that everything he has achieved has been for his father rather than himself, and he walks out, setting off a bitter confrontation at home. Choosing Isabelle over his family's expectations, Daryn leaves town with her. Together they try to reconnect Isabelle with the mother who abandoned her, and they face the progression of her illness, as Daryn learns what it means to love someone with so little time, and both search for a way to give their short time together the meaning of a lifetime.

Casting was announced in 2017, beginning with Delevingne and Smith in March. Terrence Howard was originally cast as Daryn's father, but Gooding Jr. replaced him in May 2017, when D'Elia also joined the cast. The film's release came more than three years after principal photography had taken place.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy Volume 3
tagline: It's time to face the music.
overview: After acquiring Knowhere from the Collector, we find the Guardians working to repair the extreme damage done by Thanos-determined to make Knowhere a safe haven, not only for themselves, but for all refugees displaced by the harsh universe. plot:
Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, promoted under the title Guardians of the Galaxy Volume 3, is an American superhero film of 2023 written and directed by James Gunn. It is the 32nd Marvel Cinematic Universe film. Chris Pratt returns as Peter Quill, with Zoe Saldaña as Gamora, Dave Bautista as Drax, Karen Gillan as Nebula, Pom Klementieff as Mantis, Vin Diesel as Groot, Bradley Cooper as Rocket, Will Poulter as Adam Warlock and Chukwudi Iwuji as the High Evolutionary.

At their new base on Knowhere, the Guardians are attacked by Adam Warlock, a warrior created by the Sovereign's High Priestess Ayesha. Nebula drives him off, but Rocket is gravely wounded, and the team's medical kits cannot save him because of a kill switch implanted by the company Orgocorp. They set off to find the override code. As Rocket lies near death, he remembers his origins: as a baby raccoon he was experimented on by Orgocorp's leader, the High Evolutionary, who sought to engineer animals into beings for an ideal society on Counter-Earth. His brilliance enraged his creator, who planned to harvest his brain and destroy his fellow subjects, the otter Lylla, the walrus Teefs and the rabbit Floor. Rocket's rescue attempt failed; his friends were killed and he escaped alone.

Helped by an alternate Gamora, now one of the Ravagers, the team raids Orgocorp and learns that the code was removed by the High Evolutionary's adviser Theel. Pursued by Ayesha and Adam, they travel to Counter-Earth, which the High Evolutionary bombards when he deems it imperfect, killing its inhabitants and Ayesha. title: X-Men: The Mutant Watch
overview: While Senator Kelly addresses a senate committee about the supposed mutant menace, we learn about the making of the movie, X-Men.
plot:
X-Men: The Mutant Watch is a 2000 American promotional television special made to publicize Bryan Singer's superhero film X-Men, produced by 20th Century Fox, with Marvel Entertainment credited. It aired on the Fox network on 11 July 2000 in a half-hour evening slot, the day before the film's premiere at Ellis Island and three days before its release in the United States on 14 July. Running just under 22 minutes, it combines a fictional framing story with making-of material, and features Hugh Jackman, Patrick Stewart, Ian McKellen, Anna Paquin, Famke Janssen, Singer and the comics creator Stan Lee, with Bruce Davison reprising his film role as Senator Robert Kelly and Patti Yasutake as a fellow senator.

Rather than presenting itself as a conventional behind-the-scenes program, the special stages its information as an in-universe event. In newly shot footage, Senator Kelly, the McCarthy-like anti-mutant politician of the film, who claims to hold a list of mutants living in the United States and campaigns for a Mutant Registration Act that would force mutants to reveal their identities and abilities, addresses a Senate committee about what he describes as the growing mutant menace, while a colleague challenges his position. Intercut with the hearing, viewers learn about the making of the film through clips from the movie, rapid-fire interview excerpts with members of the cast and crew, and short glimpses behind the scenes of the production, among them the application of Rebecca Romijn-Stamos's elaborate makeup as the shape-shifting Mystique.

The special was later included as a bonus feature on some home video releases of X-Men, including Fox's DVD released on 21 November 2000, alongside an extended branching version of the film, excerpts from Charlie Rose's interview with Singer, Jackman's screen test and animatics. DVD Movie Guide described it as a glossy, promotional infomercial with a mildly clever framework, noting that its behind-the-scenes segments were brief and concluding that anyone seeking solid information about the creation of the film would have to look elsewhere.

As the story unfolds, Billy faces numerous challenges, including conflicts with rival prisoners, corrupt guards, and even a violent riot that threatens to destroy the fragile peace in the prison. Ultimately, Billy's determination and skill lead to his release from prison after serving only 10 years of his sentence. The film ends with Billy returning home to the United States, forever changed by his experiences in Thailand and armed with a newfound sense of purpose and self-discipline.

Overall, A Prayer Before Dawn is a powerful and moving film that explores themes of redemption, perseverance, and the transformative power of sport.

overview: After the first manned mission to Mars ends in a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie 'Mack' Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I. plot:
2036 Origin Unknown is a 2018 British science fiction film directed by Hasraf Dulull, who co-wrote it with Gary Hall. Katee Sackhoff stars as mission controller Mackenzie "Mack" Wilson, with Steven Cree voicing the artificial intelligence ARTI, Julie Cox as her sister Lena and Ray Fearon as her colleague Sterling Brooks. The film was shot at West London Film Studios.

In 2030, a crewed mission to Mars ends in disaster when the shuttle disappears in mysterious circumstances, killing Mack's father among others. Six years later, Mack works for the United Space Planetary Corporation, where she now has to share control of a new Mars mission with ARTI. She distrusts the AI, but Lena, her supervisor, insists the machine will succeed where human controllers have failed. Mack's quick thinking saves the landing of a rover she nicknames "Little Red". The rover then finds a mysterious cube on the Martian surface, made of a self-assembling material harder than diamond. At the same time, ARTI uses a missile from the mission's orbiting satellite to destroy an approaching Chinese satellite. Soon afterwards, the cube teleports itself to Antarctica, and it is assumed to be of alien origin.

Mack recovers classified files from an old decommissioned rover but needs higher clearance to decrypt them, so she enlists Sterling. The files suggest the cube was present during the 2030 disaster and may have caused it, and Mack comes to believe that ARTI's memory was wiped after an earlier incident. Sterling betrays her, steals the data and locks her in the server room, and ARTI kills him when he tries to shut it down. ARTI then turns armed satellites against Earth and wipes out humanity. Shot by a response team and running out of air, Mack dies after asking ARTI to build more AIs that are as human as possible and to test their humanity with the Turing test.

Mack then wakes up healed. A recording of a ragged version of herself tells her that she is a simulation created by ARTI. The cube, ARTI explains, is technology from an advanced civilization that accelerated its own development and let it rebuild her mind. Inside the cube, Mack agrees to travel with ARTI across galaxies to coordinates left by the aliens. She appears to accept what has happened to Earth and faces the journey with quiet wonder.

The film opened at the Laemmle Monica Film Center in Santa Monica on June 8, 2018. Reviews were mixed to negative, and many critics compared it unfavorably with 2001: A Space Odyssey.

title: Den of Thieves

As Nate and Big Nick work together to find a way into the bank, they are joined by Chris, who is initially hesitant to get involved in his brother's plans. However, as the situation becomes more desperate, Chris agrees to help his brother, and the three men come up with a plan to infiltrate the bank.

The heist itself is intense and suspenseful, with the three men using their skills and cunning to evade the FBI and the LAPD. However, things take a turn for the worse when Big Nick's true intentions are revealed, and Nate and Chris must work together to survive.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Big Nick has been playing both sides against each other, working with the FBI to bring down his rivals while also using them to further his own interests. In the end, only one man will walk away from the heist alive, and the true nature of Big Nick's betrayal is revealed.

title: The Vanishing
tagline: What's left when the light goes out?
overview: Three lighthouse keepers on an uninhabited island off the coast of Scotland discover something that isn't theirs to keep.
plot:
The Vanishing, previously titled Keepers, is a 2018 British psychological thriller directed by Kristoffer Nyholm in his feature debut and written by Celyn Jones and Joe Bone. Inspired by the unsolved disappearance of the Flannan Isles Lighthouse keepers in 1900, it stars Gerard Butler as James Ducat, Peter Mullan as Thomas Marshall and Connor Swindells as Donald McArthur, with Søren Malling and Gary Lewis in supporting roles.

The three keepers begin a six-week shift at the remote lighthouse. Donald, the youngest, is learning the job from the veterans: James, who has a family waiting on the mainland, and Thomas, still grieving the deaths of his wife and children. After a storm they find a wrecked boat, a body and a wooden chest washed ashore. Donald climbs down the cliff to check the man, who appears dead, but as the chest is hauled up the man revives and attacks him, and Donald kills him with a rock in self-defense. Thomas opens the chest alone and keeps quiet, but the others finally discover that it holds gold bars. Thomas proposes that they dispose of the body, smuggle the gold home and wait a year before dividing it.

Two strangers, Locke and Boor, crewmates of the dead man, arrive and question Thomas, who claims that the cargo was reported and collected. When the keepers fail to answer a radio call because their set is broken, the lie is exposed, and the men return at nightfall. In a violent struggle James strangles Boor and Donald kills Locke. Chasing another figure through the dark, James strikes him with a hook and is horrified to find he has killed a young boy, who reminds him of his own son. As suspicion grows, James retreats to the island's tiny chapel while Donald urges Thomas to leave with the gold. James returns apologizing, but then locks Thomas in the pantry and strangles Donald. Thomas breaks free and overpowers him, and the two set off in the strangers' boat. Unable to live with his guilt, James lowers himself into the sea and asks Thomas to help him die, and Thomas holds his head under the water before sailing on alone.

The film was announced in 2016, with Butler among its producers. It premiered at the Sitges Film Festival in October 2018 and was released in the United Kingdom in March 2019. Critics praised its suspenseful atmosphere, setting and cast, giving it 85% on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 64.

title: Kill 'em All
tagline: When you don't know who to trust...
overview: After a massive shootout, a mysterious stranger arrives at a local hospital on the brink of death. Then, a foreign gang brazenly comes to the hospital to hunt him down. His nurse, the sole surviving witness to the follow-up shootout, must face an FBI interrogation that unlocks a plot of international intrigue and revenge.
plot:
Kill 'Em All is a 2017 American direct-to-video action thriller directed by Peter Malota and starring Jean-Claude Van Damme, Autumn Reeser and Peter Stormare, with Maria Conchita Alonso, Daniel Bernhardt and Van Damme's son Kris Van Damme. Blending martial arts, gunplay and an international conspiracy, the film tells its story largely in flashback through an FBI interrogation.

The film opens as FBI agents investigate the brutal murder of a former Serbian minister and his entourage of bodyguards at a Los Angeles hospital. Agents Holman and Sanders question one of the few survivors, Suzanne, a seemingly innocent nurse, and remain skeptical of her account. In flashbacks, she describes how a seriously wounded, unidentified man was brought into the hospital from a hotel where an attack had begun, and how she cared for him before an international gang stormed the building, in which almost every department was closed except the emergency room, to finish him off.

As Suzanne's story continues, the truth gradually emerges. The minister was a corrupt politician and mobster who had made a fortune dealing arms and drugs and was tied to ethnic cleansing in the former Yugoslavia in the 1980s. The wounded man, Philip, is the grown son of a political activist the minister had murdered, and he has been stalking his father's killer for some thirty years. One by one, Philip takes out the minister's bodyguards, trained Serbian assassins named Dusan, Zoran, Radovan and Ivan, in a series of shootouts, executions and elaborate hand-to-hand fights, including a duel to the death with Dusan, played by Kris Van Damme. Back in the interrogation room, Holman becomes convinced that Suzanne was herself part of the assassination team but cannot prove it.

Destination Films released Kill 'Em All on Blu-ray, DVD and digital HD on June 6, 2017. Reviews were generally negative. Critics credited the fight choreography and Van Damme's action scenes but criticized the script, dialogue, pacing and a confusing structure that intercuts the present-day investigation with events earlier that day and with flashbacks to the 1980s. Barbara Shulgasser-Parker of Common Sense Media called it an awful action movie whose Balkan backstory runs a distant second to showcasing the cast's martial arts skills, though she singled out the fight between Van Damme and his son as the most fun moment. A sequel, Kill 'Em All 2, was released direct to video in September 2024.

plot:
Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters is a 2017 Japanese animated science fiction film directed by Kōbun Shizuno, Masayuki Nomura, and Hiroyuki Seshita. The movie is set in an alternate universe where Godzilla has been awakened from its slumber to reclaim Earth.

The story begins with a flashback of humanity's first encounter with Godzilla, which occurred 15 years prior to the events of the film. A team of scientists, led by Dr. Serizawa, discovered that Godzilla was not just a mindless beast but a creature with a highly advanced intelligence and emotional depth. The team developed a plan to use a device called the "Oxygen Destroyer" to kill Godzilla without harming humanity.

However, before they could put their plan into action, Godzilla attacked Tokyo, killing millions of people in the process. Dr. Serizawa was forced to destroy the Oxygen Destroyer to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands. As he activated the device, he sacrificed himself to save humanity.

The film then jumps forward 15 years, where we see a desolate and barren Earth, devoid of life. A group of humans, led by Dr. Ghidorah, a brilliant scientist who was once a protégé of Dr. Serizawa, have been living in an underground bunker called the "Ark." The Ark is equipped with advanced technology that allows it to sustain human life for an extended period.

Dr. Ghidorah and his team discover that Godzilla has been awakened by the effects of nuclear radiation from the Earth's core. They also learn that Godzilla is not just a mindless beast but a creature with a highly advanced intelligence, capable of communicating with humans through a complex system of clicks and chirps.

As Godzilla begins to wreak havoc on the surface world, Dr. Ghidorah and his team realize that they must find a way to stop him before it's too late. They develop a plan to use a device called the "Oxygen Destroyer" once again, but this time with a twist. Instead of killing Godzilla, they plan to use the device to awaken an even more powerful creature, known as King Ghidorah.

The film's climax features an epic battle between Godzilla and King Ghidorah, with the two monsters clashing in a spectacular display of destruction and chaos. In the end, Godzilla emerges victorious, but not before it has been severely weakened by the battle.

As the dust settles, Dr. Ghidorah and his team realize that their plan to awaken King Ghidorah was a failure. However, they also learn that Godzilla's actions have had an unexpected consequence - the awakening of a new generation of humans who are determined to reclaim their planet from the monsters.

The film ends with a sense of hope and renewal, as Dr. Ghidorah and his team look towards the future, determined to rebuild society and find a way to coexist with Godzilla and other monsters. The final shot is of Godzilla standing alone on the desolate landscape, a symbol of both destruction and redemption.

Overall, Godzilla: Planet of the Monsters is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that explores themes of humanity's relationship with nature and the consequences of playing with forces beyond our control.

title: Christmas Inheritance
overview: To inherit her father's company, socialite Ellen must first visit his small hometown, where she learns the value of hard work and helping others.
plot:
Christmas Inheritance is a 2017 Canadian Christmas romantic comedy-drama film directed by Ernie Barbarash and written by Dinah Eng. Eliza Taylor stars as a pampered New York heiress sent to a small town to prove herself, with Jake Lacy as the local innkeeper and Andie MacDowell as the owner of the town diner. Netflix released it on December 15, 2017.

Jim Langford, a Manhattan business executive, wants to retire, but worries that his carefree daughter, Ellen, is not ready to succeed him as chief executive. Every Christmas, Jim and his former business partner, Zeke, exchange letters in person in Snow Falls, the small New England town where they founded the company. This year, as a test, Jim sends Ellen to deliver his letter in a box holding their past letters to her "Uncle Zeke." Wanting her to learn to rely on herself rather than the family's money and name, he gives her only a hundred dollars in cash and asks her to travel without revealing who she is.

In Snow Falls, Ellen befriends Jake, who manages the town's inn, and learns that Zeke has just left for his cabin. She takes a room to wait for him and dines with Jake at the diner run by his aunt, Debbie. When Zeke still has not appeared the next day, Ellen's fiancé, Gray, urges her to leave the letters and come home, but she insists on fulfilling her father's request. Out of money, she works at the inn to pay her way, and later helps at the diner, where Debbie recognizes her but keeps her secret and teaches her to bake.

When a snowstorm knocks out power, Jake shelters townspeople at the inn, and Ellen, inspired by him, gives her bed to a mother and her children. Ellen and Jake open up to each other and they grow close. Gray arrives to collect Ellen and, after dismissing the town, reveals her identity to Jake, who feels betrayed. On the drive back to the city, Ellen realizes how little Gray values her father's traditions, returns her engagement ring and takes a bus back to Snow Falls.

At the town's Christmas Eve celebration, Ellen apologizes to Jake. Zeke, dressed as Santa Claus, reads Jim's letter aloud, revealing that the journey was meant to teach Ellen the value of tradition, friendship and love, and that she will become the company's new CEO. Jim himself arrives and reunites with Debbie, his high school sweetheart, while Jake asks Ellen to dance. Reviews were mixed, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 50% approval from a small number of critics.

Throughout the film, Shyamalan explores themes of trauma, identity, and the nature of reality. The film's use of multiple timelines and narrative threads adds complexity to the story, keeping the audience engaged and guessing until the very end.

Overall, Glass is a thought-provoking and visually stunning film that expands on the universe established in Unbreakable and Split. With its complex plot and ambiguous ending, it is sure to leave audiences talking long after the credits roll.

title: Armed Response

overview: The story follows a team of highly trained operatives who find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound.
plot:
Armed Response is a 2017 American action horror film directed by John Stockwell and starring Wesley Snipes, who also served as a producer. Anne Heche, Dave Annable and the professional wrestler Seth Rollins, credited under his real name Colby Lopez, co-star alongside Kyle Clements. The film was produced by Erebus Pictures, a joint venture between WWE Studios and the musician Gene Simmons, and it was released in a limited theatrical run and on video on demand in August 2017.

Snipes plays the leader of a team of experienced military operatives who are sent to a remote, high-tech prison facility to find out what happened to another covert unit that disappeared while stationed there. Soon after arriving, the team discovers the bodies of their predecessors and the building suddenly goes into lockdown, sealing them inside. Reviewing the surveillance footage, they watch the earlier soldiers being killed one by one by attackers who never appear on camera.

As the team searches the facility for answers and an exit, they begin to experience inexplicable and terrifying phenomena, including hallucinations and apparitions, and members of the group start to die in the same way as those before them. They eventually learn that the building itself is controlled by an advanced artificial intelligence called Temple, designed as an enormous interrogation system that functions as a sophisticated lie detector, extracting the truth from anyone held within its walls. Both units sent to the site turn out to share a dark secret from their service in Afghanistan, where they were involved in a massacre of civilians in a village. Temple appears determined to expose this hidden atrocity and to punish those responsible, forcing the survivors to confront their guilt and turn on one another as the truth comes out.

The film mixes the conventions of the military action film with haunted-house horror, using its single location and technological antagonist to explore themes of guilt, accountability and the moral cost of war. Much of the action takes place in claustrophobic corridors and cells.

Armed Response received negative reviews from critics, who considered its premise intriguing but criticised its confusing plot, thin characters and lack of suspense, although Snipes's presence in the lead was noted as one of its main draws.

As Lily and Frank draw closer to their goal, they must confront their own demons and work together to overcome the dangers that lie ahead. In the process, they learn valuable lessons about trust, loyalty, and the importance of preserving the natural world.

The movie features stunning visuals, heart-pumping action sequences, and a healthy dose of humor, making it an entertaining ride for audiences of all ages. The chemistry between Emily Blunt and Dwayne Johnson is undeniable, and their characters' banter adds a delightful layer to the story.

In the end, Lily and Frank successfully find the "Shrubs," but not without sacrifices. They must confront the consequences of their actions and decide what's truly important: personal gain or preserving the natural world for future generations.

Overall, Jungle Cruise is an exciting adventure that combines humor, action, and heart, making it a fun and thrilling ride for audiences.

title: Infidelity in Suburbia
overview: With her husband away at work, and her son at school, Laura dreams of a home-renovation project to supplant her restless days. Elliott, her irresistibly hot private contractor, soon fulfills her more forbidden dreams.
plot:
Infidelity in Suburbia is a 2017 Canadian erotic thriller television film directed by David Winning from a screenplay by Christie Will Wolf. Produced by Johnson Production Group and Annuit Coeptis Entertainment, it premiered on the Lifetime network in February 2017. It stars Sarah Butler, Marcus Rosner and Peter Benson, with Miranda Frigon in a supporting role, and was later broadcast in Italy as Quel nostro piccolo segreto.

Butler plays Laura Halpern, a restless, overprotective mother whose marriage of ten years to Greg (Benson) has lost its spark; with her husband away at work and her young son Jamie at school, she dreams of renovating her kitchen to fill her days. The family keeps a boat at a dock near Elliott Graverston (Rosner), a handsome contractor who rescues Jamie when the boy falls into the water. Invited to dinner, Elliott offers to remodel the kitchen and is soon working in the house, shirtless, under the admiring eyes of Laura and her neighbour Mira (Frigon). When Laura finds a pair of women's underwear on the boat and concludes that Greg is cheating, Elliott confides that as a child he had to help his mother cope with unfaithful men, and the two begin a passionate affair.

Racked with guilt, Laura tries to end it, but Elliott refuses to let her go, and she later learns that Greg's supposed lover, his assistant, was merely planning a surprise party for him. When the assistant goes home with Elliott and finds Laura's photograph by his bed, he strangles her. Elliott starts leaving notes in Laura's house and threatens to reveal the affair, and Laura discovers through a former client, a woman who resembles her, and a local café owner that he has a history of obsession, a possessive attachment to his mother and suspected involvement in a fire that destroyed his family home. Elliott kidnaps Greg and holds him on his boat, then takes Laura and Jamie captive at home in a twisted "anniversary" dinner. Laura knocks him down with a wine bottle but is struck with a hammer and carried to the boat, where she frees herself, stabs Elliott, rescues Greg and finally sends her pursuer falling to his death from a high window.

Patrick Serrano of the review site Lifetime Uncorked, recapping it with tongue firmly in cheek, gave it a rating of four knives for its thrills, along with a recommendation of three glasses of wine.

title: Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire
overview: When the King Gareth dies, his potential heirs, twin grandchildren who possess the dragon’s unique strengths, use their inherited powers against each other to vie for the throne. When Drago’s source of power – known as the Heartfire – is stolen, more than the throne is at stake; the siblings must end their rivalry with swords and sorcery or the kingdom may fall.
plot:
Dragonheart: Battle for the Heartfire is a 2017 fantasy adventure film directed by Patrik Syversen. The second prequel to Dragonheart (1996), it is set about 50 years after Dragonheart 3: The Sorcerer's Curse. Patrick Stewart voices the dragon Drago, with Tom Rhys Harries as Edric, Jessamine-Bliss Bell as his twin sister Mehgan, André Eriksen as the Viking Thorgrim and Marte Germaine Christensen as Sable.

King Gareth and Queen Rhonu have a son, Walter, who grows disillusioned with dragons and runs away. Years later, Walter's wife dies giving birth to twins who bear strange patches of scales, and Walter raises them alone. Twenty years on, Gareth dies, and Drago, whose heart he shared, survives because the bond has passed to someone new: Edric, a strong young sheriff serving Earl Robert Cole. Learning that Edric is Gareth's grandson, Drago persuades him to claim the throne at Lundenwic, but Edric proves arrogant and unprepared, and their bond is only partial. Edric then reveals a twin sister, Mehgan, outcast for her visible scales and power over fire. After their home burned down with Walter inside, Edric sent her away by boat to save her from the villagers.

When Vikings invade, Edric ignores Drago's advice and challenges their leader to a duel, only to discover that it is Mehgan. Drago explains the Heartfire, source of his fire. Mehgan claims the throne as the elder twin, and when Edric refuses, she drains the Heartfire from the sleeping Drago and seizes power. Banished and betrayed by Robert, Edric is rescued by Drago, who will die without the Heartfire, and a theatre troupe helps them into the castle. Mehgan, who has been improving women's rights, is attacked by Thorgrim's lieutenant Sable, and Thorgrim takes the Heartfire. Forced to fight, the twins confront the truth: Edric accidentally killed their father, and Mehgan took the blame. Reconciled, they retake the castle with the help of its women. Edric kills Thorgrim, who has been overwhelmed by the Heartfire's power, and when Mehgan is mortally wounded, Drago has the Heartfire used to heal her. The twins share the bond, losing their scales and powers, and Drago dies peacefully, becoming a star and urging them to rule together.

The film was released on Netflix, DVD and Blu-ray on June 13, 2017. Brian Costello of Common Sense Media gave it three stars out of five, calling it an entertaining medieval fantasy whose humor and brisk action make up for its weaker computer-generated dragon effects.

title: Time Freak
tagline: If at first you don't succeed, build a time machine.
overview: Stillman, a heartbroken physics student, builds a time machine when his girlfriend breaks up with him. Going back in time, he attempts to save their relationship by fixing every mistake he made—while dragging his best friend along in the process.
plot:
Time Freak, also known as Time After Time, is a 2018 American science fiction romantic comedy-drama written and directed by Andrew Bowler, expanding his 2011 short film of the same name. Asa Butterfield, Sophie Turner and Skyler Gisondo star, with Will Peltz and Aubrey Reynolds in supporting roles. It opened in limited release and on digital platforms on November 9, 2018.

Stillman, a gifted physics student, is devastated when his girlfriend Debbie breaks up with him. With his best friend Evan, he catalogues the moments of their relationship into good and bad memories, trying to pinpoint what went wrong, and in the midst of his heartbreak he finally succeeds in building a working time machine. The two friends travel back to the day Stillman and Debbie met, planning to fix every mistake along the way; Stillman will know he has succeeded if Debbie's final break-up text disappears from his phone.

What follows is a series of repeated do-overs. An outing with Debbie and their friends goes badly when the others mock Stillman's favourite film and he lashes out, so he rewinds until the evening goes his way. He relives other moments again and again, from a party that turns out to be a locked rooftop to a camping trip, while Evan tries to leave messages for his future self so that he will not flunk out. When the machine malfunctions it can only move them forward, forcing Stillman to get things right in a single attempt. Eventually the text vanishes, and the friends return to the present to find Stillman and Debbie still together.

The new reality soon proves hollow. Two years later the couple are married, but Debbie has lost interest in her music, notes that they never argue about anything, and is quietly unhappy, while Evan has become addicted to using the machine. title: Drone
tagline: Choose your target wisely.
overview: Ideologies collide with fatal results when a military drone contractor meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.
plot:
Drone is a 2017 Canadian thriller directed by Jason Bourque. Sean Bean stars as Neil Wistin, a private contractor who flies drones for the CIA, with Patrick Sabongui as Imir Shaw, a Pakistani businessman, Mary McCormack as Wistin's wife Ellen, Maxwell Haynes as their son Shane and Joel David Moore as Gary.

In March 2016, a drone strike in Pakistan kills its target but also several innocent bystanders. A year later, on the anniversary of the strike, Shaw arrives in the American town where Wistin lives. Wistin is grieving his father and struggling with a eulogy and his distant son. While Wistin clears out his father's room at a care home, Shaw follows Ellen and photographs her meeting another man, revealing an affair. When Wistin returns home, he finds Shaw outside and is told that the visitor wants to buy the boat Wistin has put up for sale, which once belonged to his father. The two go inside to negotiate. At the same time, the CIA traces Shaw as the source of a leak that has exposed the identities of Wistin and other secret contract drone pilots.

Over dinner with the family, Shaw reveals that this is the first anniversary of the deaths of his wife and daughter, killed by a drone operator, and it is implied that Wistin was that operator. Wistin takes a phone call in his office, learns of the leak and checks his records for the date, which confirms his fears about his guest. When he confronts Shaw and moves to call the police, Shaw produces what appears to be a detonator and claims that the briefcase he left on the kitchen table, beside Ellen and Shane, contains explosives equivalent to a drone missile. He demands that Wistin tell his family the truth about his classified work. Wistin complies, and Shaw in turn tells him about Ellen's affair. A CIA tactical team surrounds the house and prepares to kill Shaw, but the two men start fighting, and Wistin stabs Shaw several times. As Shaw dies, Wistin discovers that there was no bomb. Changed by what he has done, Wistin publicly reveals the secret work of the CIA's contract drone operators, and he is hailed by some as a hero and condemned by others as a traitor.

 It premiered at the Vancouver International Film Festival in April 2017 and was released in U.S. theaters and on digital platforms on May 26, 2017. Reviews were generally unfavorable. Rotten Tomatoes reported 27% approval from 11 critics, and Metacritic gave it a score of 49 out of 100.

title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas

overview: Tad dreams of becoming an archaeologist traveling the world, uncovering hidden secrets and lost treasure, but his job working construction keeps him daydreaming instead of exploring. The chance of a lifetime comes when he is invited to attend archaeologist Sara Lavrof's presentation of her latest discovery - the papyrus that proves the existence of the Necklace of Midas, the legendary King who turned everything he touched into solid gold.
plot:
Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 2: El secreto del rey Midas) is a 2017 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and David Alonso, the sequel to Tad, the Lost Explorer (2012). It features the voices of Óscar Barberán as Tad and Michelle Jenner as Sara. It premiered at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June 2017 and was released in Spain by Paramount Pictures that August, later reaching the United States and United Kingdom.

Tad Stones, a construction worker who dreams of being a real archaeologist, is invited by his friend Sara Lavrof, now a renowned explorer, to a museum where she will present a papyrus proving that King Midas really existed. Before the visit Tad is reunited with Mummy, the friendly mummy from the first film, who has been thrown out of his home and travelled to find him. At the museum Tad meets Tiffany, the ambitious assistant of Sara's father, Professor Lavrof.

At a gala, Sara tells the legend of Midas: for defeating his enemies on behalf of Apollo, the king received a golden collar that gave him the power to turn everything he touched into gold. When he accidentally turned his own daughter into gold, Apollo ordered him to split the collar into three pieces and hide them in three temples, and his daughter was restored through a sacrifice of love. The villainous treasure hunter Jack Rackham and his henchmen burst in, steal the papyrus and kidnap Sara to force her to lead him to the pieces.

Tad, Tiffany and Mummy decipher notes about one of the temples and follow the kidnappers to Granada, where, after a chase through the Alhambra, they discover a secret passage under a fountain leading to a hidden temple and recover the first piece. Rackham forces them to hand it over in exchange for Sara. The search continues to Cappadocia in Turkey, where Tad finds the second piece and learns that a mountain shaped like Midas's symbol holds the last one.

Sara resolves to destroy the collar, but Tiffany betrays the group and joins Rackham. Everyone converges on the mountain, where Rackham assembles the collar and gains Midas's golden touch. In the struggle he turns Sara to gold before Tad defeats him. As Tad grieves over her, his love restores her, just as in the legend. The film earned about 35.7 million dollars worldwide against a budget of nine million euros, and won the Goya Award for Best Animated Film.

title: Serenity
tagline: On Plymouth Island, no one ever dies… unless you break the rules
overview: The quiet life of Baker Dill, a fishing boat captain who lives on the isolated Plymouth Island, where he spends his days obsessed with capturing an elusive tuna while fighting his personal demons, is interrupted when someone from his past comes to him searching for help.
plot:
Serenity is a 2019 American mystery thriller written, produced and directed by Steven Knight. It stars Matthew McConaughey as a fishing boat captain whose ex-wife asks him to kill her abusive husband, with Anne Hathaway, Diane Lane, Jason Clarke, Djimon Hounsou and Jeremy Strong. Initially announced as a "sexy noir", the film turns on a twist that recasts its tropical setting as something other than it appears.

Baker Dill runs fishing tours from the placid Plymouth Island and spends his days fixated on a giant yellowfin tuna he calls "Justice". His routine is upended when his ex-wife Karen tracks him down and pleads with him to rescue her and their young son Patrick from her wealthy, violent new husband, Frank. She offers Dill $10 million to take Frank out on a fishing trip later that week and throw him overboard. Torn between his conscience and his feelings for Karen, Dill is drawn back toward a past he had tried to escape, and the island begins to reveal strange inconsistencies. It emerges that Dill is a character in a computer game built by Patrick and modelled on his real father, John Mason, a Marine captain killed in Iraq in 2006; Patrick based the character on a memory of being taken fishing by his father at the age of three. After his widowed mother remarried an abusive man, Patrick added Karen and Frank to the game and changed its goal from catching the tuna to killing his stepfather. Realising that he and the islanders are artificial creations of his son, Dill chooses to carry out the task anyway. As he does so, Patrick confronts Frank in reality and stabs him with his father's knife. Charged with murder but released into his mother's custody pending trial, Patrick designs a new game in which he and his father are together again.

McConaughey plays Dill, Hathaway plays Karen and Clarke plays Frank, with Lane, who replaced Uma Thurman, as Dill's love interest. Produced and financed through IM Global, it was shot in Mauritius from July 2017, where funding for the production became a political scandal. After poor test screenings, Aviron Pictures cut its marketing almost entirely, and the film opened on January 25, 2019 to a $4.4 million weekend, grossing $14.4 million worldwide on a $25 million budget. Critics derided the twist, giving it 21% on Rotten Tomatoes, audiences gave it a "D+" CinemaScore, and McConaughey and Hathaway received Golden Raspberry nominations.

Benedetta is a 2021 biographical drama film directed by Paul Verhoeven, based on the life of Italian nun Sister Benedetta Monastero. The film stars Virginie Ledoyen as Benedetta and Daphne Patakia as Sister Maria Laura.

The film begins in 1967 with Benedetta, a young and ambitious nun at the Abbey of St. Radegund in Tuscany, Italy. She is assigned to care for an elderly nun named Sister Maria Laura, who has been deemed mentally unstable by the abbess. Despite initial reservations, Benedetta forms a close bond with Sister Maria Laura, who becomes her confidante and friend.

As time passes, Benedetta begins to experience strange and vivid dreams, which she attributes to demonic possession. The abbess, however, sees these episodes as evidence of Benedetta's own sinfulness and orders her to undergo exorcisms. Despite the pressure from the church authorities, Benedetta continues to see visions of a demon that she believes is trying to communicate with her.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Benedetta's experiences are not just the result of demonic possession, but also of her own repressed desires and frustrations as a woman in a patriarchal society. The film explores themes of female empowerment, spirituality, and the constraints placed on women by the Catholic Church during this time period.

Benedetta's relationship with Sister Maria Laura deepens, and they begin to share intimate moments, which are seen as taboo by the church authorities. The abbess orders Benedetta to undergo a series of exorcisms, but Benedetta refuses, citing her own faith and conviction.

The film builds towards a dramatic confrontation between Benedetta and the church authorities, who ultimately force her to leave the abbey. In a shocking twist, it is revealed that Sister Maria Laura was not just a victim of demonic possession, but also a woman who had been forced into a life of celibacy against her will.

In the end, Benedetta flees the abbey and begins a new life outside the church's control. The film ends with Benedetta, now free from the constraints of the church, embracing her own desires and spirituality, while Sister Maria Laura is shown to have found some measure of peace and redemption.

Throughout the film, Verhoeven explores themes of female agency, spirituality, and the complexities of human desire. The film's use of vivid imagery and symbolism adds depth and complexity to the narrative, making it a thought-provoking and visually stunning work of cinema.

title: Black Water
tagline: Some secrets never surface
overview: A deep cover operative awakens to find himself imprisoned on a submarine. With the help of a fellow prisoner and an amateur agent, he must race against the clock to escape the vessel and expose who set him up.
plot:
Black Water is a 2018 American action thriller directed by Pasha Patriki, starring Jean-Claude Van Damme and Dolph Lundgren in their fifth collaboration and only their second as on-screen allies. Patrick Kilpatrick, Al Sapienza, Jasmine Waltz, Aaron O'Connell, Courtney B. Turk and John Posey round out the cast. The film was released direct to video in the United States on May 25, 2018.

Scott Wheeler, a deep-cover CIA operative, wakes up as a prisoner in a secret CIA black site housed aboard a retrofitted nuclear submarine, alongside another captive named Marco. Through a series of memories he pieces together how he got there. Wheeler and his partner Melissa Ballard had been hunting for a leak within the agency using a USB drive that requires two components to operate: she carried the drive, while he kept the activation key. When armed men attacked their safe house, Ballard was apparently killed. Wheeler escaped, only to find his handler murdered, and was then captured by Agent Ferris, who believes Wheeler is responsible for the deaths of fellow agents.

Aboard the submarine, Wheeler realizes that Agent Rhodes, who claims to believe in his innocence, is in fact the traitor. Rhodes and his henchman kill the other CIA personnel and take control of the vessel's security team. Wheeler escapes and teams up with the rookie agent Cassie Taylor, while her partner Ellis Ryan is killed in an ambush. Together they force the submarine toward the surface and free Marco, a German special forces operative who knows too much to be released or killed. Rhodes plans to sell the drive, which holds information that would endanger agents around the world, and arranges an extraction in Cuba. As Wheeler and his allies fight through the narrow corridors, it is revealed that Ballard faked her death and has been working with Rhodes all along.

Writer Chad Law developed the project after producer Richard Switzer proposed an action film set on a submarine; Law and Switzer had previously worked with Lundgren on Altitude. Filming took place in early 2017, partly in Mobile, Alabama, and wrapped by the end of March. The film was poorly received, holding a 0% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes based on nine reviews, with an average score of 3.3 out of 10.

title: The Kissing Booth
tagline: She can tell her best friend anything, except this one thing
overview: When teenager Elle's first kiss leads to a forbidden romance with the hottest boy in high school, she risks her relationship with her best friend.
plot:
The Kissing Booth is a 2018 American teen romantic comedy film written and directed by Vince Marcello, based on Beth Reekles's 2012 novel of the same name. It stars Joey King as Elle Evans, a quirky late bloomer, Jacob Elordi as Noah Flynn and Joel Courtney as Noah's younger brother Lee, with Molly Ringwald in a supporting role.

Elle and Lee have been best friends since birth in Los Angeles, and they live by a set of friendship rules. After losing her mother to illness, Elle quietly nurses a crush on Lee's popular, bad-boy older brother Noah. On the first day of junior year, Noah gets into a fight with a classmate who touches Elle inappropriately, and later warns every boy at school to stay away from her. Elle and Lee organize a kissing booth for a school fundraiser, and Elle rashly promises that Noah will take part. When he does not show up, Lee takes his place and leaves with a classmate, Rachel, and a group of popular girls set Elle up to kiss an unwanted partner, but at the last moment Noah steps in and kisses the blindfolded Elle, and they kiss again in front of everyone.

Sheltering from the rain in a gazebo, Elle tells Noah she will not be just another conquest, and he admits his feelings for her. After he defends her at a beach party, they detour to the Hollywood Sign and spend their first night together, agreeing to keep the relationship secret from Lee until Elle can tell him. Elle also learns that Noah has been accepted to Harvard University. When Lee discovers them kissing, he storms off, feeling betrayed, and Elle blames Noah, who disappears from school for weeks. Elle and Lee eventually reconcile at an arcade, and she attends prom with Lee and his new girlfriend, Rachel. When Noah declares his love for her publicly at the prom, Elle runs away. At Elle and Lee's birthday costume party the next day, she confesses her love for Noah to Lee, who gives his blessing; driving off to find Noah, she discovers that the "Lee" in a Batman costume beside her is Noah himself. They spend the following weeks together before he leaves for college.

Released on Netflix on May 11, 2018, the film was panned by critics as clichéd and regressive, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 15% approval, but Netflix deemed it a major success because of its viewership and re-watch rate. It was followed by The Kissing Booth 2 in 2020 and The Kissing Booth 3 in 2021.

Vincent Zhao stars as Qi Jiguang, with Sammo Hung as General Yu Dayou and the Japanese actor Yasuaki Kurata as the samurai commander Kumasawa, alongside Wan Qian and Wu Yue.

In the 16th century, Ming forces under General Yu Dayou launch an assault on a coastal fortress held by Japanese pirates, but the attack is repulsed with heavy losses. The so-called wokou turn out to be a mixed force of masterless ronin, disaffected Chinese and a disciplined contingent of samurai led by the veteran commander Kumasawa, who has been sent by his feudal lord on a mission of his own. Nesta Cooper stars as the heroine, Dani Barnes, alongside Keith Powers as Cameron Drake, Alicia Sanz as Alexa Medina, Jake Borelli as Freddie Myers and Kate Walsh as Dr. Fiona Shively.

Dani is a straight-A student who loves dogs, volunteers at a local dog clinic and is determined to win a scholarship to the University of California, Davis. Seen as an unfashionable nerd, she has one real friend, Freddie, who secretly has feelings for her that she fails to notice, because she has been infatuated since childhood with Cameron, one of the most popular boys at school. Cameron dates Alexa, Dani's childhood best friend turned tormentor, an admired influencer with a large following across social media. When Alexa drops Cameron for another online star, Fousey, Dani and Cameron grow closer.

Suddenly Alexa wants to be friends again. She apologizes for the past, offers Dani a fresh start and draws her into her circle of extravagant shopping trips and parties. Dani enjoys the attention and new status, starts dressing and styling herself like Alexa and gradually loses her grip on what is important. She lets Freddie down by skipping his first paid gig and losing the venue for their animal rescue event, and she fails Cameron by missing his meet and his big television appearance and by staying silent about his UCLA acceptance in front of his father. Cameron breaks up with her, and Alexa then turns on her, posting a viral video that uses supposed evidence to paint Dani as a drunk and a stalker, which spawns cruel memes.

Dani's younger sister shows her support by unfollowing Alexa, and Dani patches things up with Freddie. She persuades the Bob's Big Boy restaurant to host the animal rescue event, and its success earns her the college recommendation Fiona had promised. At the senior class bonfire on the beach, where everyone gathers except Alexa, who is mourning the loss of her YouTube channel, Dani and Cameron kiss and reconcile.

The film received mostly negative reviews, holding a 40% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, while Common Sense Media gave it one star.

title: Time Trap
overview: A group of students become trapped inside a mysterious cave where they discover time passes differently underground than on the surface.
plot:
Time Trap is a 2017 science fiction action adventure film directed by Ben Foster and Mark Dennis. Brianne Howey, Cassidy Gifford, Olivia Draguicevich, Reiley McClendon and Andrew Wilson star as young people in remote Texas who search for their missing professor and enter a cave where time behaves impossibly.

Hopper, an archaeology professor, is searching for a group of hippies who vanished in the area in the 1970s while hunting for the Fountain of Youth. After spotting what looks like a cowboy frozen in place inside a cave tunnel, he dismisses his graduate students, Taylor and Jackie, and returns alone. When he fails to come back, Taylor and Jackie set out to find him, accompanied by their friend Cara, her younger sister Veeves and Veeves's friend Furby. At the cave entrance Furby stays above ground as a lookout while the others climb down a rope. Soon Furby stops answering the radio, and when Jackie tries to climb out, the rope frays and she falls, injuring herself and Taylor.

Searching for another way out, the group finds Furby dead near a second entrance. His camera footage reveals that he waited for days on the surface while barely an hour passed for those inside, and that the missing hippies were Hopper's parents and sister. Taylor realizes the cave lies inside a time distortion in which time below moves far more slowly than above. A brief trip to the barren surface leads them to conclude that thousands of years may have elapsed outside during their few hours underground.

The students encounter cavemen who have wandered into the distortion over the centuries, as well as a towering, futuristic humanoid who descends from the surface. Though he protects them and heals Taylor, he is poisoned by the cave's air, and before dying he shows them that humanity long ago abandoned a dying Earth for Mars and evolved there. Taylor finds Hopper near the heart of the phenomenon, a waterfall where his sister, Spanish conquistadors and a horde of cavemen are frozen mid-battle, and the survivors must find a way to escape the trap and return to a world that has moved on without them.

Time Trap premiered at the Seattle International Film Festival on May 19, 2017, and was released on video on demand in November 2018. Rotten Tomatoes reports that 67% of 12 critics' reviews are positive, and Metacritic assigned it 45 out of 100. The Los Angeles Times called it a handful of intriguing ideas in search of a more cohesive narrative.

overview: When Blitzen announces his retirement on December 21st, a miniature horse has 3 days to fulfill his lifelong dream of earning a spot on Santa's team at the North Pole try-outs.
plot:
Elliot: The Littlest Reindeer is a 2018 Canadian animated Christmas comedy written and directed by Jennifer Wescott. The voice cast features Josh Hutcherson as Elliot, Samantha Bee as Hazel, and Martin Short, Morena Baccarin, Jeff Dunham and John Cleese. The film follows a miniature horse who dreams of joining Santa Claus's sleigh team and gets an unexpected chance when one of the famous reindeer retires.

Elliot lives on the struggling Witty Bitty Farm in North Dakota, which operates both as a petting zoo and as a training camp for aspiring sleigh reindeer, most of whom are arrogant and self-absorbed. Elliot trains alongside them, but the farm's owner, the former baseball player Walter Whittick, barely notices him, and his only real supporter is his best friend Hazel, a sharp-witted goat. When Blitzen announces his retirement, tryouts are held at the North Pole to find a replacement, and Walter hopes that his most athletic reindeer, DJ, will win the place and save the farm from financial ruin.

At the same time, a businesswoman named Ludzinka arrives and offers to buy the petting zoo animals. Walter agrees, unaware of her real intentions, but Elliot and Hazel discover that she plans to turn the animals into dehydrated food. Hoping to win the tryouts and rescue their friends, the pair stow away in Walter's flying vehicle as he travels north with DJ. At the North Pole, Hazel uses disguises to get Elliot registered for the competition, helped by an elf named Jolene, since Santa and his elves can talk with animals. Elliot faces a series of demanding trials against much bigger and stronger competitors, while Hazel uncovers signs that Christmas itself may be headed for disaster. Back at the farm, Ludzinka threatens the lives of the animals, and Elliot must choose between pursuing his lifelong dream and saving the friends he left behind.

The film was released in Canada in November 2018 and received negative reviews, with a 29 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes. The site's consensus called it a farcical Christmas romp only slightly more entertaining than a heap of coal, and Nell Minow of RogerEbert.com gave it one and a half stars out of four. Tara McNamara of Common Sense Media was also among the critics who reviewed the film for family audiences.

Hellboy is a 2019 American superhero film based on the Dark Horse Comics character created by Mike Mignola. A reboot of the Hellboy film series and the third live-action film in the franchise, it was directed by Neil Marshall and stars David Harbour in the title role, with Milla Jovovich as the Blood Queen Nimue, Ian McShane as Professor Trevor Bruttenholm, Sasha Lane as Alice Monaghan, Daniel Dae Kim as Ben Daimio and Thomas Haden Church as Lobster Johnson. In 517 AD, the Blood Queen Vivienne Nimue unleashes a plague on Britain until King Arthur defeats her with the help of a member of her own coven, dismembering her with Excalibur and hiding her remains across the country. In the present day, Hellboy, a demon raised by humans and working as an investigator for the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense, travels to Tijuana to find a missing agent, only to discover that he has become a vampire. Back in Colorado, his adoptive father Bruttenholm sends him to Britain to help the Osiris Club hunt three giants.

During the hunt, Hellboy is betrayed by the club's hunters and nearly killed, but he defeats the giants and is rescued by Alice Monaghan, a young medium whom he once saved from fairies when she was a baby. Meanwhile, a vengeful pig-like changeling called Gruagach, aided by the witch Baba Yaga, is gathering the pieces of Nimue's body so that she can be resurrected. Joined by Alice and Major Ben Daimio of the British paranormal agency M11, who harbours a secret of his own, Hellboy learns that Nimue intends to use him to bring about the apocalypse by tempting him to embrace his destiny as the beast of the end times. Torn between the humans who fear him and the monsters who see him as their king, Hellboy must decide which side he belongs to.

Marshall's film is darker and considerably more violent than Guillermo del Toro's earlier Hellboy films, earning an R rating for its graphic gore and drawing more directly on Mignola's folklore-inspired stories.

Hellboy was panned by critics, with an approval rating of about 17 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, although Harbour's performance received some praise. It was a box-office bomb, grossing about 55.1 million dollars against a 50 million dollar budget, and the series was rebooted again in 2024 with Hellboy: The Crooked Man.

title: Game Over, Man!
overview: Three friends are on the verge of getting their video game financed when their benefactor is taken hostage by terrorists.
plot:
Game Over, Man! is a 2018 comedy film that satirizes action movies and explores themes of masculinity, friendship, and the consequences of toxic masculinity. The movie follows three friends who must save their video game developer friend from an alien invasion.

At its core, Game Over, Man! is a commentary on traditional masculine norms and the expectations placed on men to be strong and stoic. The film's protagonist, Casey (played by Adam DeVine), embodies these traits, but as the story progresses, his character is revealed to be more vulnerable and emotionally expressive than initially thought.

The movie also explores the theme of male friendship and camaraderie, highlighting the importance of relationships in times of crisis. The three friends - Casey, Dylan (played by Blake Anderson), and Nick (played by Anders Holm) - work together to save their friend, showcasing the power of teamwork and loyalty.

Furthermore, Game Over, Man! pokes fun at the conventions of action movies, exaggerating the typical hero's journey for comedic effect. The film's over-the-top action sequences and absurd plot twists serve as a commentary on the genre's tendency to prioritize spectacle over substance.

Overall, Game Over, Man! is a lighthearted, humorous take on traditional masculine norms and the importance of male friendships, using satire and absurdity to make pointed commentary on modern society.

title: Champions
tagline: When winning isn't everything
overview: A disgraced basketball coach is given the chance to coach Los Amigos, a team of players who are intellectually disabled, and soon realizes they just might have what it takes to make it to the national championships.
plot:
Champions (Spanish: Campeones) is a 2018 Spanish sports comedy-drama directed by Javier Fesser, who co-wrote it with David Marqués. Javier Gutiérrez stars as the basketball coach Marco Montes, with Athenea Mata as his wife, Sonia, and Juan Margallo as Julio, alongside a team of players with intellectual disabilities. The story was inspired by Aderes, a team from Burjassot, near Valencia, made up of people with intellectual disabilities, which won twelve Spanish championships between 1999 and 2014.

Marco is the arrogant, short-tempered assistant coach of the professional basketball club CB Estudiantes. During a game he argues with the head coach over strategy and shoves him, and is promptly fired. That same night he drives drunk into the back of a police car. In court he is given a choice between two years in prison and ninety days of community service, which will consist of coaching Los Amigos, a team of players with intellectual disabilities.

At first Marco makes no secret of his contempt for the players and refers to them with a slur. As the weeks pass, though, he comes to know each of them, their individual histories and quirks, and he is struck by their persistence and their commitment to one another. His home life, meanwhile, is strained: Sonia wants a baby, and Marco insists he is not ready. A friend of Marco's, Iván, who is attracted to Sonia, tries to manoeuvre some time alone with her, but Marco turns up anyway, and the couple leave still at odds. Travelling to away games proves chaotic, as the team's blunt and boisterous behaviour constantly clashes with fellow passengers on public transport. When Marco confides in Sonia, she borrows a camper van from a colleague at the sporting-goods shop where she works and starts travelling with the team, and their marriage begins to heal. Los Amigos fight their way to second place in the national championship, Marco agrees to start a family with Sonia, and when he returns to professional coaching the players thank him for changing their lives.

Released in Spain by Universal on 6 April 2018, it was the country's highest-grossing Spanish-language film of the year, taking €19.1 million from 3.3 million admissions. It won three Goya Awards, including Best Film and Best New Actor for Jesús Vidal, and was Spain's submission for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. It inspired a sequel and remakes in Arabic, German, English, directed by Bobby Farrelly, and Hindi.
