title: Elizabeth Harvest
overview: The newly married Elizabeth arrives with her new husband, the scientist Henry, at a magnificent house. He tells her that she can do there anything she pleases, except to enter a certain closed room.
plot:
Elizabeth Harvest is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The film follows Elizabeth, a young woman who returns to her hometown after being away for several years, only to find herself entangled in a web of secrets and lies.

At its core, Elizabeth Harvest explores the theme of trauma and its lasting impact on individuals. Elizabeth's past is shrouded in mystery, and as she tries to rebuild her life, she begins to confront the traumas that have haunted her for so long. The film masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, creating a sense of unease and tension that keeps the viewer on edge.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be manipulated and distorted by external forces. Elizabeth's perception of reality is constantly challenged, leaving the audience questioning what is real and what is just a product of her imagination. This theme is expertly handled, creating a sense of uncertainty that adds to the overall sense of unease.

Furthermore, the film explores the idea of isolation and how it can both isolate and liberate individuals. Elizabeth's return to her hometown serves as a catalyst for her journey of self-discovery, but it also forces her to confront the darkness that has been lurking beneath the surface of her small town.

Overall, Elizabeth Harvest is a thought-provoking thriller that delves into the complexities of human psychology and the darker aspects of human nature.

title: Mary Queen of Scots
tagline: Bow to No One
overview: In 1561, Mary Stuart, widow of the King of France, returns to Scotland, reclaims her rightful throne and menaces the future of Queen Elizabeth I as ruler of England, because she has a legitimate claim to the English throne. Betrayals, rebellions, conspiracies and their own life choices imperil both Queens. They experience the bitter cost of power, until their tragic fate is finally fulfilled.
plot:
Mary Queen of Scots is a 2018 historical drama film that delves into the complexities of power, identity, and the consequences of one's actions. The movie revolves around the tumultuous life of Mary Stuart, who finds herself entangled in a web of politics, romance, and betrayal.

At its core, the film explores the theme of female empowerment and the constraints placed on women in positions of power during the 16th century. Mary, as a queen, is expected to embody traditional feminine virtues, but her desire for autonomy, independence, and self-determination sets her apart from the expectations of those around her.

The movie also examines the destructive nature of ambition and the consequences of seeking power at any cost. Mary's quest for the throne of Scotland leads her down a path of deceit, manipulation, and ultimately, tragedy. The film highlights the devastating impact of these actions on not only Mary but also those around her, including her husband, Lord Darnley, and her cousin, Queen Elizabeth I.

Furthermore, the film touches upon the theme of identity and the performance of self. Mary's struggles to reconcile her Catholic faith with her royal duties serve as a metaphor for the tensions between personal conviction and public expectation. Her relationships with those around her, particularly her husband and her cousin, are also fraught with tension, as she navigates the complexities of love, loyalty, and duty.

Ultimately, Mary Queen of Scots is a film about the human cost of power and the devastating consequences of allowing ambition to consume us. The movie raises important questions about the nature of leadership, the constraints placed on women, and the enduring power of personal conviction in the face of adversity.

title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend
original_title: Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend
overview: Follow the launch of Lamborghini’s career as a manufacturer of tractors, a creator of military vehicles during World War II, and the designer of Lamborghini cars, which he launched in 1963 as the high-end sports car company Automobili Lamborghini.
plot:
Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend is a 2022 American biographical drama written and directed by Robert Moresco, starring Frank Grillo as the Italian industrialist Ferruccio Lamborghini, with Romano Reggiani as the young Ferruccio, Gabriel Byrne as Enzo Ferrari, Mira Sorvino as Lamborghini's second wife Annita, Hannah van der Westhuysen as his first wife Clelia and Fortunato Cerlino as his father Antonio. The film traces Lamborghini's rise from farmer's son to creator of one of the world's most famous sports car brands.

After the Second World War, Ferruccio and his friend Matteo return from service in the Italian Army to their hometown of Cento. Ferruccio reunites with his girlfriend Clelia and tells his father that he wants to start a business building affordable tractors, despite his father's doubts. He marries Clelia, and when he cannot raise enough money, his father gives him the family land to secure a bank loan. Ferruccio founds Lamborghini Trattori and develops a new engine, but tragedy strikes when Clelia dies in childbirth, leaving him with a son, Tonino.

The tractor business eventually becomes a success, and Ferruccio falls in love with Annita, a woman Matteo had hoped to court, causing a rift between the two friends. By 1963, Ferruccio and Annita are married and running a new venture, Automobili Lamborghini, though his relationship with his son remains strained. After being insulted by Enzo Ferrari, Ferruccio resolves to build a grand touring car that will rival Ferrari's. He recruits the engineers Giotto Bizzarrini and Giampaolo Dallara and the New Zealand test driver Bob Wallace, and the company presents the Lamborghini 350 GT at the Geneva Motor Show, launching a fierce rivalry with Ferrari.

The film portrays the ambition, stubbornness and personal sacrifices behind the Lamborghini brand, framing its story around the rivalry between two Italian automotive legends.

Lamborghini: The Man Behind the Legend was released in select theaters in the United States by Lionsgate on November 18, 2022. It was panned by critics, receiving 6 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and Mira Sorvino was nominated for Worst Supporting Actress at the 43rd Golden Raspberry Awards.

title: Rip Tide
tagline: She's a fashionista out of water...but she's about to get back in the swim of things.
overview: There comes a point in everyone’s life when you have to make a decision about the direction you’re going to take. For newly-18 American fashion model Cora, that time is now. She’s moved to an Australian coastal town to be with her favourite aunt, after a 'fashion faux pas’ back home.
plot:
Rip Tide is a 2017 Australian teen drama film directed by Rhiannon Bannenberg, produced by Steve Jaggi and written by Georgia Harrison. Debby Ryan stars as Cora Hamilton, an American model, with Naomi Sequeira, Danielle Carter, Aaron Jeffery, Jeremy Lindsay Taylor and others in supporting roles. The coming-of-age story follows a young woman who escapes the pressures of the New York fashion world by traveling to a beach town in Australia to reconnect with her family and rediscover her own ambitions. The film was released on streaming platforms in October 2017 and later became available on Netflix.

Cora is a successful but unhappy model in New York, constrained by her demanding career and by her ambitious mother and manager, Sofia, who is working to secure her a lucrative contract with a prestigious agency. At a photo shoot, Cora tries to suggest her own design ideas for an outfit, but the director dismisses her, and she storms out in tears. As she leaves, she is filmed falling down a flight of stairs, and the embarrassing video goes viral, damaging both her career and her mother's.

Seeing a birthday card from her Aunt Margot, whom she has not seen since childhood, Cora decides to fly to Australia to stay with her. After an argument with Sofia at the airport, in which Cora insists she is not running away but following where her life is leading, she travels to the small coastal town where her family has roots. There she connects with her aunt and with a group of young locals, takes to the ocean and gradually uncovers parts of her family's history that her mother never shared. Away from the pressures of modeling, she rediscovers her passion for designing clothes and begins to imagine a different future for herself, but her mother's arrival and the lure of her old life force her to decide what she really wants.

The film was produced by Steve Jaggi, whose company made a number of youth-oriented features in Australia for the international market, and it gave Ryan, known for her work on Disney Channel series, a leading role in a coming-of-age drama set against the beaches and surf culture of the Australian coast.

title: Project X-Traction
overview: When a China-run oil refinery is attacked in Mosul, Iraq, a Chinese private security contractor is called in to extract the oil workers. He learns, however, that the attackers’ real plan is to steal a fortune in oil, and teams up with an American former Marine to stop them.
plot:
Project X-Traction, released in most markets as Hidden Strike, is an action-adventure film directed and edited by Scott Waugh from a screenplay by Arash Amel, starring Jackie Chan, John Cena, Ma Chunrui and Pilou Asbæk. The project began as a pairing of Chan with Sylvester Stallone, who withdrew and was replaced by Cena. It was shot in 2018, with Chinese locations standing in for the Middle East, and Cena spent months living in Yinchuan to work on it. Before its final title, it was known variously as Ex-Baghdad, Project X, Project X-Traction and SNAFU.

In Iraq, repeated attacks by mercenaries under former special forces soldier Owen Paddock force the closure of an oil refinery owned by the Chinese firm Unicorp. Security contractor "Dragon" Luo Feng leads a convoy of eleven buses carrying its civilian staff, among them chief engineer Professor Chang, her son and his own estranged daughter Mei, along the Highway of Death toward the Green Zone. Former US Marine Chris Van Horne, who needs money to repair a well in a rural village, reluctantly joins his mercenary brother Henry in the attack. Using a jet-engined truck to raise a sandstorm, the mercenaries seize two buses and take Professor Chang and her son hostage, as Owen plans to force her to restart the refinery and steal its oil.

Disgusted, Chris turns on Owen, who murders Henry. After fighting off French mercenaries together, Feng and Chris become allies, and Feng repairs his bond with Mei. Owen threatens the village to recover the notebook of restart codes that Chris had taken by accident, and Chris hands it over to protect the villagers. When Owen sends the oil away in a convoy of fuel trucks, the heroes storm the refinery, wreck the convoy with the jet truck and drive Owen's vehicle off a cliff. Later they fix the village well, and Chris accepts Feng's invitation to join him on a new mission.

Released in July 2023, theatrically in the United Arab Emirates and some other markets and on Netflix elsewhere, it grossed under $1 million in cinemas against an $80 million budget. On Netflix it became the most-watched film worldwide in its opening weekend, with 56.8 million views in 28 days. Critics were largely negative, with 24% approval on Rotten Tomatoes and complaints about weak chemistry between the leads, although some reviewers enjoyed it as light popcorn entertainment.

plot:
Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile is a 2019 American biographical crime drama film directed by Joe Berlinger. The film is based on the memoir "Catch Me If You Can" written by Thomas H. Beeby, who was a lawyer for Ted Bundy during his trial.

The film stars Zac Efron as Ted Bundy, Lily Collins as Stephanie Brooks (Bundy's girlfriend), and Kaya Scodelario as Janice Ott (a victim of Bundy's crimes). The story begins with Ted Bundy, a charismatic and handsome young man, who is arrested in 1975 for the murder of a two-year-old girl. As he awaits trial, Bundy uses his charm to manipulate those around him, including his lawyers and the media.

As the film progresses, we see Bundy's transformation from a charming college student to a calculating serial killer. He targets young women with long hair, often using his good looks and charm to lure them into his car or onto a date. The film also explores Bundy's relationships with his family members, particularly his mother Eleanor (played by Elizabeth Banks), who is portrayed as having a complex and enabling relationship with her son.

The plot thickens as Bundy's crimes become more brazen and his notoriety grows. He uses his charm to evade capture, often leaving behind fake alibis and manipulating the police investigation. Meanwhile, Stephanie Brooks becomes increasingly concerned about Bundy's behavior and begins to distance herself from him.

As the film builds towards its climax, we see Bundy's arrest in 1978 and his subsequent trial. The film also explores the impact of Bundy's crimes on the families of his victims, particularly Janice Ott and her husband Bob (played by John Malkovich).

The ending of the film is a poignant commentary on the nature of evil and how it can be both captivating and terrifying. As Bundy awaits execution in 1989, he continues to charm and manipulate those around him, even as he faces certain death.

Throughout the film, Zac Efron delivers a nuanced performance as Ted Bundy, capturing the complexity and charisma of the serial killer. The supporting cast also delivers strong performances, particularly Lily Collins as Stephanie Brooks, who brings a sense of vulnerability and concern to her character.

Overall, Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores the complexities of human nature and the devastating consequences of evil actions.

title: Slaughterhouse Rulez
tagline: Bloodius. Hellius. Maximus.
overview: An illustrious British boarding school becomes a bloody battleground when a mysterious sinkhole appears at a nearby fracking site unleashing unspeakable horror.
plot:
Slaughterhouse Rulez is a 2018 British comedy horror film directed by Crispian Mills, who wrote it with Henry Fitzherbert. The first production from Simon Pegg and Nick Frost's company Stolen Picture, it stars Finn Cole as Don Wallace, Asa Butterfield as Willoughby Blake and Hermione Corfield as Clemsie Lawrence, with Michael Sheen as the headmaster, Pegg as housemaster Meredith Houseman and Frost as eco-campaigner Woody Chapman.

After his father's death, Don, a working-class teenager from the north of England, is sent by his widowed mother to Slaughterhouse, a venerable and exclusive boarding school, in keeping with his late father's wishes. He struggles to fit in amid the school's arcane rituals and sanctioned bullying, and the place harbors secrets: a pupil died by suicide the previous term, there have been mysterious disappearances, and an overzealous sixth-form prefect, Clegg, descends from a long line of war criminals. Don forms an uneasy alliance with his sardonic new roommate, Willoughby, an outsider bullied by the older boys, and falls for Clemsie, one of the sixth form's revered "goddesses". The ineffectual Houseman, meanwhile, pines for his former girlfriend, who is working in Africa and appears only in video calls.

To raise money, the scheming headmaster has made a deal allowing a company to frack for gas near the school, to the fury of Woody, who is camping in the woods. The drilling opens an enigmatic sinkhole, and from it emerge packs of ravenous subterranean creatures that begin attacking the faculty and devouring pupils. Don rallies a group of students to fight back against the monsters. In the end the creatures are defeated and the school is destroyed in an explosion, while the surviving pupils walk away and the headmaster's dog and Houseman, who have also survived, watch the destruction.

Shot at locations including Stowe School, Windsor Great Park and Chislehurst Caves, the film was released in the United Kingdom and Ireland on October 31, 2018, and in North America in May 2019, earning about £738,000 at the box office. Critics were mostly negative, giving it 38% on Rotten Tomatoes and 39 on Metacritic; Screen International found its story strands underdeveloped, while The Guardian credited Mills with directing "with zip" and found an amiable charm despite it being neither very scary nor very funny.

title: The Night Eats the World
original_title: La Nuit a dévoré le monde
overview: After waking up to find himself all alone in an apartment where a massive party was being held the night before, Sam is immediately forced to face a terrifying reality: the living dead have invaded the streets of Paris.
plot:
The Night Eats the World (French: La nuit a dévoré le monde) is a 2018 French English-language zombie film directed by Dominique Rocher, who wrote it with Jérémie Guez and Guillaume Lemans, based on Pit Agarman's novel of the same name. Anders Danielsen Lie stars as Sam, a man caught alone in a Paris overrun by zombies, with Golshifteh Farahani and Denis Lavant in supporting roles.

Sam, a musician, goes to his ex-girlfriend Fanny's apartment during a party to collect some tapes. After being bumped by a guest, he gets a nosebleed and passes out in the office, sleeping through sounds of chaos outside. The next morning the apartment is trashed and bloodied, and in the stairwell he finds Fanny and others transformed into zombies who charge at him. The zombies, fast and utterly silent, react in swarms to any sight or sound. A shotgun blast through the floor reveals that a man downstairs killed his infected wife and then himself, and Sam takes the gun, seals the building's doors and explores the apartments one by one, gathering supplies. He keeps a zombified elderly man, Alfred, trapped in the lift and talks to him, and plays music on equipment he finds.

As time passes, Sam grows lonely and unstable. After nearly dying trying to catch a stray cat, he fires at it in anger. Winter brings cold and cuts the water supply, and he survives on rainwater and a makeshift fireplace. Noticing the streets have emptied, he pounds a drum kit and screams, drawing a horde that almost climbs onto the balcony. One night he fires through his bedroom door and wounds a woman, Sarah, who has survived by crossing rooftops with a grappling hook. She later urges him to leave, warning that he will otherwise die or go mad, but he then finds her dead from the gunshot, revealing that their conversations were hallucinations. Among her belongings is a camera with photos of her family and of Sam on the roof. Deciding to leave, he burns his tapes and locks Alfred in an apartment, but the smoke sets off a fire alarm and zombies storm the building. Sam fights his way to the roof, swings across to the next building and gazes over the endless Paris skyline, where he briefly hears what may be another survivor.

The film premiered at the Angers Film Festival on 13 January 2018 and was released in France on 7 March. It holds 87% on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised its atmosphere and character focus, and a Metacritic score of 50.

title: Spinning Man
tagline: The only truth is knowing you know nothing.
overview: Evan Birch, a family man and esteemed philosophy professor at a distinguished college, is the prime suspect when a female student goes missing.
plot:
Spinning Man is a 2018 psychological thriller directed by Simon Kaijser from a screenplay by Matthew Aldrich, adapted from George Harrar's 2003 novel. Produced by Irish DreamTime and Chimney, with Ellen S. Wander and Keith Arnold as producers, cinematography by Polly Morgan and music by Jean-Paul Wall, it stars Guy Pearce, Pierce Brosnan and Minnie Driver, with Alexandra Shipp, Clark Gregg, Odeya Rush, Jamie Kennedy, Freya Tingley, Eliza Pryor and Noah Salsbury Lipson.

Evan Birch (Pearce) is a popular, respected philosophy professor at a distinguished college, married to Ellen (Driver) and the father of two children. Beneath his polished surface, however, he has a weakness for young women: he was once driven out of another university by scandal, has had affairs with students and constantly fantasizes about women he encounters. When Joyce Bonner (Rush), a high school cheerleader, disappears near a local lake, his past dalliances lead Ellen to doubt his alibi. The meticulous detective Robert Malloy (Brosnan) begins asking questions, and Evan's indignant refusal to let him search his car, invoking the Fourth Amendment, is only the first of many red flags. Evan insists he never met the girl, yet strands of her hair are found in his impounded car, and he turns out to have arrived forty minutes late to pick up his daughter from camp on the afternoon in question. His attraction to his admiring student Anna (Shipp) and the counsel of his cynical lawyer Paul (Gregg) complicate matters. Increasingly, Evan suffers memory lapses that are never fully explained, and he begins to justify his evasions with ideas from his lectures on the philosophy of language, arguing that truth is relative. The film deliberately keeps viewers uncertain whether he is a killer, a self-deceiving liar or simply a man who no longer trusts his own memory.

The project was first announced in 2016 with Peter Flinth directing and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, Greg Kinnear and Emma Roberts attached, but in April 2017 a new cast and director were announced, and principal photography began in May 2017. Lionsgate Premiere released the film in limited theaters and on demand on 6 April 2018. Reviews were mixed, with a 50% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 44. Variety praised Pearce's performance and Brosnan's crisp detective but felt the film's game of toying with the audience left viewers guessing without caring, while The Hollywood Reporter credited the cast as its main reason for watching.

Abandoned as a baby and found outside a church, Rémi grew up happily in a French village in the 19th century with the woman he believed to be his mother, who loved him dearly. Their life changes when her husband, a stonemason working in Paris, is badly injured in an accident and returns home embittered and in debt. Revealing that Rémi is not their son, he decides to take the boy to an orphanage to be rid of another mouth to feed.

On the way they meet Vitalis, a former violinist who now travels the countryside as a street performer with a mischievous monkey named Joli-Cœur and a loyal dog named Capi. Discovering that Rémi has a beautiful singing voice, Vitalis offers to rent the boy from his foster father, sparing him the orphanage. Rémi reluctantly sets out on the road with Vitalis and his animals, and the old musician teaches him to read, to sing and to perform. Their wanderings across France bring hardship, danger and moments of joy, including a friendship with a sickly girl and her wealthy mother. Along the way Rémi learns more about the mystery of his birth and about Vitalis's own hidden past, while the bond between the boy and his gruff mentor grows into something like that of father and son.

The film was a popular success in France and received generally positive reviews, with praise for Auteuil's performance, its photography and its faithful but accessible treatment of the classic novel, which had previously been adapted many times for film, television and animation.

The vivarium is inhabited by other human-animal hybrids, including a family with two children who seem to be the product of this breeding program. As Tom and Gemma try to understand what's happening, they are forced to participate in the breeding process, which involves a series of surreal and disturbing events.

Throughout the movie, Tom and Gemma's relationship is put to the test as they struggle to cope with their new reality. They begin to question their own humanity and the nature of their existence. The film builds up to a shocking climax as Tom and Gemma realize that they are trapped in this vivarium forever, forced to breed more hybrids until the experiment is complete.

The ending of Vivarium is intentionally ambiguous and open to interpretation. As the credits roll, we see Tom and Gemma's children growing up in the vivarium, while Tom and Gemma themselves seem to be stuck in a never-ending cycle of breeding and rebirth. The film raises questions about the ethics of scientific experimentation on human subjects and the consequences of playing God.

Overall, Vivarium is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that explores themes of identity, humanity, and the consequences of scientific hubris. With its unique blend of sci-fi horror and social commentary, it has become a cult classic among fans of the genre.

title: Monster Hunter
tagline: Behind our world, there is another.
overview: A portal transports Cpt. Artemis and an elite unit of soldiers to a strange world where powerful monsters rule with deadly ferocity. Faced with relentless danger, the team encounters a mysterious hunter who may be their only hope to find a way home.
plot:
Monster Hunter is a 2020 action fantasy film written, directed and produced by Paul W. S. Anderson, based on Capcom's video game series. It stars Milla Jovovich, in her sixth film with her husband Anderson, as U.S. Army Ranger Captain Natalie Artemis, with Tony Jaa as the Hunter and Ron Perlman as the Admiral, alongside T.I., Meagan Good, Diego Boneta, Josh Helman and MC Jin as members of Artemis's squad. The film follows soldiers transported to a hostile world ruled by gigantic monsters.

In a parallel world, humans struggle to survive among huge, savage creatures. A warrior known as the Hunter is separated from the Admiral's crew when their ship is attacked by the Diablos, an enormous horned beast that tunnels beneath the dunes. On Earth, Artemis and her United Nations security team are searching the desert for a missing squad of soldiers when a sudden storm pulls them through a dimensional portal into the new world, where they find the charred remains of the soldiers they were looking for.

The team's bullets and grenades prove useless against the Diablos, and the survivors take refuge in a cave, only to be attacked by spider-like monsters called Nerscylla. Artemis escapes alone and encounters the Hunter. After fighting each other, the two grudgingly agree to cooperate. She learns that the portals are created by the Sky Tower, a structure across the desert, and that they must kill the Diablos to cross safely. Learning to use the Hunter's weapons, Artemis helps him lay a trap for the beast, and their journey eventually leads them to the Admiral and his crew, and into a deadly confrontation with the fire-breathing Rathalos, which threatens to break through the portal into our world.

The film emphasizes large-scale creature battles and visual effects, borrowing monsters and characters from the game Monster Hunter: World.

Monster Hunter opened in China on December 4, 2020, and in the United States on December 18 amid the COVID-19 pandemic. It was a box office bomb, grossing 47.9 million dollars against a 60 million dollar budget, and received mixed reviews, with 44 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 47; critics praised the action and effects but faulted the direction and editing.

title: Us

overview: Husband and wife Gabe and Adelaide Wilson take their kids to their beach house expecting to unplug and unwind with friends. But as night descends, their serenity turns to tension and chaos when some shocking visitors arrive uninvited.
plot:

The film begins with Adelaide Wilson (Lupita Nyong'o), a young girl who, as a child, escapes from a haunted house at a carnival in Santa Cruz, California. The experience leaves her with a traumatic memory that she tries to suppress.

Years later, Adelaide is now an adult and living in the suburbs with her husband Gabe (Winston Duke) and their son Jason (Evan Alex). They are preparing for a family vacation to the same Santa Cruz beach where Adelaide had her terrifying childhood experience. Unbeknownst to them, this trip will bring about a series of events that will change their lives forever.

Upon arrival at the beach, Adelaide begins to feel an inexplicable sense of unease and disconnection from her surroundings. She starts to notice strange occurrences around her, which she initially dismisses as mere coincidence. However, it soon becomes clear that something is amiss.

As the night falls, a group of masked figures emerges from the shadows, revealing themselves to be Adelaide's doppelgangers, known as "the Tethered." The Tethered are identical in appearance to their human counterparts but have been living underground for years, feeding on the fear and suffering of those above ground.

The Tethered, led by Red (Lupita Nyong'o), begin to terrorize Adelaide's family, using their knowledge of the Wilsons' deepest fears against them. As the night wears on, it becomes clear that the Tethered are not just mindless monsters but rather a manifestation of the darker aspects of human nature.

As the situation spirals out of control, Adelaide is forced to confront her own dark past and the trauma she has been trying to suppress. She also begins to realize that the Tethered are not just random duplicates but rather a product of a sinister experiment designed by the government to create an army of mindless drones.

In the end, Adelaide must make a choice between saving herself or saving her family. In a shocking twist, she decides to sacrifice herself to save her loved ones, using her knowledge of the Tethered's weaknesses to defeat them.

The film ends with Adelaide and her family escaping from the beach, but not before Red reveals that there are more Tethered out there, waiting to be unleashed. The final shot is of a group of children playing in the park, unaware of the horrors that lie beneath their feet.

Throughout the movie, Peele explores themes of identity, class, and the duality of human nature. The film's use of horror elements serves as a metaphor for the darker aspects of society, highlighting the ways in which we often turn on each other when faced with fear and uncertainty.

Overall, Us is a thought-provoking and terrifying film that challenges audiences to confront their own fears and insecurities. With its clever plot twists and outstanding performances, it has become a modern horror classic.

title: Hotel Transylvania: Puppy!
tagline: A Hotel Transylvania Short
overview: The residents of Hotel Transylvania find their world turned upside-down when youngster Dennis gets a surprise monster-sized pet.
plot:
Hotel Transylvania: Puppy!, released simply as Puppy!, is a 2017 American computer-animated comedy short film written and directed by Genndy Tartakovsky and produced by Michelle Murdocca for Sony Pictures Animation, with distribution by Columbia Pictures. Set in the world of the Hotel Transylvania films, it was shown at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival in June 2017 and then released in cinemas that summer as the opening short before The Emoji Movie. Tartakovsky made the short while also working on Hotel Transylvania 3: Summer Vacation, and it takes place between the second and third features, serving as a teaser for the latter.

The short opens with little Dennis begging his parents, Mavis and Johnny, for a puppy. Mavis gently refuses, explaining that a pet is a big responsibility, and when Johnny suggests a goldfish instead, the heartbroken boy turns into a bat and flies off wailing that he wants a puppy. Dracula finds his grandson sulking on a window ledge and, unable to resist the boy's pleading face, agrees to get him one. Soon a knock at the door is followed by an enormous blue dog bursting into the family's living room, flattening Dracula against a wall. Dennis is overjoyed and names his new friend Tinkles, while Mavis glares at her father, who insists that every monster needs a good pet, and then discovers that the giant puppy has already had an accident on her floor.

The next night, Mavis asks a sleepy Dracula to look after Tinkles while she takes Dennis to school. The count barely gets back into his coffin before the dog wakes him needing to go outside, then demands to be fed. Dracula brings a wheelbarrow of meat and puts the animal through a series of tricks, which goes well until he commands Tinkles to speak and the dog replies, "Hi. How are you?" Back at the front desk, Dracula grows ever more exasperated by the huge pet looming behind him, and when a family of skeletons checks in, Tinkles lunges at them and starts chewing their bones, wrecking the lobby. Returning with Dennis, Mavis is horrified by the chaos and asks what happened; Dracula simply points to the dog, and the short ends with him sighing to the audience that he needs a vacation, a nod to the next film, also hinted at by the cruise brochure Mavis reads.

The voice cast reunites Adam Sandler as Dracula, Selena Gomez as Mavis, Andy Samberg as Johnny and Asher Blinkoff as Dennis, with Joe Whyte as the voice of Tinkles and Rose Abdoo as the hotel's witch maids.

overview: Two sisters are trapped under the fiberglass cover of an Olympic sized public pool and must brave the cold and each other to survive the harrowing night.
plot:
12 Feet Deep, originally titled The Deep End, is a 2017 American psychological horror thriller written and directed by Matt Eskandari. Alexandra Park and Nora-Jane Noone star as sisters who become trapped beneath the fibreglass cover of an Olympic-sized public swimming pool, with Diane Farr and Tobin Bell in supporting roles. The film was released by Mar Vista Entertainment in June 2017 and received generally positive reviews.

Bree goes for a swim at a local aquatic centre just before it closes for the holidays and is joined by her sister Jonna, a recovering drug addict who has been clean for three months. Meanwhile, the pool manager, McGradey, catches the janitor Clara, an ex-convict on parole, stealing from the lost-and-found box and fires her, before announcing that the facility is closing. As the swimmers pack up, Bree realises that her engagement ring is missing, and the sisters spot it stuck in a grate at the bottom of the deep end. While they dive to retrieve it, McGradey, unaware that anyone is still in the water, activates the motorised pool cover and leaves the building for the holiday weekend.

Trapped in the dark between the water and the heavy cover, with only a small opening to breathe through, Bree and Jonna try desperately to break free. Their situation worsens as the water grows colder and Bree, who is diabetic, begins to need her insulin. title: Feed
tagline: Control yourself
overview: Olivia and Matthew Grey, 18-year-old twins born into a world of privilege and high expectations. There are almost no boundaries between them - even their dreams are connected.
plot:
Feed is a 2017 American drama film directed by Tommy Bertelsen and written and produced by Troian Bellisario, who also stars. Inspired by Bellisario's own experience of anorexia, which she overcame, it follows a high school senior whose physical and mental health, grades and relationships collapse after the death of her twin brother. Bellisario plays Olivia "Liv" Grey, with Tom Felton as her twin, Matt, Ben Winchell as her crush Julian, James Remar and Paula Malcomson as their parents, Tom and Samantha, and David Warshofsky as Dr. Rothstein.

The twins Olivia and Matt are as close as they are different. Liv, a would-be valedictorian, strives for excellence, which her father seems to demand of her far more than of her fraternity-bound brother, yet easygoing Matt is also the one who looks out for her, sometimes overprotectively. After a Halloween party, Matt argues with Liv over her decision to get drunk and hook up with their friend Julian, and he crashes the car they are riding in and dies. Unable to bear her guilt alone, Liv begins to see Matt, or a hostile version of him, at the moments she most needs him. This phantom tells her what to do, what to say and what to think, and above all when not to eat; Liv imagines that she is saving her food for Matt, who can live on only if she makes the sacrifice. While she tries to keep up a facade of normality, her health deteriorates, and after a suicide attempt during a party hosted by her parents, she is sent to an inpatient treatment center for eating disorders. Even there Matt torments her, pushing her to lie to her therapists and to hide food for him against the center's rules. In a therapy session, Liv finally speaks honestly about how she has been feeling, sending Matt's ghost into a rage in which he screams that he hates her and never loved her. After confronting him, she lets go of this version of her brother and recognizes that the voice urging her to control her eating was never really his.

Bellisario began writing the script at 23, about four years after being hospitalized for anorexia, and developed it over roughly eight years, describing the film as inspired by her illness rather than autobiographical. It marked her debut as a writer and producer, and she worked closely with her former therapist while making it, an experience she called both therapeutic and inflammatory. The film was released on video on demand and digital platforms on 18 July 2017.

title: Long Shot
tagline: Unlikely but not impossible.
overview: Journalist Fred Flarsky reunites with his childhood crush, Charlotte Field, now one of the most influential women in the world. As she prepares to make a run for the Presidency, Charlotte hires Fred as her speechwriter — much to the dismay of her trusted advisers.
plot:
Long Shot is a 2019 American romantic comedy film directed by Jonathan Levine and written by Dan Sterling. The movie stars Seth Rogen, Charlize Theron, O'Shea Jackson Jr., Bob Odenkirk, and June Diane Raphael.

The story begins with Fred Flarsky (Seth Rogen), a charismatic but unemployed journalist who has been living in his parents' basement since the 1990s. He is still close to his childhood friend Charlotte Field (Charlize Theron), who is now a successful and ambitious Secretary of State under President Andrew Dixon (Bob Odenkirk).

Years later, Fred receives an invitation from Charlotte to attend her inauguration as the new Secretary of State. During the event, they reconnect, and it becomes clear that their friendship has evolved into something more. However, their social differences and past traumas make a romantic relationship complicated.

As they spend more time together, Fred is drawn back into his old life, including his job at a tabloid newspaper and his relationships with his eccentric family members. Meanwhile, Charlotte's team is working to pass the "Global Health Security Act," which aims to strengthen international cooperation on pandemics.

Despite their growing feelings for each other, Fred struggles to balance his desire for romance with his own sense of identity and purpose. He also faces challenges from his friends and family, who are skeptical about his relationship with Charlotte due to her high-profile position and his lack of ambition.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Charlotte's past is marked by trauma and a complicated relationship with her father, who was a politician. Her desire for power and control stems from a need to prove herself and overcome her insecurities.

Throughout the film, Fred and Charlotte navigate their feelings for each other while also confronting their personal demons. They must decide whether their love can overcome their differences and help them grow as individuals.

The movie culminates with a dramatic speech by Charlotte at the United Nations, where she advocates for global cooperation on pandemics. Meanwhile, Fred's past comes back to haunt him in unexpected ways, forcing him to confront his own insecurities and doubts.

Ultimately, Fred and Charlotte find a way to reconcile their differences and make their relationship work. The film ends with a heartwarming moment of intimacy between the two leads, as they finally find happiness together.

Overall, Long Shot is a charming and witty romantic comedy that explores themes of identity, power, and love. With strong performances from its leads, the movie delivers a satisfying and entertaining ride for audiences.

title: Truth or Dare
tagline: First you play the game, then the game plays you.
overview: A harmless game of "Truth or Dare" among friends turns deadly when someone—or something—begins to punish those who tell a lie—or refuse the dare.
plot:
Truth or Dare is a 2018 American supernatural horror film directed by Jeff Wadlow and written by Michael Renison and Wadlow. The movie follows a group of friends who embark on a trip to Mexico, where they participate in a traditional game called "Truth or Dare," which has a dark and sinister twist.

The story begins with a flashback of the main character, Olivia Barron (Lena Headey), as a teenager, playing Truth or Dare with her friends. The game is presented as a harmless tradition, but it ultimately leads to tragedy. The movie then jumps forward in time to show Olivia's daughter, Lucy (Bailee Madison), who is now a college student.

Lucy and her friends - Lucas (Tyler Posey), Ronnie (Violett Beane), Mark (Sam Lerner), and Tyson (Haley Lu Richardson) - are on a trip to Mexico for spring break. They decide to play Truth or Dare, which is presented as a fun and exciting game by their friend, Olivia's sister, Kate (Natalia Dyer). However, things take a dark turn when they realize that the game has a sinister force behind it.

As the night progresses, the group starts to experience strange and terrifying events. They are forced to participate in increasingly disturbing challenges, which seem to be connected to an ancient ritual. The group soon realizes that they are trapped in a supernatural cycle of horror, where they must play the game or face dire consequences.

The movie builds up to a thrilling climax as Lucy and her friends try to survive the night and uncover the truth behind the game. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including creepy creatures and supernatural entities. The group's dynamics are also put to the test as they struggle to work together and trust each other.

Throughout the movie, there are several twists and turns that keep the audience guessing. The film's climax features a shocking revelation about Lucy's connection to the game and the true nature of the sinister force behind it. In the end, only one member of the group survives, leaving the others to face their fate.

Overall, Truth or Dare is a tense and suspenseful horror movie that explores themes of friendship, loyalty, and the dangers of playing with forces beyond human control. The film's use of supernatural elements and creepy atmosphere creates a thrilling experience for viewers.

The main theme of Heavy Trip revolves around the transformative power of music, particularly heavy metal, on the protagonist's life. As Justin delves deeper into the world of heavy metal, he finds solace and empowerment through the genre's raw energy and rebellious spirit. The film explores how music can be a catalyst for self-discovery, creativity, and rebellion against societal norms.

Through Justin's journey, the movie also touches on themes of adolescence, identity, and the struggles of growing up. As Justin navigates his relationships with family and friends, he must confront his own insecurities and find his place in the world. The film's portrayal of these themes is often humorous and lighthearted, but also nuanced and relatable.

Furthermore, Heavy Trip critiques the excesses of the heavy metal subculture, particularly its tendency towards pretentiousness and elitism. The movie pokes fun at the genre's stereotypes and conventions, while also acknowledging its power to inspire creativity and community.

Overall, Heavy Trip is a heartwarming and humorous coming-of-age story that celebrates the transformative power of music and the importance of embracing one's individuality.

title: Burn Out
overview: Tony, a promising young motorcycle racer, is forced to do perilous drug runs to save the mother of his child from a dangerous mobster.
plot:
Burn Out is a 2017 French and Belgian action thriller written and directed by Yann Gozlan, based on Jérémie Guez's 2012 novel Balancé dans les cordes. François Civil stars as a young motorcycle racer drawn into the drug trade, with Olivier Rabourdin, Manon Azem, Samuel Jouy and Narcisse Mame in supporting roles. It competed at the Noir in Festival in Italy in December 2017 and was released theatrically in France by Gaumont on 3 January 2018.

Tony Rodrigues dreams of breaking into professional superbike racing. When he is not training, he works days as a forklift operator and looks after his young son Sofiane while his former partner Leyla searches for work. One day Tony passes a group of gang members, led by a man named Jordan, leaving Leyla's apartment, and finds her beaten and her home ransacked. She confesses that she had been storing drugs for Jordan and that the stash was stolen by an ex-boyfriend, leaving her with a debt she cannot pay. Determined to protect her, Tony turns to his childhood friend Moussa, now a local gang leader, who helps arrange a meeting with Jordan.

Jordan dismisses him, but Jordan's boss Miguel sees an opportunity in Tony's riding skills. To clear Leyla's debt, Tony must work as a courier for two months, delivering drugs across the city on his motorcycle within strict two-hour windows. The nighttime runs push him to exhaustion, and the strain costs him both his day job and his tryout with a racing team. When the agreed period ends, Jordan changes the terms and insists Tony keep working indefinitely, and in a burst of rage Tony beats him to death with his helmet. With Moussa's help, Tony disposes of the body and devises a dangerous plan to get rid of Miguel, offering his friend Miguel's business in exchange. The scheme goes wrong when Miguel learns the truth about Jordan, but Moussa's gang rescues Tony and kills Miguel. Back in a quiet life as a warehouse worker, Tony finds he cannot let go of the thrill, and the film ends with him provoking a police chase on his bike.

The film earned about $1.1 million at the French box office and premiered in North America at the COLCOA French Film Festival in April 2018. Netflix acquired worldwide rights outside France and released it in March 2019. Critics praised its propulsive motorcycle sequences and tension while noting its familiar premise. A Spanish remake, Centauro, was released on Netflix in 2022.

"5 Headed Shark Attack" is a campy, over-the-top thriller that explores the theme of chaos and anarchy in the face of nature's fury. The movie takes a straightforward premise - a massive shark attack on a beach town - and amplifies it to absurd levels, creating a sense of pandemonium that permeates every aspect of the story.

At its core, "5 Headed Shark Attack" is a film about the breakdown of societal order in the face of catastrophic events. The shark's arrival sets off a chain reaction of panic, destruction, and mayhem, as the characters struggle to cope with the sheer scale of the disaster unfolding before them.

The movie also touches on the theme of human hubris and the dangers of underestimating nature. The scientists and experts who initially dismiss the shark as a minor threat are ultimately proven wrong, highlighting the limitations of human knowledge and the unpredictability of the natural world.

Furthermore, "5 Headed Shark Attack" can be seen as a commentary on the voyeuristic tendencies of modern society. The characters' fascination with the shark's attacks serves as a metaphor for our own morbid curiosity about violence and disaster, which can often lead to a sense of detachment and disconnection from the consequences of our actions.

Overall, "5 Headed Shark Attack" is a tongue-in-cheek, B-movie thriller that uses its absurd premise to explore themes of chaos, anarchy, and the dangers of underestimating nature.

title: Close
tagline: Trained to protect. Born to survive.
overview: A counter-terrorism expert takes a job protecting a young heiress. After an attempted kidnapping puts both of their lives in danger, they must flee.
plot:
Close is a 2019 British action thriller directed by Vicky Jewson and starring Noomi Rapace as a professional bodyguard, a role modelled on Jacquie Davis, one of the world's leading female close protection officers, whose clients have included J. K. Rowling and Nicole Kidman. Sophie Nélisse plays the heiress she is hired to protect and Indira Varma her stepmother, with Eoin Macken and Akin Gazi. Netflix released it on 18 January 2019.

On an assignment in South Sudan, the close protection officer Sam Carlson saves the two journalists in her care when their convoy is ambushed. Meanwhile Zoe Tanner, the rebellious daughter of the recently deceased tycoon Eric Tanner, learns that her father has left her his controlling shares in Hassine Mining, to the fury of her stepmother Rima Hassine, whose family founded the firm and who now runs it. With Rima close to concluding a huge phosphate mining deal, she insists that Zoe stay with her at the family's fortified estate in Morocco and hires Sam to guard her, after Zoe's previous bodyguard was dismissed for sleeping with her.

On their first night at the remote kasbah, the security system is overridden, sealing everyone inside, and armed men kill most of the guards, including the head of security, Alik. Sam gets Zoe out, and the pair are picked up by police officers, but Zoe, who speaks Arabic, hears them talking about a private address and payment. Sam fights them off, Zoe shoots one, and the two flee into Casablanca. As news of the attack sends Hassine shares tumbling, a rival company, Sikong, closes in on the deal.

Sam's boss and former lover Conall joins them with a plan to escape to Spain by ferry, but he is killed when gunmen storm their hotel, and Sam kills two attackers in a brutal fight. Without passports, Sam and Zoe go to the company's headquarters and see Rima meeting one of the suspicious men. Following him to a marina, Sam kills him and discovers that he was a policeman with Rima's access codes to the house's security system, leading them to suspect her.

Sheltering in the abandoned house, Zoe learns that Sam gave up a child for adoption as a teenager. Rima, alerted that her login is being used, abandons the signing and flies in, revealing that Sikong has been blackmailing her and that she never ordered the attacks. Corrupt officers and mercenaries attack, and Sam and Zoe save her. Sam heads home, promising to call her daughter. Reviews were mixed, with 35% approval on Rotten Tomatoes.

plot:
Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City is a 2021 horror film directed by Johannes Roberts, based on the popular video game series of the same name. The movie takes place in 1998 and follows two main characters: Chris Redfield (Keanu Reeves) and Jill Valentine (Milla Jovovich).

The story begins with a mysterious virus outbreak in Raccoon City, which is home to the Umbrella Corporation, a powerful biotechnology company. As the virus spreads rapidly, the city descends into chaos, and the authorities are powerless to stop it.

Chris Redfield, a member of an elite law enforcement agency known as S.T.A.R.S., is sent to Raccoon City to investigate the outbreak. He soon discovers that the virus is not just a simple biological agent but a highly contagious and deadly pathogen created by Umbrella's sinister experiments.

Meanwhile, Jill Valentine, also a member of S.T.A.R.S., arrives in Raccoon City with her partner, Rebecca Chambers (Avan Jogia). As they try to contain the outbreak, they are ambushed by hordes of undead creatures, including zombies and more terrifying monsters known as "T-virus" infected humans.

As Chris and Jill navigate the treacherous streets of Raccoon City, they uncover a sinister plot by Umbrella to cover up their involvement in the outbreak. The company's true intentions are revealed, and the two protagonists must fight for survival against not only the undead but also the corporation's ruthless agents.

Throughout the movie, Roberts pays homage to the original Resident Evil games while introducing new characters and storylines. The film features plenty of action, suspense, and horror elements, making it a thrilling ride for fans of the franchise.

However, some fans may notice that the movie deviates from the original storyline in certain ways, particularly with regards to Jill's character development and the ending. Nevertheless, Welcome to Raccoon City remains an entertaining adaptation that stays true to the spirit of the Resident Evil series.

Overall, Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City is a fun, action-packed horror film that will appeal to fans of the franchise and newcomers alike.

title: Mortal Kombat

overview: Washed-up MMA fighter Cole Young, unaware of his heritage, and hunted by Emperor Shang Tsung's best warrior, Sub-Zero, seeks out and trains with Earth's greatest champions as he prepares to stand against the enemies of Outworld in a high stakes battle for the universe.

title: Operation Red Sea
overview: A squad of the Jiaolong Commando Unit - Sea Dragon, a spec ops team of the Chinese Navy, carries out a hostage rescue operation in the nation of Yewaire, on the Arabian Peninsula, and fiercely fights against local rebel groups and Zaka, a terrorist organization.
plot:
Operation Red Sea is a 2018 Chinese war film directed by Guan Hu, produced by Bona Film Group, and starring Donnie Yen, Terry Ma, and Yang Mi. The movie is based on the true story of the Chinese People's Liberation Army Navy's (PLAN) rescue operation during the 2009 Haiti earthquake.

The film begins with a dramatic sequence showing the devastating effects of the earthquake on Haiti, followed by an introduction to the main characters: Captain Wang (Donnie Yen), a seasoned and respected naval officer; his team, including Lieutenant Liang (Terry Ma) and Lieutenant Zhang (Yang Mi); and their commander, Admiral Shen (Liu Haoran).

The story takes place in 2009, when Haiti is hit by a massive earthquake. The Chinese government receives a distress call from the Haitian government for help, and Captain Wang's team is dispatched to assist in the rescue efforts.

Upon arrival, the Chinese naval team discovers that the situation on the ground is chaotic, with many survivors trapped under the rubble of collapsed buildings. The team quickly gets to work, using their expertise and equipment to locate and extract those in need.

As the operation unfolds, Captain Wang's leadership skills are put to the test as he navigates the treacherous terrain and makes tough decisions to prioritize the rescue efforts. Meanwhile, Lieutenant Liang struggles with his own demons, which threaten to undermine his performance and compromise the mission.

Throughout the film, Guan Hu masterfully weaves together action-packed sequences, heart-wrenching moments of human drama, and poignant reflections on the true meaning of sacrifice and duty. The cinematography is stunning, capturing the intensity of the rescue efforts and the emotional toll on the characters.

As the operation reaches its climax, Captain Wang's team faces numerous challenges, including treacherous terrain, limited resources, and personal conflicts. However, through their collective effort and unwavering commitment to their mission, they manage to save countless lives and bring hope to those in need.

The film concludes with a powerful tribute to the bravery and selflessness of the Chinese naval personnel who participated in the rescue operation. The final shot is of Captain Wang, standing alone on the deck of his ship, looking out at the sea, as the sound of sirens and the cries of the rescued fill the air.

Operation Red Sea is a gripping and emotionally charged film that showcases the heroism and sacrifice of the Chinese people during one of the most devastating humanitarian crises of the 21st century. With its stunning action sequences, poignant character development, and powerful themes, this movie is a must-see for fans of war dramas and those interested in exploring the complexities of human nature under extreme circumstances.

overview: Jackie Chan stars as a hardened special forces agent who fights to protect a young woman from a sinister criminal gang. At the same time, he feels a special connection to the young woman, like they met in a different life.
plot:
Bleeding Steel is a 2017 Chinese science fiction action film written and directed by Leo Zhang and starring Jackie Chan as Lin Dong, with Ouyang Nana, Show Lo, Erica Xia-Hou, Callan Mulvey and Tess Haubrich. Largely set and filmed in Sydney, Australia, the cyberpunk-styled story combines gunfights and martial arts with themes of biotechnology and cybernetic enhancement.

Hong Kong special agent Lin Dong is racing to the hospital to see his young daughter Xixi, who is critically ill with leukemia, when he is called away to protect Dr. James, a scientist and key witness in danger. As his unit escorts the doctor, who has injected himself with an experimental substance, they are ambushed by soldiers in black armor led by the monstrous Andre. Most of the unit is killed, and Lin is badly wounded before he manages to stop Andre with a massive explosion. While he lies injured, he learns that his daughter has died.

Thirteen years later in Sydney, author Rick Rogers publishes a novel called Bleeding Steel about a soldier implanted with a mechanical heart. A young hacker, Li Sen, breaks into Rogers's hotel suite to steal information about the book, but a mysterious woman in black arrives and tortures the author to learn the source of his story. The trail leads to Nancy, a young woman plagued by nightmares about laboratory experiments, who is being hunted by Andre, now a cyborg, and his forces. Lin Dong, who has been secretly watching over Nancy, must protect her, uncover the truth behind her visions and her connection to his past, and confront the enemy he thought he had destroyed, in a series of chases and fights that culminate in a climactic battle in Sydney.

The film was one of several Chinese productions seeking to blend Hollywood-style science fiction with Chan's trademark stunt-driven action.

Bleeding Steel was released in China on 22 December 2017 and in the United States by Lionsgate Premiere in theaters and on video on demand on 6 July 2018. It received mostly negative reviews, with 22 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes; the South China Morning Post called it a new low for Chan. It grossed about 48.8 million dollars worldwide and was considered a box-office disappointment.

title: I Feel Pretty
tagline: Change everything Without changing anything.
overview: A head injury causes a woman to develop an extraordinary amount of confidence and believe she's drop dead gorgeous.
plot:
I Feel Pretty is a 2018 American romantic comedy film directed by Abby Kohn and Marc Silverstein, produced by Universal Pictures.

The movie follows the story of Renee Bennett (played by Amy Schumer), a young woman who struggles with body image issues. She feels like she's stuck in a rut in her life, feeling unfulfilled and unhappy with her appearance. One day, while on a yoga retreat, Renee has an accident that leaves her with a severe head injury, which causes her to wake up from a coma with amnesia.

As Renee slowly regains her memories, she discovers that she's been living someone else's life. She finds out that the person she was living as is actually a successful businesswoman named Daphne (played by Michelle Williams), who has a loving husband and two children. Feeling like an imposter, Renee decides to take on Daphne's identity and start her new life.

Initially, Renee struggles to adjust to her new life, but she eventually finds success in her career as a fashion designer. She also starts dating a wealthy businessman named Josh (played by Tom Hiddleston), who is initially unaware of the fact that he's dating someone else.

As Renee navigates her new life, she begins to realize that Daphne was not as perfect as she seemed. She discovers that Daphne had her own set of problems and insecurities, which made her feel like she needed to put on a mask to hide them. This realization makes Renee question whether she's truly happy in her new life or if she's just pretending to be someone else.

Throughout the movie, Renee grapples with the idea of identity and self-acceptance. She struggles to reconcile her old life as Renee with her new life as Daphne, and ultimately comes to a realization that true happiness comes from within. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Renee embracing her true self and finding love in the process.

The film features a strong performance from Amy Schumer, who brings depth and nuance to the character of Renee. The supporting cast, including Michelle Williams and Tom Hiddleston, add to the humor and heart of the movie. Overall, I Feel Pretty is a charming and relatable comedy that explores themes of identity, self-acceptance, and the power of embracing one's true self.

title: Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars
overview: Federation trooper Johnny Rico is ordered to work with a group of new recruits on a satellite station on Mars, where giant bugs have decided to target their next attack.
plot:
Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars is a 2017 Japanese computer-animated military science fiction film directed by Shinji Aramaki and Masaru Matsumoto and written by Edward Neumeier, the screenwriter of the original 1997 film. A sequel to Starship Troopers: Invasion (2012) and the fifth installment of the franchise, it marks the return of Casper Van Dien as Johnny Rico, a role he played in the first and third films, and Dina Meyer as Dizzy Flores from the original film. The voice cast also includes DeRay Davis, Justin Doran and Luci Christian. It received a one-night theatrical release in the United States in August 2017 before its home-video release.

After the events of Invasion, Rico has been demoted to colonel and reassigned to a space station orbiting Mars, where he is ordered to train a group of new and largely incompetent recruits. On Mars, support for the war against the Arachnids is low; the colonists, untouched by the conflict, even talk of withdrawing from it, and their complacency leaves them unprepared for a full-scale bug invasion.

Unknown to almost everyone, Sky Marshal Amy Snapp has long known that a bug nest has been growing beneath the surface of Mars, and she plans to exploit the coming attack to win support for destroying the entire planet. She launches a massive fleet attack on the Arachnid Quarantine Zone as a distraction, intending to capture General Carl Jenkins and use a planet-destroying Q-bomb on Mars, then blame Jenkins for the catastrophe. When the bugs strike, Rico and his recruits survive the initial assault and reach the planet's surface. As Snapp seizes Jenkins and cuts communications between Earth and Mars, Jenkins manages to reach Carmen Ibanez telepathically and urge her to return to Mars. Rico and his troopers, rescued by a dropship, must fight their way through the bug hordes and expose Snapp's plan before the Federation destroys the planet and everyone on it.

The film retained the satirical tone of Neumeier's original screenplay, with mock propaganda broadcasts and pointed commentary on militarism and political manipulation. Critical response was limited and mostly negative: of the four reviews collected by Rotten Tomatoes, one was positive and three negative, although the return of Van Dien and Meyer to the franchise attracted attention from longtime fans of the 1997 film.

title: Olaf's Frozen Adventure
overview: Olaf is on a mission to harness the best holiday traditions for Anna, Elsa, and Kristoff.
plot:
Olaf's Frozen Adventure is a 2017 animated film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. The movie takes place three years after the events of the first film, Frozen.

The story begins with Anna and Elsa preparing for Christmas at Arendelle Palace. However, Elsa has lost touch with her magical powers due to a magical curse that prevents her from using them during the holiday season. According to an ancient tradition, whoever finds the true spirit of Christmas will be granted a single wish.

Anna, determined to help her sister, sets out on a journey to find the next generation's "true spirit of Christmas." She is joined by Olaf, who has become more self-aware and curious about his origins. Together, they embark on a quest to find the correct answer to the question posed by the curse: what is the true meaning of Christmas?

As they travel through various lands, including Arendelle, Northuldra, and the forest, Anna and Olaf encounter different characters who share their own stories and traditions about Christmas. Along the way, they learn valuable lessons about friendship, love, and the importance of family.

One of the main characters they meet is Prince Hans, who has become a more complex character in this film. He is struggling to find his place in Arendelle and is searching for a way to redeem himself after his past mistakes.

As Anna and Olaf near their destination, they discover that the true spirit of Christmas is not just about gifts or decorations but about kindness, generosity, and love. They also learn that Elsa's powers are still present within her, even if she can't use them during the holiday season.

The climax of the film takes place at a grand Christmas celebration in Arendelle, where Anna and Olaf finally find the correct answer to the curse. However, it is not what they expected. The true spirit of Christmas is revealed to be a combination of all the different traditions and stories that people share during the holiday season.

In the end, Elsa's powers are restored, and she is able to use them once again. Anna and Olaf return home, where they are greeted with a grand celebration. The film ends with a heartwarming moment between Anna and Elsa, as they share a hug and a smile, symbolizing their love and appreciation for each other.

Overall, Olaf's Frozen Adventure is a heartwarming and entertaining film that explores the true meaning of Christmas through the eyes of two beloved characters from the Frozen franchise. The movie features stunning animation, catchy music, and lovable characters that will delight audiences of all ages.

title: Security
overview: An ex-special services veteran, down on his luck and desperate for work, takes a job as a security guard at a run-down mall in a rough area of town. On his first night on the job, he opens the door to a distraught and desperate young girl who has fled the hijacking of a Police motorcade that was transporting her to testify as a witness in a trial. Hot on her heels is the psychopathic hijacker and his team of henchmen, who will stop at nothing to extract and eliminate the witness.
plot:
Security is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by Alain DesRochers and written by Tony Mosher and John Sullivan. Antonio Banderas stars as Eddie Deacon, a former Marine who takes a job as a shopping mall security guard, with Ben Kingsley as Charlie, the leader of a band of mercenaries, Liam McIntyre as Vance, Gabriella Wright as Ruby, Chad Lindberg as Mason, Jiro Wang as Johnny Wei, Cung Le as the mercenary "Dead Eyes" and Katherine Mary de la Rocha as Jamie. Made for Nu Image and Millennium Films on a budget of $15 million, it was shot in Bulgaria between November 2015 and January 2016.

Eddie Deacon, a former Marine Corps security captain accepts a job as a security guard at a shopping mall, where he meets his new colleagues Vance, Ruby, Mason and Johnny. Meanwhile, a US Marshals convoy transporting Jamie, a young girl who is the key witness in an organized crime trial, is ambushed by mercenaries. The marshals are killed, but Jamie escapes and runs to the mall for shelter. The mercenaries' leader, Charlie, arrives and offers the guards a bribe to hand her over, and when Eddie refuses, Charlie warns his own men that they and their families will die if they fail to bring her back. Cut off from help, Eddie and his small team improvise homemade bombs and booby traps to defend the building against the heavily armed intruders, killing several of the attackers. Their resistance comes at a cost, as Johnny is shot by a sniper while trying to signal the police and Ruby is fatally wounded helping Vance escape. When men posing as US Marshals arrive, Eddie spots the mercenaries' telltale neck tattoos and realizes they are impostors. With his team dwindling and the mercenaries jamming communications, Eddie sends Jamie to call for help while he faces Charlie's ruthless second-in-command, Dead Eyes, in a final fight to keep the girl alive and return home to his own wife and daughter.

Security was released in 2017 and became available to stream on Netflix in various countries on October 3, 2017.

title: Mandy
overview: The Shadow Mountains, 1983. Red and Mandy lead a loving and peaceful existence; but when their pine-scented haven is savagely destroyed, Red is catapulted into a phantasmagoric journey filled with bloody vengeance and laced with fire.
plot:
Mandy is a 2018 American psychological horror film written and directed by Panos Cosmatos. The film stars Nicolas Cage, Andrea Riseborough, and Linus Roache.

The story begins with Red Miller (Nicolas Cage), a lumberjack living in the Pacific Northwest with his girlfriend, Mandy Bloom (Andrea Riseborough). They are happy together, but their idyllic life is disrupted when Red's past comes back to haunt him. A former friend and fellow lumberjack, Jeremiah Sand (Linus Roache), arrives at their cabin, seeking refuge from a traumatic event in his own life.

Jeremiah's presence sets off a chain of events that ultimately leads to the downfall of Red and Mandy's relationship. It is revealed that Jeremiah was involved in a heinous crime with Red, which has left a deep scar on both men. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Jeremiah's true intentions are sinister, and he is seeking revenge against Red.

The film takes a dark and surreal turn as Jeremiah's actions escalate, leading to a series of gruesome and disturbing events. Mandy, who is initially oblivious to the danger lurking around her, begins to experience strange and terrifying visions. As the situation spirals out of control, Red becomes increasingly unhinged, descending into madness.

Throughout the film, Cosmatos employs a distinctive visual style, blending elements of folk horror, heavy metal music, and psychedelic art. The cinematography is striking, with vivid colors and unsettling imagery that adds to the overall sense of unease and dread.

As the plot reaches its climax, Red's world begins to disintegrate, and he is forced to confront his own demons. In a shocking and disturbing finale, Red's actions become increasingly erratic, leading to a confrontation with Jeremiah that will leave only one man standing.

Mandy is a film that defies easy interpretation, but at its core, it is a story about the destructive power of trauma and the devastating consequences of unchecked anger. The film's use of heavy metal music and its surreal, dreamlike atmosphere add to the sense of unease and tension, creating a viewing experience that is both captivating and unsettling.

Overall, Mandy is a bold and unflinching exploration of the human psyche, with a performance from Nicolas Cage that is both mesmerizing and terrifying. The film's unique blend of horror and drama makes it a must-see for fans of the genre, but be warned: Mandy is not for the faint of heart.

plot:
S.W.A.T.: Under Siege is a 2017 American action thriller film directed by Chris Mandleburg and starring Shemar Moore, Debra Messing, and Jay Harrington. The movie follows the story of Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson (Shemar Moore), a former Marine who joins the Los Angeles Police Department's Special Weapons and Tactics team.

The main themes of S.W.A.T.: Under Siege include:

1. **Loyalty and Teamwork**: The film highlights the importance of loyalty, trust, and teamwork among law enforcement officers. Hondo's leadership skills and ability to bring his team together are crucial in overcoming the challenges they face.
2. **Personal Redemption**: Hondo's character arc is centered around finding redemption for past mistakes. As he navigates his new role as a SWAT officer, he must confront his personal demons and prove himself as a valuable member of the team.
3. **Corruption and Institutional Failure**: The movie explores the theme of corruption within law enforcement agencies, highlighting the need for accountability and reform. The villainous character, Victor Tanaka (Brian Michael Smith), represents a corrupt cop who is more interested in personal gain than serving justice.
4. **Gritty Realism**: S.W.A.T.: Under Siege offers a gritty, realistic portrayal of police work, showcasing the intense training and high-stakes situations that SWAT officers face on a daily basis.

The plot development revolves around Hondo's initial struggles to adjust to his new role, as he faces skepticism from his colleagues and must prove himself in the field. As the story unfolds, he becomes embroiled in a complex web of corruption and deceit, leading to a tense showdown with Tanaka and his accomplices.

Ultimately, the film concludes with Hondo emerging victorious, having successfully brought down the corrupt cop and restored justice to the community. The ending highlights Hondo's growth as a character, as he finds redemption and earns the respect of his peers.

Overall, S.W.A.T.: Under Siege is an action-packed thriller that explores themes of loyalty, personal redemption, corruption, and gritty realism, making it a compelling watch for fans of the genre.

plot:
Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya: Vow in the Snow, also known as Oath Under Snow, is a 2017 Japanese animated fantasy action film that serves as a prequel to Hiroshi Hiroyama's manga Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya, itself a spin-off of the visual novel Fate/stay night. Shin Oonuma directed the film and Silver Link produced it, both returning from the anime series. The voice cast includes Noriaki Sugiyama, Kaori Nazuka, Rikiya Koyama, Natsuki Hanae and Noriko Shitaya.

As a boy, Shirou travels with his adoptive father, Kiritsugu, to Fuyuki city to investigate a family rumored to be hiding a child with extraordinary magical power. Amid the city's ruins they rescue Miyu, who can grant wishes unconditionally and whose exposure to human desires probably caused a disastrous storm. Kiritsugu intends to use her power to save humanity and insists that Shirou treat her as a tool rather than a person, but Shirou grows attached to her, and Kiritsugu dies before learning how to use her powers.

Five years later, Shirou lives as an ordinary high school student, with Miyu as his younger sister, alongside classmates Julian and Sakura. As he prepares to take Miyu to see the ocean, Julian appears to complete a ritual he began years earlier, revealing himself as the cause of the vortex that destroyed Fuyuki. Julian and his follower Angelica defeat Shirou, leave him for dead and kidnap Miyu. The priest Kirei Kotomine explains that Julian belongs to the Ainsworths, an ancient family of mages who foresaw humanity's end and seek the wish-granting Holy Grail to avert it, and that Julian means to sacrifice Miyu to begin the Grail War. Sakura offers Shirou help but wishes he would flee the city because of her feelings for him. Her brother Shinji, holding the Assassin card, attacks them and kills her, and Shirou uses her Archer card to defeat Shinji, who proves to be Julian's puppet. Shirou then hunts down the other card holders, all likewise puppets. Declared the winner by Kirei, he finds Miyu in a cave and, defying Kiritsugu's wishes, uses his wish to send her to another world where she can be happy. Without his card he fights Angelica, the true Archer card holder, and is defeated, but buys enough time for the ritual to finish. Miyu wakes in an alternate Fuyuki.

The film grossed $1,118,410 in Japan, and its home media releases sold strongly. Critics praised its alternate take on Shirou and its visuals.

The story revolves around Kabir (played by Anthony Mackie), a young man who possesses superhuman abilities after being bitten by an infected mosquito while traveling in India. He is diagnosed with "Code 8," a rare genetic disorder that grants him extraordinary powers, including super strength, speed, and agility.

Kabir returns to his hometown of Toronto, where he struggles to control his new abilities and navigate the complexities of his life as a superhero. His brother, Tyler (played by Luke Mitchell), is initially unaware of Kabir's secret but eventually discovers his true nature.

As Kabir tries to live a normal life, he becomes embroiled in a conspiracy involving corrupt government officials and corporate interests who seek to exploit individuals with superhuman abilities for their own gain. The main antagonist, Senator Stevens (played by Stephen McHattie), is determined to capture and control those with Code 8 powers.

Kabir's journey takes him from the streets of Toronto to the corridors of power in Ottawa, where he must confront his own demons and make difficult choices about how to use his abilities. Along the way, he forms alliances with a group of individuals who possess similar powers, including Tyler, who becomes a key player in Kabir's quest for justice.

Throughout the movie, the themes of identity, community, and social responsibility are explored. Kabir must navigate the complexities of being a superhero while also dealing with personal struggles and relationships. The film features a diverse cast of characters, reflecting the multiculturalism of Toronto.

The plot thickens as Kabir discovers that Senator Stevens is hiding a dark secret: he has been experimenting on individuals with Code 8 powers, using them for his own nefarious purposes. Kabir must use his abilities to stop Stevens and his cohorts, while also confronting the moral implications of his actions.

In the end, Kabir emerges victorious but not without scars. He finds a sense of belonging among those who possess similar powers, and he begins to forge a new path forward, one that balances his desire for justice with his need for human connection. The movie concludes on a hopeful note, suggesting that even in the face of adversity, individuals with extraordinary abilities can make a positive impact.

Overall, Code 8 is a gripping thriller that explores themes of identity, community, and social responsibility. With its diverse cast and thought-provoking storyline, it offers a fresh take on the superhero genre.
